with:

```js
// Fire's alerts (codes above), in ascending building id. Cheap: one pass, and the coverage map only when some building
// is burning or at High risk (it is cached on the roads and the firehouses).
export function fireAlerts(world) {
  const out = [];
  let cover = null;
  const staffed = (b) => ((cover || (cover = fireCoverage(world))).get(b.id) || 0) >= FIRE.staffedAt;
  for (const b of allBuildings(world)) {
    if (b.fire) out.push({ code: staffed(b) ? 'blaze' : 'fire', id: b.id });
    else if (canBurn(b) && fireBand(b.risk || 0) >= 2 && !staffed(b)) out.push({ code: 'fire_risk', id: b.id });
  }
  return out;
}

// Why a building is or is not covered for putting fires out: { cause, cover, firehouse }. cause is 'covered' (coverage
// at least FIRE.staffedAt); 'no_road' (no road tile beside it, so no firehouse can reach it); 'none' (no firehouse within
// FIRE.reach road tiles); otherwise it names the best firehouse that does reach it (working beats burning beats paused,
// then the most staff): 'short' (working or not, it is short of workers), 'burning' (it is in the fire stage) or
// 'paused'. firehouse is that firehouse's id (for 'covered', the best-staffed one), or null.
export function fireCause(world, b) {
  const cover = coverageOf(world, b);
  const roads = adjacentRoadTiles(world, b);
  let pick = null, rank = -1;
  if (roads.length) {
    for (const f of allBuildings(world)) {
      if (f.type !== 'firehouse') continue;
      const reach = roadReach(world, f, FIRE.reach);
      if (!roads.some((t) => reach.has(t))) continue;
      const r = f.paused ? 0 : inFireStage(f) ? 1 : 2 + staffRatio(world, f);
      if (r > rank) { rank = r; pick = f; }
    }
  }
  let cause;
  if (cover >= FIRE.staffedAt) cause = 'covered';
  else if (!roads.length) cause = 'no_road';
  else if (!pick) cause = 'none';
  else cause = pick.paused ? 'paused' : inFireStage(pick) ? 'burning' : 'short';
  return { cause, cover, firehouse: pick ? pick.id : null };
}

// Fire's mood terms (spec 4.9, DANGER_MOOD): { fire } when a building was in the fire stage in the last 30 days
// (danger.lastFireDay; a blaze put out in time never sets it), { burned } for the buildings burned in the last 180 days
// (each burnedEach, at most burnedMax); a key only while its term is not 0. updateMood adds them at the month end, when
// world.day has just turned, so the last 30 days are exactly last month's.
export function fireMood(world) {
  const out = {};
  const d = world.danger;
  if (d.lastFireDay !== null && world.day - d.lastFireDay <= DAYS_PER_MONTH) out.fire = DANGER_MOOD.fireLastMonth;
  const n = d.burnDays.filter((day) => world.day - day <= DANGER_MOOD.burnedDays).length;
  if (n) out.burned = Math.max(DANGER_MOOD.burnedMax, n * DANGER_MOOD.burnedEach);
  return out;
}
```

(`fireCause` walks the firehouses only, and `roadReach` is cached per footprint on the road version, so it is cheap enough for the words, which are worked out per alert shown, not per tick. `fireAlerts` stays one pass over the buildings, as the contract asks: `alertsFor` is called several times a tick.)

In `src/ui/text.js`, inside Track A's section only, replace:

```js
export const FIRE_TEXT = {};
```

with:

```js
// Track A's words for fire: the fire row, alert titles and fixes for fire, blaze and fire_risk, the mood rows fire and burned, captions. Add new lines just above the end marker.
// (An import declaration is hoisted, so it may sit here, inside the section. The names are Track A's own, so another
// section importing fireCause, fireBand or FIRE under their plain names cannot clash with them.)
import { fireCause as fireCauseOf, fireBand as fireBandOf } from '../sim/fire.js';
import { FIRE as FIRE_NUMBERS } from '../data/fire.js';

// Every line follows src/sim/fire.js: fireAlerts picks the code, fireCause the reason no staffed firehouse reaches the
// building, b.fire.left the days a fire has before the building burns down (it burns on the day left reaches 0).
export const FIRE_TEXT = {
  caught: (name) => `${name} has caught fire`,                                    // a blaze
  burning: (name, left) => `${name} is burning: ${plural(left, 'day', 'days')} left`,   // the fire stage
  highRisk: (name) => `${name} has a high fire risk`,                             // fireBand 2 (High)
  canCatch: (name) => `${name} could catch fire`,                                 // fireBand 3 (Can catch fire): 3% a day
  fighting: {
    blaze: 'The firehouse is putting it out',                                     // it can still reach need before the blaze grows
    late: (days) => `The firehouse came too late: it grows into a fire in ${plural(days, 'day', 'days')}`,
    fire: 'The firehouse is fighting it',                                         // 25% x coverage a day
  },
  cause: {
    covered: 'A firehouse reaches it',
    no_road: 'No road beside it for a firehouse to reach: lay one',
    none: `No firehouse within ${FIRE_NUMBERS.reach} road tiles: build one near it`,
    short: 'Its firehouse is short of workers: more homes bring more workers',
    burning: 'Its firehouse is burning: build another near it',
    paused: 'Its firehouse is paused: resume it',
  },
};
// A home is named by its tier ("Hut has caught fire"), anything else by its type.
const fireAlertName = (b, name) => (b && b.type === 'house' ? tierName(b.tier) : name);
const fireAlertTitle = (b, name) => (b && b.fire && b.fire.stage === 'fire' ? FIRE_TEXT.burning(fireAlertName(b, name), b.fire.left) : FIRE_TEXT.caught(fireAlertName(b, name)));
const fireCauseFix = (world, b) => (b ? FIRE_TEXT.cause[fireCauseOf(world, b).cause] : FIRE_TEXT.cause.none);
// A covered blaze goes out when its fought days reach need before days reaches FIRE.blazeDays (fireDay counts the fought
// day first), so it is too late when more fought days are needed than blaze days are left.
function fireFightFix(b) {
  const f = b && b.fire;
  if (f && f.stage === 'fire') return FIRE_TEXT.fighting.fire;
  if (f && f.need - f.fought > FIRE_NUMBERS.blazeDays - f.days) return FIRE_TEXT.fighting.late(FIRE_NUMBERS.blazeDays - f.days);
  return FIRE_TEXT.fighting.blaze;
}
Object.assign(ALERT_TEXT, {
  fire: (alert, world, b, name) => ({ title: fireAlertTitle(b, name), fix: fireCauseFix(world, b) }),
  blaze: (alert, world, b, name) => ({ title: fireAlertTitle(b, name), fix: fireFightFix(b) }),
  fire_risk: (alert, world, b, name) => ({
    title: b && fireBandOf(b.risk || 0) >= 3 ? FIRE_TEXT.canCatch(fireAlertName(b, name)) : FIRE_TEXT.highRisk(fireAlertName(b, name)),
    fix: fireCauseFix(world, b),
  }),
});
// The summary's mood rows (fireMood's keys).
Object.assign(MOOD_NAMES, { fire: 'A fire last month', burned: 'Buildings burned, last 6 months' });
```

Why each line is true of the sim: "has caught fire" is a blaze; "is burning: N days left" reads `b.fire.left`, and the fire burns the building down on the day `left` reaches 0, so N more game days; "The firehouse is putting it out" appears only for `blaze` on a blaze, which `fireAlerts` raises only at coverage 0.5 or more, so every remaining blaze day is fought, and only while the fought days it still needs fit in the blaze days it has left (otherwise "The firehouse came too late: it grows into a fire in N days", which is what `fireDay` then does; if the firehouse loses workers the code turns to `fire`); "is fighting it" is a covered fire's 25% x coverage a day; the `fire` fixes name `fireCause`'s cause, the same rank the coverage map uses (a firehouse below 25% staff or paused covers nothing, a burning one covers nothing); "within 8 road tiles" reads `FIRE.reach`; "could catch fire" is risk at 100 or more (`fireBand` 3, a 3% draw a day), "a high fire risk" 60-99. Track D tiers these codes and writes the banner around them; Track E's first-fire goal names the firehouse.

# Track B: raids and defence

CONTRACT NOTE: Nothing in the contract raises a wall tile to `DEFENCE.towerOnWallHp` when a tower is placed on it (`place` leaves `world.wall` alone). Track B resolves it in its own files: `defence.js` gains `fullWallHp(world, i)` (80 under a tower, else `wallHpFor`) and `healWalls(world)`, and the raid step sets every standing tile to its full hit points when raiders arrive and again when the raid ends (the spec's heal). Between raids a tower's wall tile may read 40; only a raid reads it. `place`, `demolish` and `undo` are unchanged.
CONTRACT NOTE: `flowField`'s cache is keyed on the tile costs themselves (every tile's `tileCost`, compared exactly), not on `wallVersion`, `roadVersion` and a building signature alone. A wall's hit points fall on every hit without a version bump (contract), so a field cached across a hit would differ from the one a city loaded mid-raid builds afresh, and the two would walk different ways; the contract's own "saving and loading mid-raid changes nothing" needs the stricter key.
CONTRACT NOTE: A tower standing on a wall tile falls (the building is removed, no rubble) when raiders break that tile, so no building ever stands on a breach (contract note 5). The spec is silent on it.
CONTRACT NOTE: Fields Track B adds inside its records: `raid.active.x`, `.y` (the band's tile), `.blocked` (the wall tile in its way, or null), `.towerIds` (towers that shot), `.fires` (`[{ id, type }]`, buildings the raid set alight still burning) and `.burnedKinds`; `raid.last` carries `fires` and `burnedKinds` too, and its `burned` keeps counting after the raid ends while the raid's fires burn out (the band leaves within days; a fire burns 10-15). The `raid_end` event's report is a snapshot. Code that builds `active` by hand in the contract's shape alone still works (`raidStep` fills the extra fields in).
CONTRACT NOTE: Burned buildings are recognised by `trackFires` as "the struck building is gone on a day `danger.burnDays` ends with `world.day`". That needs Track A's `burnBuilding` to push the day being simulated (`world.day` during `fireDay`) to `danger.burnDays`, as the contract's `danger` row implies. Track B3's catch-up step checks it against the real fire.
CONTRACT NOTE: `combatDay` returns `{ fighting }` (the contract gave no return value; `raidDay` needs it to hold the band). New exports beside the contract's: `soldiersHome`, `BESIDE` (`combat.js`), `fullWallHp`, `healWalls` (`defence.js`), `flowCacheSize` (`pathfinding.js`, tests).
CONTRACT NOTE: Track B's words import the sim through namespace imports placed inside its own `text.js` section (`import * as raidsData`, `raidsSim`, `raidsTime`; import declarations are hoisted), so it never edits the shared import block at the top. No other track may use those three names.
CONTRACT NOTE: Three Track 0 tests asserted Track B's stub defaults or pinned a table B adds to; B updates exactly those lines: `tests/stage3/contract/simSeams.test.js` (the raid stub test's `flowField`, `previewWall` and `drawWall` lines), `tests/stage3/contract/uiSeams.test.js` (the wall line tool's preview, which expected the stub's `locked`), and `tests/ui/houseSheetWhy.test.js` (`MOOD_NAMES` pinned exactly, now the Stage 1-2 rows only).

It never changes a number in `src/data/raids.js` (none needed tuning) and never touches `festival.js` (complete in Track 0).

Every code block below was applied, in this order, to a copy of the repo with Track 0 applied, and the full suite run after each task: 993, 1001 and 1018 tests, `ALL PASSED` (before Track A's real fire; B3's Step 0 merges it in). The before-blocks are exact; apply them in the order given.

How a raid runs, in one paragraph (so the words and the tests read against it): `raidDay` runs every day after `fireDay`. Barracks train on every level. On every level but Peaceful the clock starts the first day the city has 250 people (its peak counts), the first warning comes 720 days later (index 0: 3 raiders, no tribute, a pause), later ones `laterWarnDay` after the last raid's arrival (a drop from 2x or 3x to 1x). On the warning's `arrives` day the band appears at the entry (a drop to 1x; standing walls healed to full, a tower's wall tile to 80). Each later day: towers shoot (4 x staffing, the nearest raider within 4 tiles of the tower's centre), soldiers within 8 tiles of their barracks' centre walk 2 tiles towards the nearest raider or hit it for 3 when beside it, raiders hit a soldier beside them or the wall tile blocking the band for 2; fallen raiders and wounded soldiers leave; at half the raiders fallen (rounded up) the band turns back; unless anyone fought, the band waits out its strike or steps one tile along the flow field (towards the nearest unstruck building of the warned kind, then the kinds below it, then any non-home; back to the entry after 3 strikes or in retreat), stopping before a standing wall tile to break it. Reaching its target the band strikes (a blaze through `igniteBuilding`, 1% of the treasury per raider, 5-50, never below 0) and stays 2 days. The raid ends when no raider is left: beaten when they all fell or retreated, lost when the band left after its strikes; then the report, the tallies, the adaptation, the next warning, healed walls and soldiers walking home.

with

```js
// Raises the warning for the raid at world.raid.index (spec 4.3, 4.13): its entry by hash2(seed, index,
// RAID_SALT.entry) among world.raiderEntries (a map without any has no raids), its direction, its size and tribute fixed
// now, the target kind now, arriving RAIDS.warningDays later. The first warning pauses the game; later ones drop 2x or 3x
// to 1x (setSpeed). index then counts it, so laterWarnDay draws the next raid's gap.
function raiseWarning(world, events) {
  const r = world.raid, entries = world.raiderEntries;
  if (!entries.length) return;
  const index = r.index, first = index === 0;
  const entry = { ...entries[Math.floor(hash2(world.seed, index, RAID_SALT.entry) * entries.length)] };
  const size = raidSize(world);
  const w = { index, entry, dir: entryDir(world, entry), size, tribute: first ? null : tributeFor(world, size), target: raidTargetKind(world), day: world.day, arrives: world.day + RAIDS.warningDays, first };
  r.warning = w;
  r.index = index + 1;
  if (first) setSpeed(world, 0);
  else if (world.speed > 1) setSpeed(world, 1);
  if (events) events.push({ type: 'raid_warning', index, entry: { ...entry }, dir: w.dir, size, tribute: w.tribute, target: w.target, arrives: w.arrives, first });
}

// The day's raid step (spec 4.3, 4.13), run by tickDay after fireDay; world.day is the day being simulated. Never on
// Peaceful (raidsOn). The clock starts the first day the city has RAIDS.clockPeople people (its peak counts: a city that
// had them keeps its clock), and the first warning comes RAIDS.firstWarnAfter days later; a warning is raised on
// nextWarnDay when none is up and no raid is under way.
export function raidDay(world, events = null) {
  if (!raidsOn(world)) return;
  const r = world.raid, day = world.day;
  if (r.clockDay === null && Math.max(world.tally.peakPeople, population(world)) >= RAIDS.clockPeople) {
    r.clockDay = day;
    r.nextWarnDay = day + RAIDS.firstWarnAfter;
  }
  if (!r.warning && !r.active && r.nextWarnDay !== null && day >= r.nextWarnDay) raiseWarning(world, events);
}

// STUB. The month-end raid step, run by runMonth before mood (nothing required yet; kept so a later rule has its seam).
export function raidMonth(world, events = null) {}

// The band's centre as a map tile: the mean of its raiders' points, or the entry when none is left.
function bandCentre(a) {
  if (!a.raiders.length) return { x: a.entry.x, y: a.entry.y };
  const n = a.raiders.length;
  return { x: Math.floor(a.raiders.reduce((s, u) => s + u.x, 0) / n), y: Math.floor(a.raiders.reduce((s, u) => s + u.y, 0) / n) };
}

// Raids' alerts, both critical: { code: 'raid', x, y, left } while raiders are on the map (x, y: the band's centre;
// left: raiders still on the map) and { code: 'raid_warning', x, y, dir, arrives } while a raid is on its way (x, y: its
// entry). A warning and a raid are never up at once.
export function raidAlerts(world) {
  const r = world.raid, out = [];
  if (r.active) out.push({ code: 'raid', ...bandCentre(r.active), left: r.active.raiders.length });
  if (r.warning) out.push({ code: 'raid_warning', x: r.warning.entry.x, y: r.warning.entry.y, dir: r.warning.dir, arrives: r.warning.arrives });
  return out;
}
```

with

```js
// Track B imports under its own names (import declarations are hoisted, so they may sit in this section).
import * as raidsData from '../data/raids.js';
import * as raidsSim from '../sim/raids.js';
import * as raidsTime from '../sim/time.js';
export const RAID_TEXT = {
  // The edge a raid comes from, as the words say it: "Raiders from the east", "facing east".
  dirs: { north: 'north', east: 'east', south: 'south', west: 'west' },
  // What a raid is after, in the plural: "storehouses", "trading posts"; "buildings" for a raid after any building.
  targets: (kind) => (kind === 'building' ? 'buildings' : pluralName(kind)),
  // The defence that would beat the warned raid (spec 4.13, ruling 108), from tributeQuote: N is the towers it needs less
  // the working towers the city has, priced at this city's tower: "Build 2 towers facing east (≈ 300 gold)"; at 0 "Your
  // towers can beat this raid". '' with no warning up. The banner puts it beside Pay tribute (Track D).
  towers(world) {
    const q = raidsSim.tributeQuote(world);
    if (!q) return '';
    if (q.buildN === 0) return 'Your towers can beat this raid';
    return `Build ${plural(q.buildN, 'tower', 'towers')} facing ${RAID_TEXT.dirs[world.raid.warning.dir]} (≈ ${q.buildCost} gold)`;
  },
};
// The raid alerts (raidAlerts). raid_warning: what is coming and the defence that would beat it. raid: the band on the map
// by its phase (raid.active.phase): fighting its way in or striking, leaving after its strikes, or falling back once half
// have fallen; towers (DEFENCE.towerRange tiles of a tower) and soldiers (DEFENCE.patrol tiles of their barracks) fight it
// in every phase.
Object.assign(ALERT_TEXT, {
  raid_warning: (alert, world) => {
    const w = world.raid.warning;
    return { title: `Raiders from the ${RAID_TEXT.dirs[alert.dir]} are after your ${RAID_TEXT.targets(w ? w.target : 'building')}`, fix: RAID_TEXT.towers(world) };
  },
  raid: (alert, world) => {
    const a = world.raid.active;
    const dir = RAID_TEXT.dirs[a ? a.dir : ''] || '';
    const phase = a ? a.phase : 'attack';
    const raiders = plural(alert.left, 'raider', 'raiders');
    if (phase === 'retreat') return { title: `Raid from the ${dir}: ${raiders} falling back`, fix: 'Towers keep shooting as they go' };
    const fix = `Towers hit raiders within ${raidsData.DEFENCE.towerRange} tiles; soldiers fight within ${raidsData.DEFENCE.patrol} tiles of their barracks`;
    return { title: phase === 'leave' ? `Raid from the ${dir}: ${raiders} leaving` : `Raid from the ${dir}: ${raiders}`, fix };
  },
});
// The mood rows (spec 4.9): a raid in the last six months (raidMood), a festival (festivalMood).
Object.assign(MOOD_NAMES, { raid: 'Recent raid', festival: 'Festival' });
// payTribute's and holdFestival's refusals (spec 4.13).
Object.assign(REASONS, {
  no_warning: 'No raid is on its way',
  first_raid: "The first raid can't be paid off",
  below_zero: "Tribute can't put the treasury below 0",
  no_temple: 'Needs a working temple',
  too_soon: `One festival every ${Math.round(raidsData.FESTIVAL.every / raidsTime.DAYS_PER_MONTH)} months`,
});
```

```js
    expect(f.next(10, 7)).toEqual([11, 7]);
```

Replace the whole of `src/sim/pathfinding.js` with:

```js
// Raider pathfinding (spec 4.13): one flow field per band target, rebuilt when walls, roads or buildings change, cached
// outside the world (a WeakMap, as reach.js does), so saves stay pure data. Stage 3 contract: Track B implements the
// STUB and may change tileCost's internals, never its meaning.
//
// The cache is keyed on the tile costs themselves (every tile's tileCost, compared exactly), not only on the versions:
// a wall's hit points fall on every hit without a wallVersion bump, so a field kept across a hit would differ from the
// one a city loaded mid-raid computes afresh, and the two would walk different ways. Comparing 64 x 64 numbers a call
// is far cheaper than one search, and a field is still built only when a cost changed.
import { idx, inBounds, NEIGHBOURS4 } from './grid.js';
import { T } from './terrain.js';

// What crossing a tile costs a raider (spec 4.13): open ground and roads 1; water and buildings cannot be crossed
// (Infinity); a standing wall, gate or tower-on-wall tile 1 + its hit points / 2 (the days one raider needs to break
// it); a breach 1. A tower stands on a wall tile with the wall's hit points (DEFENCE.towerOnWallHp), so its tile is a
// wall tile here; a tower on open ground is a building.
export function tileCost(world, x, y) {
  if (!inBounds(world.size, x, y)) return Infinity;
  const i = idx(world.size, x, y);
  if (world.terrain[i] === T.WATER) return Infinity;
  if (world.wall[i] > 0) return 1 + world.wall[i] / 2;
  if (world.wall[i] < 0) return 1;
  return world.occ[i] ? Infinity : 1;
}

const cache = new WeakMap();   // world -> { costs: Float64Array, fields: Map(goal key -> field) }

function costsOf(world) {
  const n = world.size, costs = new Float64Array(n * n);
  for (let y = 0; y < n; y++) for (let x = 0; x < n; x++) costs[y * n + x] = tileCost(world, x, y);
  return costs;
}

function sameCosts(a, b) {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i]) return false;
  return true;
}

// A binary heap of [priority, tile], smallest first; ties go to the lower tile index, so the search is deterministic.
function heapPush(h, p, t) {
  h.push([p, t]);
  let i = h.length - 1;
  while (i > 0) {
    const j = (i - 1) >> 1;
    if (h[j][0] < p || (h[j][0] === p && h[j][1] <= t)) break;
    h[i] = h[j]; i = j;
  }
  h[i] = [p, t];
}
function heapPop(h) {
  const top = h[0], last = h.pop();
  if (h.length) {
    let i = 0;
    for (;;) {
      const l = 2 * i + 1, r = l + 1;
      let m = i, mp = last;
      if (l < h.length && (h[l][0] < mp[0] || (h[l][0] === mp[0] && h[l][1] < mp[1]))) { m = l; mp = h[l]; }
      if (r < h.length && (h[r][0] < mp[0] || (h[r][0] === mp[0] && h[r][1] < mp[1]))) { m = r; mp = h[r]; }
      if (m === i) break;
      h[i] = h[m]; i = m;
    }
    h[i] = last;
  }
  return top;
}

// The search: dist[u] is the cheapest sum of entry costs from u to a goal (a goal itself 0). Every tile gets a dist, even
// one a raider cannot enter (so a band standing where it should not, as on its entry, can still step off), but only
// tiles that can be crossed carry the search on.
function buildField(world, costs, goals) {
  const n = world.size, dist = new Float64Array(n * n).fill(Infinity), heap = [];
  for (const [x, y] of goals) {
    if (!inBounds(n, x, y)) continue;
    const i = idx(n, x, y);
    if (costs[i] === Infinity || dist[i] === 0) continue;
    dist[i] = 0;
    heapPush(heap, 0, i);
  }
  while (heap.length) {
    const [d, v] = heapPop(heap);
    if (d > dist[v] || costs[v] === Infinity) continue;
    const step = d + costs[v], vx = v % n, vy = (v - vx) / n;
    for (const [dx, dy] of NEIGHBOURS4) {
      const ux = vx + dx, uy = vy + dy;
      if (!inBounds(n, ux, uy)) continue;
      const u = uy * n + ux;
      if (step < dist[u]) { dist[u] = step; if (costs[u] !== Infinity) heapPush(heap, step, u); }
    }
  }
  const next = (x, y) => {
    if (!inBounds(n, x, y)) return null;
    const here = dist[idx(n, x, y)];
    if (here === 0 || here === Infinity) return null;
    let best = null, bestCost = Infinity;
    for (const [dx, dy] of NEIGHBOURS4) {
      const vx = x + dx, vy = y + dy;
      if (!inBounds(n, vx, vy)) continue;
      const v = vy * n + vx, c = dist[v] + costs[v];
      if (c < bestCost) { bestCost = c; best = [vx, vy]; }
    }
    return best;
  };
  return { dist, next };
}

// The flow field towards the goal tiles ([[x, y], ...]): { dist, next } where dist is a Float64Array of size² (the
// cheapest cost from each tile to a goal, Infinity where none is reachable) and next(x, y) is the neighbouring tile
// [x, y] one step cheaper, or null at a goal or where none is (ties go to NEIGHBOURS4's order: east, west, south,
// north). Goals that cannot be crossed (water, a building) are left out. Shared and cached: callers must not write to it.
export function flowField(world, goals) {
  const costs = costsOf(world);
  let c = cache.get(world);
  if (!c || !sameCosts(c.costs, costs)) {
    c = { costs, fields: new Map() };
    cache.set(world, c);
  }
  const key = goals.map(([x, y]) => `${x},${y}`).join(' ');
  let f = c.fields.get(key);
  if (!f) {
    f = buildField(world, costs, goals);
    c.fields.set(key, f);
  }
  return f;
}

// How many fields the cache holds for this world now (tests).
export function flowCacheSize(world) {
  const c = cache.get(world);
  return c ? c.fields.size : 0;
}
```

Replace the whole of `src/sim/defence.js` with:

```js
// Walls and gates (spec 4.13, 6.4 Drawing mode). Stage 3 contract: Track 0 fixed the names, signatures and shapes;
// Track B implements the STUBs. Walls are a tile layer, world.wall: 0 none, > 0 a standing tile's hit points, -1 a breach
// (broken stone, a gap until wall is drawn over it again at the normal price). A gate is a wall tile on a road: citizens,
// walkers and road reach pass it (it is still road), raiders treat it as wall. world.wallVersion goes up whenever a tile
// appears, goes or breaks (the path and terrain caches key on it). The commands keep buildings and roads off wall tiles
// (a tower may stand on a standing wall tile), and demolish and undo handle wall tiles (src/sim/commands.js, undo.js).
//
// A tower standing on a wall tile has DEFENCE.towerOnWallHp: the raid step (raids.js) sets every standing tile to its
// full hit points, fullWallHp, when raiders arrive and again when the raid ends (spec 4.13: hit tiles heal), so placing
// or demolishing a tower needs no change to the wall layer.
import { DEFENCE } from '../data/raids.js';
import { idx, inBounds } from './grid.js';
import { T } from './terrain.js';
import { isUnlocked } from './progression.js';
import { canAfford, spend } from './money.js';
import { costOf } from './costs.js';
import { pushUndo } from './undo.js';
import { roadPath } from './commands.js';

const fail = (reason, extra = {}) => ({ ok: false, reason, warnings: [], tiles: [], gates: [], cost: 0, ...extra });

// A wall tile on a road.
export const isGate = (world, i) => world.wall[i] !== 0 && Boolean(world.road[i]);

// The hit points a newly drawn tile gets: a gate's on a road, a wall's elsewhere.
export const wallHpFor = (world, i) => (world.road[i] ? DEFENCE.gateHp : DEFENCE.wallHp);

// A standing tile's full hit points: a tower's on a tile a tower stands on, else wallHpFor.
export function fullWallHp(world, i) {
  const id = world.occ[i];
  return id && world.buildings[id] && world.buildings[id].type === 'tower' ? DEFENCE.towerOnWallHp : wallHpFor(world, i);
}

// Every standing tile back to its full hit points (raids.js: on arrival and when the raid ends). Breaches stay.
export function healWalls(world) {
  for (let i = 0; i < world.wall.length; i++) if (world.wall[i] > 0) world.wall[i] = fullWallHp(world, i);
}

// The tiles raiders stand on (a wall cannot be drawn under them).
function raiderTiles(world) {
  const a = world.raid.active;
  return new Set(a ? a.raiders.map((r) => idx(world.size, Math.floor(r.x), Math.floor(r.y))) : []);
}

// What drawing wall from (x0, y0) to (x1, y1) would do, in the road tool's L (flip picks the other L):
// { ok, reason, warnings, tiles, gates, cost } where tiles are the map indices that get wall (new tiles and breaches
// redrawn; standing wall is skipped), gates the subset on roads, and cost = walls x costOf(world, 'wall') + gates x
// costOf(world, 'gate'). Fails with 'locked' (before Market town), 'out_of_bounds', 'water', 'blocked' (a building in the
// way, or a raider), 'nothing_to_place' (all of it is wall already) or 'no_gold' (below the debt floor), keeping
// tiles, gates and cost for the last two.
export function previewWall(world, x0, y0, x1, y1, flip = false) {
  if (!isUnlocked(world, 'wall')) return fail('locked');
  if (![x0, y0, x1, y1].every(Number.isInteger) || !inBounds(world.size, x0, y0) || !inBounds(world.size, x1, y1)) return fail('out_of_bounds');
  const raiders = raiderTiles(world);
  const tiles = [], gates = [];
  for (const [x, y] of roadPath(x0, y0, x1, y1, flip)) {
    const i = idx(world.size, x, y);
    if (world.terrain[i] === T.WATER) return fail('water');
    if (world.occ[i] || raiders.has(i)) return fail('blocked');
    if (world.wall[i] > 0) continue;                                   // standing wall: nothing to do
    tiles.push(i);
    if (world.road[i]) gates.push(i);
  }
  if (!tiles.length) return fail('nothing_to_place');
  const cost = (tiles.length - gates.length) * costOf(world, 'wall') + gates.length * costOf(world, 'gate');
  if (!canAfford(world, cost)) return fail('no_gold', { tiles, gates, cost });
  return { ok: true, reason: null, warnings: [], tiles, gates, cost };
}

// The drawWall command (spec 7.3): draws the preview's tiles at full hit points, charges its cost, bumps wallVersion,
// adds tally.wallTiles, takes 'wall' out of newItems, and pushes the undo entry { kind: 'wall', tiles, before, cost }
// (before: each tile's value before, so undo puts breaches back). Returns the preview's result.
export function drawWall(world, x0, y0, x1, y1, flip = false) {
  const p = previewWall(world, x0, y0, x1, y1, flip);
  if (!p.ok) return p;
  const before = p.tiles.map((t) => world.wall[t]);
  for (const t of p.tiles) world.wall[t] = wallHpFor(world, t);
  world.wallVersion++;
  spend(world, p.cost);
  world.tally.wallTiles += p.tiles.length;
  const fresh = world.newItems.indexOf('wall');                      // the Defence card's wall stops saying "New"
  if (fresh >= 0) world.newItems.splice(fresh, 1);
  pushUndo(world, { kind: 'wall', tiles: p.tiles.slice(), before, cost: p.cost });
  return p;
}
```

```js
    expect(a.raiders.map((r) => [r.id, r.hp, r.hit, Math.floor(r.x), Math.floor(r.y)])).toEqual([0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((k) => [unit + k, UNITS.raider.hp, false, 31, 16]));
    expect([w.nextUnitId, w.tally.raids, w.speed]).toEqual([unit + 5, 1, 1]);
    expect(events).toEqual([{ type: 'raid_start', index: 1, dir: 'east', size: 5 }]);
    expect([20, 21, 22].map((x) => w.wall[idx(w.size, x, 2)])).toEqual([DEFENCE.wallHp, DEFENCE.towerOnWallHp, DEFENCE.wallHp]);
    expect(raidAlerts(w)).toEqual([{ code: 'raid', x: 31, y: 16, left: 5 }]);
    const p = city().w;
    p.speed = 0;
    arriveNow(p, 3);
    expect(p.speed).toBe(0);                                                          // never a pause, and a paused game stays paused
  });
  it('walks to the nearest of the warned kind, strikes three targets two days each, steals, then leaves: a lost raid', () => {
    const { w, store } = city(1000);
    const far = addRaw(w, 'storehouse', 6, 3);
    const temple = addRaw(w, 'temple', 14, 20);
    addRaw(w, 'well', 25, 12);
    addRaw(w, 'house', 20, 20, { tier: 3, residents: 10 });
    arriveNow(w, 3, { day: 1000 });
    const events = runRaid(w);
    const hits = strikes(events);
    expect(hits.map((e) => e.id)).toEqual([store.id, far.id, temple.id]);            // storehouses nearest first, then the next kind down
    expect(hits.map((e) => e.stolen)).toEqual([30, 30, 27]);                           // 1% of the treasury a raider, at least 5: 10+10+10, 10+10+10, 9+9+9
    expect(w.gold).toBe(1000 - 87);
    const end = ended(events);
    expect(end.won).toBe(false);
    expect(end.report).toEqual({ index: 0, dir: 'east', size: 3, won: false, byTowers: 0, bySoldiers: 0, towers: 0, burned: 0, stolen: 87, day: w.day, burnedKinds: [], fires: end.report.fires });
    expect(w.raid.last).toEqual(end.report);
    expect([w.raid.active, w.tally.raidsLost, w.tally.raidsBeaten, w.tally.goldStolen, w.raid.adaptation]).toEqual([null, 1, 0, 87, RAIDS.adaptLost]);
    expect(w.raid.nextWarnDay).toBe(laterWarnDay(w, 1000));
    expect(raidMood(w)).toEqual({ raid: DANGER_MOOD.raidLost });
    w.day = end.report.day + DANGER_MOOD.raidDays - 1;
    expect(raidMood(w)).toEqual({ raid: DANGER_MOOD.raidLost });
    w.day += 1;
    expect(raidMood(w)).toEqual({});
  });
  it('stays two days at a target, striking on the first, and never takes the treasury below 0', () => {
    const { w, store } = city(7);
    arriveNow(w, 3);
    const events = runRaid(w, 23);
    expect(strikes(events)).toEqual([{ type: 'raid_strike', id: store.id, stolen: 7 }]);  // 5, then the last 2, then nothing
    expect([w.gold, w.raid.active.phase, w.raid.active.wait, w.raid.active.x, w.raid.active.y]).toEqual([0, 'strike', RAIDS.strikeDays, 8, 16]);
    runRaid(w, 1);
    expect([w.raid.active.phase, w.raid.active.x]).toEqual(['strike', 8]);
    runRaid(w, 1);
    expect(w.raid.active.phase).toBe('leave');                                        // no other building: it goes home
    expect(w.raid.active.x).toBe(9);
  });
  it('lights a blaze through the fire system at each strike and follows it', () => {
    const { w, store } = city();
    arriveNow(w, 3);
    runRaid(w, 23);
    const a = w.raid.active;
    expect(a.struck).toEqual([store.id]);
    expect(a.fires.map((f) => f.id)).toEqual(store.fire ? [store.id] : []);           // igniteBuilding is Track A's: a stub lights nothing
  });
  it('counts the buildings its fires burn down, by kind, during the raid and after it ends', () => {
    const { w, store } = city();
    const temple = addRaw(w, 'temple', 14, 20);
    arriveNow(w, 3);
    const a = w.raid.active;
    store.fire = { stage: 'fire', days: 4, left: 3 };                                  // as Track A's blaze would be by now
    temple.fire = { stage: 'blaze', days: 1, need: 2, fought: 0 };
    a.fires.push({ id: store.id, type: 'storehouse' }, { id: temple.id, type: 'temple' });
    removeBuilding(w, store.id);                                                      // what burnBuilding does, on this day
    w.danger.burnDays.push(1001);
    runRaid(w, 1);
    expect([a.burned, a.burnedKinds, a.fires]).toEqual([1, ['storehouse'], [{ id: temple.id, type: 'temple' }]]);
    a.raiders = [];                                                                   // the raid ends with the temple still burning
    runRaid(w, 1);
    expect([w.raid.last.burned, w.raid.last.fires.length]).toEqual([1, 1]);
    removeBuilding(w, temple.id);
    w.danger.burnDays.push(w.day + 1);
    w.day += 1;
    raidDay(w, []);
    expect([w.raid.last.burned, w.raid.last.burnedKinds, w.raid.last.fires]).toEqual([2, ['storehouse', 'temple'], []]);
  });
  it('counts a struck building the real fire burns down (once Track A has merged; the stub lights nothing)', () => {
    const { w, store } = city();
    arriveNow(w, 3);
    runRaid(w, 23);
    if (!store.fire) return;                                                          // before Track A: nothing to follow
    for (let k = 0; k < 60 && w.buildings[store.id]; k++) { w.day += 1; fireDay(w, []); raidDay(w, []); }
    expect(store.id in w.buildings).toBe(false);                                      // no firehouse: the blaze grew and burned it down
    const rec = w.raid.active || w.raid.last;
    expect([rec.burned, rec.burnedKinds, rec.fires]).toEqual([1, ['storehouse'], []]);
  });
});

describe('s3 raids defence', () => {
  it('one staffed tower beats the first raid; without it the raid is lost', () => {
    const lost = city();
    arriveNow(lost.w, RAIDS.firstSize);
    expect(ended(runRaid(lost.w)).won).toBe(false);
    const { w, store } = city();
    const tower = addRaw(w, 'tower', 20, 18);
    staffAll(w);
    arriveNow(w, RAIDS.firstSize);
    const events = runRaid(w);
    const end = ended(events);
    expect(end.won).toBe(true);
    expect(strikes(events)).toEqual([]);
    expect(store.id in w.buildings).toBe(true);
    expect([end.report.towers, end.report.byTowers, end.report.bySoldiers]).toEqual([1, 3, 0]);   // two fell, the third as it ran
    expect([w.tally.raidsBeaten, w.tally.raidersByTowers, w.raid.adaptation]).toEqual([1, end.report.byTowers, 1]);
    expect(raidMood(w)).toEqual({ raid: DANGER_MOOD.raidBeaten });
    expect(tower.id in w.buildings).toBe(true);
  });
  it('turns back once half the raiders (rounded up) have fallen, and the towers keep shooting as they go', () => {
    const { w } = city();
    addRaw(w, 'tower', 20, 18);
    staffAll(w);
    arriveNow(w, 5, { first: false });
    const a = w.raid.active;
    let turned = null;
    for (let k = 0; k < 200 && w.raid.active; k++) {
      w.day += 1;
      raidDay(w, []);
      if (w.raid.active && w.raid.active.phase === 'retreat' && turned === null) turned = 5 - a.raiders.length;
    }
    expect(turned).toBe(Math.ceil(5 * RAIDS.retreatShare));
    expect(w.raid.last.won).toBe(true);
    expect(w.raid.last.byTowers).toBeGreaterThan(turned - 1);
  });
  it('keeps raiders out with a closed ring until they breach it, hits them at the breach from a tower on the ring', () => {
    const { w, store } = city();
    // A ring round the storehouse: x 4..9, y 13..18 (a gate where the road at y = 13 crosses).
    drawWall(w, 4, 13, 9, 18);
    drawWall(w, 4, 13, 9, 18, true);
    expect(w.wall[idx(w.size, 9, 13)]).toBe(DEFENCE.gateHp);
    const shape = w.wallVersion;
    arriveNow(w, 3);
    let firstBlocked = null;
    for (let k = 0; k < 200 && w.raid.active; k++) {
      w.day += 1;
      raidDay(w, []);
      const a = w.raid.active;
      if (!a) break;
      if (a.blocked !== null && firstBlocked === null) firstBlocked = { tile: a.blocked, day: w.day, x: a.x };
      if (a.phase === 'strike') break;
    }
    expect(firstBlocked.x).toBe(10);                                                  // stopped outside the east side of the ring
    expect(w.wall[firstBlocked.tile]).toBe(-1);                                       // and broke through it
    expect(w.wallVersion).toBe(shape + 1);
    expect(w.raid.active.struck).toEqual([store.id]);
    const breachDays = Math.ceil(DEFENCE.wallHp / (3 * UNITS.raider.damage));
    expect(w.raid.active.day + 21 + breachDays).toBeLessThan(w.day + 1);
    // The same raid against the same ring with a staffed tower on it beside the cheapest tile: beaten at the wall.
    const t = city();
    drawWall(t.w, 4, 13, 9, 18);
    drawWall(t.w, 4, 13, 9, 18, true);
    addRaw(t.w, 'tower', 9, 18);
    staffAll(t.w);
    arriveNow(t.w, 3);
    const events = runRaid(t.w);
    expect(ended(events).won).toBe(true);
    expect(strikes(events)).toEqual([]);
    expect(t.w.raid.last.byTowers).toBeGreaterThan(1);
    expect(t.w.raid.last.towers).toBe(1);
  });
  it('brings down a tower standing on a wall tile when raiders break that tile', () => {
    const { w } = city();
    drawWall(w, 20, 15, 20, 17);
    const tower = addRaw(w, 'tower', 20, 16);
    arriveNow(w, 3);
    const a = w.raid.active;
    const tile = idx(w.size, 20, 16);
    expect(w.wall[tile]).toBe(DEFENCE.towerOnWallHp);
    w.wall[tile] = 2;                                                                 // nearly broken
    a.blocked = tile;
    const shape = w.wallVersion;
    runRaid(w, 1);
    expect([w.wall[tile], w.wallVersion, tower.id in w.buildings, w.occ[tile]]).toEqual([-1, shape + 1, false, 0]);
  });
  it('breaks a gate as wall, while the road through it still carries reach', () => {
    const { w } = city();
    drawWall(w, 10, 0, 10, 31);                                                       // a wall across the map, a gate at (10, 13)
    w.wall[idx(w.size, 10, 13)] = 2;                                                  // the gate is weakest: the band goes for it
    arriveNow(w, 3);
    w.wall[idx(w.size, 10, 13)] = 2;
    let blocked = null;
    for (let k = 0; k < 60 && w.raid.active && blocked === null; k++) {
      w.day += 1;
      raidDay(w, []);
      if (w.raid.active && w.raid.active.blocked !== null) blocked = w.raid.active.blocked;
    }
    expect(blocked).toBe(idx(w.size, 10, 13));
    expect(w.road[blocked]).toBe(1);
  });
  it('sends soldiers out to raiders within their patrol, has them fight, and walks them back after', () => {
    const { w } = city();
    const barracks = addRaw(w, 'barracks', 14, 14);
    const far = addRaw(w, 'barracks', 14, 26);
    staffAll(w);
    for (const b of [barracks, barracks, far]) w.soldiers.push({ id: w.nextUnitId++, barracks: b.id, x: b.x + 1, y: b.y + 1, hp: UNITS.soldier.hp, hit: false, task: 'wait' });
    arriveNow(w, 3);
    const events = runRaid(w);
    const end = ended(events);
    expect(end.won).toBe(true);
    expect(end.report.bySoldiers).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(w.tally.raidersBySoldiers).toBe(end.report.bySoldiers);
    const mine = w.soldiers.filter((s) => s.barracks === barracks.id);
    expect(mine.length + w.tally.soldiersWounded).toBe(2);
    expect(mine.some((s) => s.hit)).toBe(true);
    const idle = w.soldiers.find((s) => s.barracks === far.id);
    expect([idle.task, idle.x, idle.y]).toEqual(['wait', far.x + 1, far.y + 1]);    // 12 tiles away: outside its patrol
    for (let k = 0; k < 20; k++) { w.day += 1; raidDay(w, []); }
    expect(mine.every((s) => s.task === 'wait' && s.x === barracks.x + 1 && s.y === barracks.y + 1)).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('s3 raids soldiers', () => {
  it('trains one soldier per 30 days at full staff, slower when short, none below 25%, up to 4, and replaces the wounded', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    const b = addRaw(w, 'barracks', 4, 4);
    b.staff = 6;
    for (let d = 0; d < DEFENCE.trainDays - 1; d++) trainSoldiers(w);
    expect(w.soldiers.length).toBe(0);
    trainSoldiers(w);
    expect(w.soldiers).toEqual([{ id: 1, barracks: b.id, x: 5, y: 5, hp: UNITS.soldier.hp, hit: false, task: 'wait' }]);
    for (let d = 0; d < 5 * DEFENCE.trainDays; d++) trainSoldiers(w);
    expect(w.soldiers.length).toBe(DEFENCE.soldiersPerBarracks);
    expect(b.progress).toBe(0);
    expect(soldiersPayOf(w)).toBe(DEFENCE.soldiersPerBarracks * DEFENCE.soldierPay);
    w.soldiers.pop();
    b.staff = 5;                                                                       // 5 of 6: 36 days
    for (let d = 0; d < 35; d++) trainSoldiers(w);
    expect(w.soldiers.length).toBe(3);
    trainSoldiers(w);
    expect(w.soldiers.length).toBe(4);
    w.soldiers.pop();
    b.staff = 1;                                                                       // under 25%: no training
    for (let d = 0; d < 200; d++) trainSoldiers(w);
    expect(w.soldiers.length).toBe(3);
    b.staff = 6; b.paused = true;
    for (let d = 0; d < 200; d++) trainSoldiers(w);
    expect(w.soldiers.length).toBe(3);
    removeBuilding(w, b.id);                                                           // the barracks is gone: its soldiers leave service
    trainSoldiers(w);
    expect(w.soldiers).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('trains on Peaceful too, where no raid ever comes', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld({ raiderEntries: [EAST] });
    w.difficulty = 'peaceful';
    w.tally.peakPeople = 1000;
    const b = addRaw(w, 'barracks', 4, 4);
    b.staff = 6;
    for (let d = 0; d < 3000; d++) { w.day = d; raidDay(w, []); }
    expect([w.soldiers.length, w.raid.clockDay, w.raid.warning, w.raid.active]).toEqual([4, null, null, null]);
  });
});

describe('s3 raids determinism', () => {
  // A small raided town through tickDay: people, a storehouse, a tower and a barracks, the clock started long ago.
  function town() {
    const w = makeTestWorld({ gold: 3000, raiderEntries: [EAST, { x: 16, y: 0 }] });
    setRoad(w, 0, 13, 31, 13);
    setRoad(w, 16, 0, 16, 31);
    w.milestone = 'market_town';
    for (let x = 0; x < 12; x += 2) addRaw(w, 'house', x, 14, { tier: 4, residents: 40 });
    addRaw(w, 'storehouse', 18, 14);
    addRaw(w, 'tower', 22, 12);
    addRaw(w, 'barracks', 12, 11);
    drawWall(w, 26, 10, 26, 20);
    Object.assign(w.raid, { clockDay: 0, nextWarnDay: 30, index: 1 });
    return w;
  }
  it('gives the same world for the same seed and days, and the same again when saved and loaded mid-raid', () => {
    const a = town(), b = town();
    let day = 0;
    while (!(a.raid.active && a.raid.active.raiders.length && a.raid.active.x < 26) && day < 400) { tickDay(a); tickDay(b); day++; }
    expect(Boolean(a.raid.active)).toBe(true);
    expect(serialize(a)).toBe(serialize(b));
    const c = deserialize(serialize(a));
    for (let d = 0; d < 60; d++) { tickDay(a); tickDay(c); }
    expect(serialize(c)).toBe(serialize(a));
  });
});
```

```js
  w.day = 1000;
  raidDay(w, []);
  for (let k = 0; k < 200 && w.raid.active; k++) { w.day += 1; raidDay(w, []); }

}
```

Replace the whole of `src/sim/combat.js` with:

```js
// Combat and soldiers (spec 4.13). Stage 3 contract: Track B implements the STUBs; raidDay (raids.js) calls them.
//
// world.soldiers: one entry per trained soldier, ascending id: { id, barracks, x, y, hp, hit, task }
//   barracks: the id of the barracks that trained it; x, y: tile coordinates (may be fractional); hp: UNITS.soldier.hp
//   down to 1 (a soldier at 0 is wounded and leaves the list); hit: hurt at least once; task: 'wait' | 'out' | 'back'.
// A barracks keeps its training progress in its own b.progress (days of training at full staff towards
// DEFENCE.trainDays). Raiders live in world.raid.active.raiders.
//
// Distances are straight lines between points in tile coordinates (a building's point is its footprint's centre, a
// unit's its x, y). "Beside" is within BESIDE (one tile). Soldiers walk straight towards their raider or their barracks,
// over walls and buildings (they are the city's own; only raiders are kept out). A soldier whose barracks is gone
// (burned or demolished) leaves service. A tower on a wall tile falls when raiders break that tile (the tile becomes a
// breach, the tower is removed with no rubble). Each fallen raider is counted once, for whatever hit it last: a tower
// (raid.active.byTowers, tally.raidersByTowers) or a soldier (bySoldiers, raidersBySoldiers).
// Fields Track B adds to raid.active (raids.js): blocked (the tile index of the standing wall in the band's way, or
// null) and towerIds (the towers that have shot during this raid, for the report's tower count).
import { UNITS, DEFENCE } from '../data/raids.js';
import { allBuildings, removeBuilding } from './world.js';
import { isWorking, staffRatio } from './labour.js';

export const BESIDE = 1;

const centre = (b) => ({ x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.d / 2 });
const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
const alive = (u) => u.hp > 0;

function nearest(from, list) {
  let best = null, bd = Infinity;
  for (const u of list) {
    const d = dist(from, u);
    if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = u; }
  }
  return best;
}

// Moves a unit up to `by` tiles straight towards a point, stopping `short` of it.
function stepTowards(u, to, by, short = 0) {
  const d = dist(u, to);
  const move = Math.min(by, d - short);
  if (move <= 0) return;
  u.x += ((to.x - u.x) * move) / d;
  u.y += ((to.y - u.y) * move) / d;
}

// The point a soldier waits at: its barracks' centre (or where it stands, if the barracks has just gone).
function homeOf(world, s) {
  const b = world.buildings[s.barracks];
  return b ? centre(b) : { x: s.x, y: s.y };
}

function walkHome(world, s) {
  const home = homeOf(world, s);
  stepTowards(s, home, UNITS.soldier.speed);
  if (dist(s, home) < 1e-6) { s.x = home.x; s.y = home.y; s.task = 'wait'; }
  else s.task = 'back';
}

// Soldiers with no raid to fight walk back to their barracks and wait there (raids.js, every day without a raid).
export function soldiersHome(world) {
  for (const s of world.soldiers) if (s.task !== 'wait') walkHome(world, s);
}

// Trains soldiers for the day: each barracks at 25% staff or more (isWorking) adds its staffing ratio to b.progress
// and, at DEFENCE.trainDays, trains one soldier (up to DEFENCE.soldiersPerBarracks of its own), placed at the barracks'
// centre, waiting. A full barracks gathers no progress; a wounded soldier's place is trained again. Soldiers of a
// barracks that no longer stands leave service first.
export function trainSoldiers(world, events = null) {
  if (world.soldiers.some((s) => !world.buildings[s.barracks] || world.buildings[s.barracks].type !== 'barracks')) {
    world.soldiers = world.soldiers.filter((s) => world.buildings[s.barracks] && world.buildings[s.barracks].type === 'barracks');
  }
  for (const b of allBuildings(world)) {
    if (b.type !== 'barracks') continue;
    if (world.soldiers.filter((s) => s.barracks === b.id).length >= DEFENCE.soldiersPerBarracks || !isWorking(world, b)) continue;
    b.progress += staffRatio(world, b);
    if (b.progress < DEFENCE.trainDays - 1e-9) continue;   // 5/6 staffing adds up in floating point
    b.progress = 0;
    const c = centre(b);
    world.soldiers.push({ id: world.nextUnitId++, barracks: b.id, x: c.x, y: c.y, hp: UNITS.soldier.hp, hit: false, task: 'wait' });
  }
}

// A raider's blows break a standing wall tile: it becomes a breach (wallVersion goes up) and a tower on it falls.
function breakTile(world, i) {
  world.wall[i] = -1;
  world.wallVersion++;
  const id = world.occ[i];
  if (id && world.buildings[id] && world.buildings[id].type === 'tower') removeBuilding(world, id);
}

// One day of fighting while a raid is under way (spec 4.13), in this order:
//   towers: each working tower deals DEFENCE.towerDamage x its staffing ratio to the nearest raider within
//     DEFENCE.towerRange of its centre, and the shot is kept in raid.active.shots ({ from, to } points) for the arrows;
//   soldiers: each soldier with a raider within DEFENCE.patrol of its barracks' centre goes out ('out') to the nearest
//     one: beside it, it deals UNITS.soldier.damage; else it walks up to UNITS.soldier.speed tiles towards it. With none
//     in its patrol it walks home;
//   raiders: each raider beside a soldier deals UNITS.raider.damage to the nearest; otherwise, while the band is
//     blocked by a standing wall tile (active.blocked), it deals that to the tile, which breaks at 0.
// Then wounded soldiers leave service (tally.soldiersWounded) and fallen raiders leave the band (byTowers, bySoldiers and
// their tallies). Returns { fighting }: whether a raider and a soldier traded blows today (the band then waits).
export function combatDay(world, events = null) {
  const a = world.raid.active;
  if (!a) return { fighting: false };
  if (!a.towerIds) a.towerIds = [];
  a.shots = [];
  const killer = new Map();   // raider id -> 'tower' | 'soldier', set as it falls
  const hurt = (r, dmg, by) => {
    r.hp -= dmg;
    r.hit = true;
    if (r.hp <= 0 && !killer.has(r.id)) killer.set(r.id, by);
  };
  for (const t of allBuildings(world)) {
    if (t.type !== 'tower' || !isWorking(world, t)) continue;
    const c = centre(t);
    const foe = nearest(c, a.raiders.filter((r) => alive(r) && dist(c, r) <= DEFENCE.towerRange));
    if (!foe) continue;
    hurt(foe, DEFENCE.towerDamage * staffRatio(world, t), 'tower');
    a.shots.push({ from: c, to: { x: foe.x, y: foe.y } });
    if (!a.towerIds.includes(t.id)) a.towerIds.push(t.id);
  }
  let fighting = false;
  for (const s of world.soldiers) {
    const home = homeOf(world, s);
    const foe = nearest(s, a.raiders.filter((r) => alive(r) && dist(home, r) <= DEFENCE.patrol));
    if (!foe) { if (s.task !== 'wait') walkHome(world, s); continue; }
    s.task = 'out';
    if (dist(s, foe) <= BESIDE) { hurt(foe, UNITS.soldier.damage, 'soldier'); fighting = true; }
    else stepTowards(s, foe, UNITS.soldier.speed, 0.8);
  }
  for (const r of a.raiders) {
    if (!alive(r)) continue;
    const foe = nearest(r, world.soldiers.filter((s) => alive(s) && dist(r, s) <= BESIDE));
    if (foe) {
      foe.hp -= UNITS.raider.damage;
      foe.hit = true;
      fighting = true;
    } else if (a.blocked !== null && a.blocked !== undefined && world.wall[a.blocked] > 0) {
      world.wall[a.blocked] = Math.max(0, world.wall[a.blocked] - UNITS.raider.damage);
      if (world.wall[a.blocked] === 0) breakTile(world, a.blocked);
    }
  }
  const wounded = world.soldiers.filter((s) => !alive(s)).length;
  if (wounded) {
    world.soldiers = world.soldiers.filter(alive);
    world.tally.soldiersWounded += wounded;
  }
  for (const r of a.raiders) {
    if (alive(r)) continue;
    if (killer.get(r.id) === 'tower') { a.byTowers++; world.tally.raidersByTowers++; }
    else { a.bySoldiers++; world.tally.raidersBySoldiers++; }
  }
  a.raiders = a.raiders.filter(alive);
  return { fighting };
}
```

```js
// beaten in retreat. A target is the nearest (straight line from the band) unstruck building of the warned kind, else of
```

```js
// The day's raid step (spec 4.3, 4.13), run by tickDay after fireDay; world.day is the day being simulated. Never on
// Peaceful (raidsOn). The clock starts the first day the city has RAIDS.clockPeople people (its peak counts: a city that
// had them keeps its clock), and the first warning comes RAIDS.firstWarnAfter days later; a warning is raised on
// nextWarnDay when none is up and no raid is under way.
export function raidDay(world, events = null) {
  if (!raidsOn(world)) return;
  const r = world.raid, day = world.day;
  if (r.clockDay === null && Math.max(world.tally.peakPeople, population(world)) >= RAIDS.clockPeople) {
    r.clockDay = day;
    r.nextWarnDay = day + RAIDS.firstWarnAfter;
  }
  if (!r.warning && !r.active && r.nextWarnDay !== null && day >= r.nextWarnDay) raiseWarning(world, events);
}
```

with

```js
// The day's raid step (spec 4.3, 4.13), run by tickDay after fireDay; world.day is the day being simulated. Barracks
// train every day on every level (combat.js). The rest never runs on Peaceful (raidsOn): the clock starts the first day
// the city has RAIDS.clockPeople people (its peak counts: a city that had them keeps its clock), and the first warning
// comes RAIDS.firstWarnAfter days later; a warning is raised on nextWarnDay when none is up and no raid is under way,
// and its raiders arrive on its arrives day. A raid under way has its day (raidStep); soldiers with none walk home.
export function raidDay(world, events = null) {
  trainSoldiers(world, events);
  const r = world.raid, day = world.day;
  if (raidsOn(world) && r.clockDay === null && Math.max(world.tally.peakPeople, population(world)) >= RAIDS.clockPeople) {
    r.clockDay = day;
    r.nextWarnDay = day + RAIDS.firstWarnAfter;
  }
  trackFires(world, r.active);
  trackFires(world, r.last);
  if (r.active) return raidStep(world, events);
  soldiersHome(world);
  if (!raidsOn(world)) return;
  if (r.warning) { if (day >= r.warning.arrives) arrive(world, events); }
  else if (r.nextWarnDay !== null && day >= r.nextWarnDay) raiseWarning(world, events);
}
```

with

```js
// Where each raider stands in the band's tile, by its id: the centre and eleven spots around it.
const SLOTS = [[0, 0], [0.25, 0.2], [-0.25, 0.2], [0.25, -0.2], [-0.25, -0.2], [0, 0.32], [0, -0.32], [0.32, 0], [-0.32, 0], [0.16, 0.34], [-0.16, -0.34], [0.34, -0.16]];
function placeBand(a) {
  for (const u of a.raiders) {
    const [dx, dy] = SLOTS[u.id % SLOTS.length];
    u.x = a.x + 0.5 + dx;
    u.y = a.y + 0.5 + dy;
  }
}

// The raiders arrive at the warned entry (spec 4.13): the warning becomes the raid under way, every standing wall tile
// is at its full hit points (a tower on a wall tile at DEFENCE.towerOnWallHp), tally.raids counts it, 2x or 3x drops to
// 1x, and raid_start is pushed. They make their first move the next day.
function arrive(world, events) {
  const r = world.raid, w = r.warning;
  const raiders = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < w.size; k++) raiders.push({ id: world.nextUnitId++, x: 0, y: 0, hp: UNITS.raider.hp, hit: false });
  const a = {
    index: w.index, entry: { ...w.entry }, dir: w.dir, size: w.size, target: w.target, day: world.day, raiders, phase: 'attack', targetId: null,
    struck: [], wait: 0, byTowers: 0, bySoldiers: 0, burned: 0, stolen: 0, shots: [], x: w.entry.x, y: w.entry.y, blocked: null, towerIds: [], fires: [], burnedKinds: [],
  };
  placeBand(a);
  r.active = a;
  r.warning = null;
  world.tally.raids += 1;
  healWalls(world);
  if (world.speed > 1) setSpeed(world, 1);
  if (events) events.push({ type: 'raid_start', index: a.index, dir: a.dir, size: a.size });
}

// The tiles next to a building that a raider could stand on: its strike goals.
function ringGoals(world, b) {
  return ring(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.d).filter(([x, y]) => inBounds(world.size, x, y) && tileCost(world, x, y) !== Infinity);
}

// The building the band goes for next, or null (see the header): the warned kind first, then each kind below it, then
// any building but a home or rubble; nearest first, ties to the lower id; one it can reach.
function pickTarget(world, a) {
  const at = idx(world.size, a.x, a.y), here = { x: a.x + 0.5, y: a.y + 0.5 };
  const kinds = RAIDS.targets.includes(a.target) ? RAIDS.targets.slice(RAIDS.targets.indexOf(a.target)) : [];
  const groups = [...kinds.map((k) => (b) => b.type === k), (b) => b.type !== 'house' && b.type !== 'rubble'];
  for (const match of groups) {
    const near = allBuildings(world).filter((b) => match(b) && !a.struck.includes(b.id))
      .map((b) => ({ b, d: Math.hypot(b.x + b.w / 2 - here.x, b.y + b.d / 2 - here.y) }))
      .sort((p, q) => p.d - q.d || p.b.id - q.b.id);
    for (const { b } of near) if (flowField(world, ringGoals(world, b)).dist[at] !== Infinity) return b;
  }
  return null;
}

// A strike (spec 4.13): a blaze through the fire system (Track A's igniteBuilding; the building is followed while it
// burns, see trackFires), and each raider steals RAIDS.stealShare of the treasury, at least RAIDS.stealMin and at most
// RAIDS.stealMax, never taking it below 0. The band stays RAIDS.strikeDays days, this one included.
function strike(world, a, b, events) {
  if (igniteBuilding(world, b.id, events, 'raid')) a.fires.push({ id: b.id, type: b.type });
  let stolen = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < a.raiders.length; k++) {
    const take = Math.min(Math.max(0, world.gold), Math.max(RAIDS.stealMin, Math.min(RAIDS.stealMax, Math.round(world.gold * RAIDS.stealShare))));
    world.gold -= take;
    stolen += take;
  }
  a.stolen += stolen;
  world.tally.goldStolen += stolen;
  a.struck.push(b.id);
  a.targetId = b.id;
  a.phase = 'strike';
  a.wait = RAIDS.strikeDays;
  if (events) events.push({ type: 'raid_strike', id: b.id, stolen });
}

// Follows the raid's fires (active.fires, then the report's): one put out is dropped; one whose building is gone on a
// day a building burned down (danger.burnDays, written by fire.js) counts as burned, with its type.
function trackFires(world, rec) {
  if (!rec || !rec.fires || !rec.fires.length) return;
  const burnDays = world.danger.burnDays;
  rec.fires = rec.fires.filter((f) => {
    const b = world.buildings[f.id];
    if (b) return Boolean(b.fire);
    if (burnDays.length && burnDays[burnDays.length - 1] === world.day) { rec.burned += 1; rec.burnedKinds.push(f.type); }
    return false;
  });
}

// The raid is over (spec 4.13): no raider is left on the map. Beaten (won) when the raiders retreated or all fell, lost
// when the band left after its strikes. The report becomes raid.last; the tallies, the adaptation (a lost raid sets
// RAIDS.adaptLost, any other adds RAIDS.adaptStep up to 1) and the next warning (laterWarnDay after the arrival day)
// follow; hit wall tiles heal; soldiers out walk back.
function endRaid(world, events, won) {
  const r = world.raid, a = r.active;
  const report = {
    index: a.index, dir: a.dir, size: a.size, won, byTowers: a.byTowers, bySoldiers: a.bySoldiers, towers: a.towerIds.length, burned: a.burned,
    stolen: a.stolen, day: world.day, burnedKinds: a.burnedKinds.slice(), fires: a.fires.map((f) => ({ ...f })),
  };
  r.active = null;
  r.last = report;
  world.tally[won ? 'raidsBeaten' : 'raidsLost'] += 1;
  r.adaptation = won ? Math.min(1, r.adaptation + RAIDS.adaptStep) : RAIDS.adaptLost;
  r.nextWarnDay = laterWarnDay(world, a.day);
  healWalls(world);
  for (const s of world.soldiers) if (s.task === 'out') s.task = 'back';
  if (events) events.push({ type: 'raid_end', won, report: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(report)) });
}

// One day of the raid under way (see the header).
function raidStep(world, events) {
  const a = world.raid.active;
  if (!Number.isInteger(a.x)) Object.assign(a, bandCentre(a));      // a raid set up in the contract's shape alone
  if (a.blocked === undefined) a.blocked = null;
  if (!a.towerIds) a.towerIds = [];
  if (!a.fires) a.fires = [];
  if (!a.burnedKinds) a.burnedKinds = [];
  const { fighting } = combatDay(world, events);
  if (!a.raiders.length) return endRaid(world, events, true);
  if (a.phase !== 'retreat' && a.size - a.raiders.length >= Math.ceil(a.size * RAIDS.retreatShare)) {
    a.phase = 'retreat';
    a.targetId = null;
    a.wait = 0;
  }
  if (fighting) return;
  if (a.phase === 'strike') {
    a.wait -= 1;
    if (a.wait > 0) return;
    a.phase = a.struck.length >= RAIDS.strikes ? 'leave' : 'attack';
    a.targetId = null;
  }
  for (let step = 0; step < UNITS.raider.speed; step++) {
    let goals;
    if (a.phase === 'attack') {
      let t = a.targetId ? world.buildings[a.targetId] : null;
      if (!t || flowField(world, ringGoals(world, t)).dist[idx(world.size, a.x, a.y)] === Infinity) t = pickTarget(world, a);
      if (t) { a.targetId = t.id; goals = ringGoals(world, t); }
      else { a.phase = 'leave'; a.targetId = null; }
    }
    if (a.phase !== 'attack') goals = [[a.entry.x, a.entry.y]];
    const field = flowField(world, goals);
    const here = idx(world.size, a.x, a.y);
    if (field.dist[here] === 0 || field.dist[here] === Infinity) return reach(world, a, events);
    const [nx, ny] = field.next(a.x, a.y);
    const ni = idx(world.size, nx, ny);
    if (world.wall[ni] > 0) { a.blocked = ni; return; }
    a.blocked = null;
    a.x = nx;
    a.y = ny;
    placeBand(a);
    if (field.dist[ni] === 0) return reach(world, a, events);
  }
}

// The band is at its goal: its target (a strike), or its entry (it leaves the map and the raid ends). A band that can
// no longer reach its entry slips away at once.
function reach(world, a, events) {
  if (a.phase === 'attack') return strike(world, a, world.buildings[a.targetId], events);
  const won = a.phase === 'retreat';
  a.raiders = [];
  return endRaid(world, events, won);
}

// The raid mood term (spec 4.9, DANGER_MOOD): { raid: raidBeaten or raidLost } for raidDays after the last raid ended,
// by its outcome; {} otherwise (and for a raid paid off, which leaves no report).
export function raidMood(world) {
  const last = world.raid.last;
  if (!last || world.day - last.day >= DANGER_MOOD.raidDays) return {};
  return { raid: last.won ? DANGER_MOOD.raidBeaten : DANGER_MOOD.raidLost };
}
```

In `src/ui/text.js`, in Track B's section, insert just above the line `// ── end s3 raids ───…` (after the `Object.assign(REASONS, { … });` block):

```js
// The raid report (spec 4.13), as a caption at raid_end and a line in the summary, from raid.last's numbers: towers is
// how many towers shot, byTowers and bySoldiers the raiders each stopped, burned the buildings the raid's fires burned
// down (one is named by its kind), fires those still burning (the report keeps counting as they burn out), stolen the
// gold taken.
//   Beaten: "Raid from the east beaten: 2 towers stopped 9 of 12, soldiers stopped 3; 1 storehouse burned, 40 gold stolen."
//   Lost:   "Raid from the east: raiders burned 3 buildings and took 120 gold. Towers stopped 1 of 6."
const raidBurnedWords = (r) => (r.burned === 1 && r.burnedKinds && r.burnedKinds[0] ? `1 ${buildingName(r.burnedKinds[0]).toLowerCase()}` : plural(r.burned, 'building', 'buildings'));
RAID_TEXT.report = (r) => {
  const from = `Raid from the ${RAID_TEXT.dirs[r.dir]}`;
  const burning = r.fires ? r.fires.length : 0;
  if (r.won) {
    const stopped = [];
    if (r.byTowers) stopped.push(`${plural(r.towers, 'tower', 'towers')} stopped ${r.byTowers} of ${r.size}`);
    if (r.bySoldiers) stopped.push(`soldiers stopped ${r.bySoldiers}`);
    const lost = [];
    if (r.burned) lost.push(`${raidBurnedWords(r)} burned`);
    if (burning) lost.push(`${plural(burning, 'building', 'buildings')} on fire`);
    if (r.stolen) lost.push(`${r.stolen} gold stolen`);
    return `${from} beaten: ${stopped.join(', ') || 'the raiders turned back'}; ${lost.length ? lost.join(', ') : 'nothing lost'}.`;
  }
  const did = [];
  if (r.burned) did.push(`burned ${raidBurnedWords(r)}`);
  if (burning) did.push(`set ${plural(burning, 'building', 'buildings')} on fire`);
  if (r.stolen) did.push(`took ${r.stolen} gold`);
  const stopped = [];
  if (r.byTowers) stopped.push(`towers stopped ${r.byTowers} of ${r.size}`);
  if (r.bySoldiers) stopped.push(`soldiers stopped ${r.bySoldiers}`);
  const defence = stopped.length ? ` ${stopped.join(', ').replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase())}.` : '';
  return `${from}: raiders ${did.length ? listText(did) : 'left with nothing'}.${defence}`;
};
```

# Track C: art and render

CONTRACT NOTE: Swaying palms and acacias (spec 5.6: "swaying trees are drawn in the depth-sorted pass") cannot be done from Track C's files. The renderer draws a tree as the cached sprite of the slot `decorAt` names ('palm' or 'acacia'), and renderer.js and createUI.js are the contract's, so no hook lets ambient life change a tree's sprite per frame. Track C delivers everything but the wiring: lean slots `palm.l-4` ... `palm.l4` and `acacia.l-4` ... `acacia.l4` (art/nature.js, half a degree a step) and `ambient.treeSlot(world, x, y, slot, now)` (out of step by tile, the still slot while ambient motion is off or sway is dropped), both tested in Task C4. Until the controller adds the seam, trees stand still and the reeds and crops carry the sway. The seam is two lines. In `src/render/renderer.js`, in the depth-sorted sprite loop, replace `const sprite = spriteCache.get(o.slot, zoom, dpr);` with `const slot = opts.treeSlot && o.id >= 1e6 && o.id < 2e6 ? opts.treeSlot(o) : o.slot;   // Stage 3: ambient sway (render/ambient.js)` followed by `const sprite = spriteCache.get(slot, zoom, dpr);`. In `src/ui/createUI.js`, in the `renderer.renderFrame` options beside `ambient:`, add `treeSlot: (o) => ambient.treeSlot(world, o.x, o.y, o.slot, t),`. Shadows are unaffected (a lean slot keeps its tree's empty `shadows`).

CONTRACT NOTE: The contract gives ambient life one hook, `opts.ambient`, called under the sprites; but smoke from kilns and chimneys, crop bands on fields, glints on garden and villa pools and a bird crossing must show over buildings. Resolved inside Track C: `ambient.draw` draws the ground layer (river glints, bank ripples, reed tips, the felucca and ducks) and leaves the rest as a late layer that `drawFires` (render/fire.js, `opts.fire`, the first hook after the sprites) draws first, through `drawAmbientLate(g)`, matched to its frame by the frame's draw object (a WeakMap), so it runs in the same frame or not at all. Anyone who reorders the renderer's hooks must keep `opts.fire` after the sprites.

CONTRACT NOTE: `createUI` notes input for the frame gate on `pointerdown`, `keydown` and `wheel` only, so a slow pan or pinch that lasts more than 2 s while the game is paused drops to 30 fps part-way (spec 5.6 caps only "no input for 2 s"). Not resolved in Track C (createUI.js is the contract's): adding `'pointermove'` to `INPUTS` in `src/ui/createUI.js` fixes it, at the cost of one call per move event.

## Track C: art and render, ambient life included

Track C draws Stage 3: the firehouse, rubble, the tower, the barracks and the wall pieces (C1); walls on the map and flames (C2); raiders, soldiers, health bars, arrows and the firehouse walker (C3); and ambient life with the idle frame-rate cap (C4). It changes no sim behaviour and no world field: everything it draws is read from the contract's state (`b.fire`, `world.wall`, `world.raid.active`, `world.soldiers`) and its own caches live outside the world (WeakMaps keyed by the world, or by the frame's draw object).

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { makeDraw } from '../../../src/render/art/ctx.js';
import { ART, slotFor } from '../../../src/render/art/registry.js';
import { RUBBLE_VARIANTS, FIREHOUSE_EMBLEM, DEFENCE_EMBLEM } from '../../../src/render/art/defence.js';
import { BUILDINGS } from '../../../src/data/buildings.js';
import { CATEGORY_TINT } from '../../../src/data/ui.js';
import { RED, TEAL, GOLD, TERRAIN } from '../../../src/render/art/palette.js';
import { makeCanvas, canvasHash, nearColour } from '../../helpers/canvas.js';

const SCALE = 3;
// A slot drawn alone, its footprint origin placed so the whole of its bounds fits the canvas.
function drawSlot(slot) {
  const def = ART[slot];
  const [l, t, r, b] = def.bounds;
  const c = makeCanvas(Math.ceil((r - l) * SCALE), Math.ceil((b - t) * SCALE));
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.translate(-l * SCALE, -t * SCALE);
  def.draw(makeDraw(ctx, SCALE), 0, 0);
  return c;
}
// Solid pixels that pass test([r, g, b]).
function count(c, test = () => true) {
  const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data;
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i + 3] > 200 && test([d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]])) n++;
  return n;
}
// The highest inked row, in art px above the footprint origin's ground point (p(0, 0) is the back corner).
function inkTop(slot) {
  const c = drawSlot(slot), [, t] = ART[slot].bounds;
  const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data;
  for (let y = 0; y < c.height; y++) for (let x = 0; x < c.width; x++) if (d[(y * c.width + x) * 4 + 3] > 40) return y / SCALE + t;
  return null;
}

describe('s3 art buildings', () => {
  it('draws the firehouse, tower, barracks and rubble on their real footprints, each a picture of its own', () => {
    const hashes = new Set();
    for (const type of ['firehouse', 'tower', 'barracks', 'rubble', 'wall', 'gate']) {
      const def = ART[type];
      if (!BUILDINGS[type].tile) expect([type, def.w, def.d]).toEqual([type, BUILDINGS[type].w, BUILDINGS[type].d]);
      expect([type, typeof def.draw, def.bounds.length, def.height > 0]).toEqual([type, 'function', 4, true]);
      const c = drawSlot(type);
      expect([type, count(c) > 400]).toEqual([type, true]);
      hashes.add(canvasHash(c));
    }
    expect(hashes.size).toBe(6);
  });
  it('gives the firehouse its red emblem and the tower and barracks teal shields and the Defence colour (spec 5.3)', () => {
    expect([FIREHOUSE_EMBLEM, DEFENCE_EMBLEM]).toEqual([RED, CATEGORY_TINT.defence]);
    const red = (c) => count(c, (px) => nearColour(px, RED, 24));
    const teal = (c) => count(c, (px) => nearColour(px, TEAL, 24));
    const defence = (c) => count(c, (px) => nearColour(px, DEFENCE_EMBLEM, 16));
    const [fh, tw, bk] = ['firehouse', 'tower', 'barracks'].map(drawSlot);
    expect(red(fh)).toBeGreaterThan(150);                                        // the band, the awning and the pennant
    expect([teal(tw) > 30, defence(tw) > 20]).toEqual([true, true]);
    expect([teal(bk) > 60, defence(bk) > 60]).toEqual([true, true]);
    expect(red(tw)).toBeLessThan(red(fh) / 3);                                    // red is the firehouse's, not the tower's
  });
  it('draws rubble as a raised heap of broken brick in three variants, never as an empty plot', () => {
    expect(ART['house.t0']).toBe(undefined);                                     // an empty plot is the terrain's bare pad, with no sprite
    expect(inkTop('rubble')).toBeLessThan(8 - 3);                                // the heap and its stub rise above the tile's centre (art y 8)
    const variants = [];
    for (let v = 0; v < RUBBLE_VARIANTS; v++) variants.push(canvasHash(drawSlot(`rubble.v${v}`)));
    expect([RUBBLE_VARIANTS, new Set(variants).size]).toEqual([3, 3]);
    expect([4, 5, 6, 7].map((id) => slotFor({ id, type: 'rubble', x: 0, y: 0 }))).toEqual(['rubble.v1', 'rubble.v2', 'rubble.v0', 'rubble.v1']);
    expect(canvasHash(drawSlot('rubble'))).toBe(variants[0]);                    // the plain slot is the first heap
  });
  it('keeps each slot\'s height at its highest point, so taps and problem badges sit right', () => {
    for (const slot of ['firehouse', 'tower', 'barracks', 'rubble', 'rubble.v1', 'rubble.v2', 'wall', 'gate']) {
      const top = inkTop(slot), h = ART[slot].height;
      expect([slot, top >= -h - 1]).toEqual([slot, true]);                       // nothing drawn above the declared height
    }
    expect(ART.tower.height).toBeGreaterThan(Math.max(ART.firehouse.height, ART.barracks.height));
    expect(ART.rubble.height).toBeLessThan(ART.firehouse.height / 3);
  });
  it('draws the Wall card as a run of mudbrick and the gate as an arch over a road, in painted bands', () => {
    const gate = drawSlot('gate'), wall = drawSlot('wall');
    const road = (c) => count(c, (px) => nearColour(px, TERRAIN.roadEdge, 6));   // the road's worn edge: the wall has none of it
    expect([road(gate) > 300, road(wall) < 40]).toEqual([true, true]);
    for (const band of [RED, TEAL, GOLD]) expect([band, count(gate, (px) => nearColour(px, band, 20)) > 10]).toEqual([band, true]);
  });
});
```
