Replace the whole of `src/render/art/defence.js` with:

```js
// Stage 3 art (spec 5.3, 5.4): the firehouse with its red emblem, rubble (a heap of broken mudbrick, unlike the bare pad
// of an empty plot), the tower, the barracks, and the wall pieces. Walls are a tile layer (world.wall): the map draws
// them as a continuous mudbrick band from wallPiece, gatePiece and breachPiece (src/render/terrainWalls.js), and the
// 'wall' and 'gate' slots are what their card and the gate's picture show, built from the same pieces.
import { box, tb, qd, crs, door, win, parapet, pots, awn, p, U, quad, hs } from './primitives.js';
import { pennant } from './services.js';
import {
  WASH, WASH2, MUD, MUD2, STONE, RED, RED_DARK, TEAL, GOLD, WOOD, DOOR, INK, SHADOW, TERRAIN,
} from './palette.js';
import { boundsFor } from '../iso.js';

export const FIREHOUSE_EMBLEM = RED;      // spec 5.3: the firehouse's emblem matches its card (red)
export const DEFENCE_EMBLEM = RED_DARK;   // the Defence category's tint (CATEGORY_TINT.defence in data/ui.js)
const BUCKET = '#8A4A2A';
const SHIELD = TEAL, SHIELD_BOSS = GOLD;
const TIMBER = ['#8C6A4E', '#7A5A42', '#5E4636'];

// Firehouse (1x1): a whitewashed station with a red band under its parapet, a wide door with leather buckets hung beside
// it, a lookout on the roof under a red awning, water jars and a trough, and a red pennant.
export function firehouse(g, x, y) {
  g.poly(quad(x + 0.08, y + 0.74, 0.7, 0.2, 0), '#E9D9B4');                  // the swept apron in front of the door
  const F = box(g, x + 0.12, y + 0.12, 0.66, 0.6, 11, 0, WASH);
  parapet(g, x + 0.12, y + 0.12, 0.66, 0.6, 11);
  qd(g, F.L, 0, 1, 8.6, 9.8, RED);
  qd(g, F.R, 0, 1, 8.6, 9.8, RED_DARK);
  door(g, F, 0.24, 0.58, 6.6);                                                  // the wide door the crew runs out of
  win(g, F.R, 0.36, 0.64, 4.6, 6.8);
  for (const u of [0.7, 0.86]) {                                                // leather buckets on pegs beside the door
    const q = F.L(u, 6.6);
    g.line(q, [q[0], q[1] + 1], WOOD, 0.4);
    g.poly([[q[0] - 1.1, q[1] + 1], [q[0] + 1.1, q[1] + 1], [q[0] + 0.8, q[1] + 3.4], [q[0] - 0.8, q[1] + 3.4]], BUCKET, { outline: true });
  }
  const Lk = box(g, x + 0.2, y + 0.18, 0.26, 0.26, 2.6, 11, WASH2);            // the lookout on the roof
  qd(g, Lk.L, 0.3, 0.7, 0.6, 2.2, DOOR);
  awn(g, x + 0.17, y + 0.15, 0.32, 0.32, 17.4, RED, RED_DARK, '#F6ECD6');
  const T = box(g, x + 0.82, y + 0.2, 0.12, 0.46, 2.2, 0, STONE, 0);            // the trough, full
  g.poly(quad(x + 0.84, y + 0.23, 0.08, 0.4, 2.2), TERRAIN.water);
  qd(g, T.L, 0, 1, 1.4, 1.8, '#A89AA8', { alpha: 0.6 });
  pots(g, p(x + 0.38, y + 0.86), 3);                                            // water jars ready by the door
  pennant(g, U(p(x + 0.76, y + 0.14), 11), 7, FIREHOUSE_EMBLEM);
}

// Rubble: a burned building's broken mudbrick (spec 4.12, 5.4): a soot stain, a jagged stub of wall at the back, a low
// heap of broken brick with chunks on it, loose bricks and a charred beam. An empty plot is a bare pad; rubble is a
// raised heap. Three variants (by id, registry.js), the second mirrored and the third shifted, so a burned 2x2 does not
// show four copies of one heap.
const BRICK = ['#D9B27C', '#C49A62', '#9C8070'];
const HEAP = ['#D2AA74', '#BE965F', '#A2805E'];
const BURNT = '#4A3A36';

export function rubble(g, x, y, v = 0) {
  const flip = v === 1, shift = v === 2 ? 0.08 : 0;
  const at = (u, w2) => (flip ? [x + w2, y + u] : [x + u + shift, y + w2 - shift]);
  const P = (u, w2, z = 0) => { const [a, b] = at(u, w2); return U(p(a, b), z); };
  const bx = (u, w2, w, d, h, z, C) => { const [a, b] = at(u, w2); box(g, a, b, flip ? d : w, flip ? w : d, h, z, C, 0); };
  const c = P(0.5, 0.52);
  g.radial([c[0] + 1, c[1] + 0.6], 13, 6, '#7E6A5E', 0.3);                       // soot and dust on the ground
  const steps = [[0.14, 4.8], [0.3, 3.2], [0.42, 4.2], [0.56, 2.2]];              // the stub of the old wall, broken in steps
  for (const [u, h] of steps) bx(u, 0.18, 0.14, 0.14, h + (v === 2 ? -0.8 : 0), 0, MUD2);
  g.line(P(0.15, 0.32, 2.6), P(0.66, 0.32, 1.4), BURNT, 0.6, 0.55);                 // scorch along its foot
  const ring = [[0.2, 0.66], [0.3, 0.44], [0.52, 0.38], [0.74, 0.46], [0.84, 0.66], [0.66, 0.86], [0.38, 0.84]];
  g.poly(ring.map(([u, w2]) => P(u, w2, 0)), HEAP[2], { outline: true });          // the heap's footing in shade
  g.poly(ring.map(([u, w2]) => { const d = Math.hypot(u - 0.52, w2 - 0.64); return P(u + (0.52 - u) * 0.2, w2 + (0.64 - w2) * 0.2, 2.6 - d * 3); }), HEAP[1]);
  g.poly([P(0.36, 0.56, 3.2), P(0.52, 0.5, 3.8), P(0.66, 0.58, 3.2), P(0.52, 0.7, 2.6)], HEAP[0]);
  const chunks = [[0.32, 0.6, 0.14, 0.1, 1.4, 2.2], [0.5, 0.52, 0.12, 0.12, 1.6, 2.8], [0.62, 0.66, 0.1, 0.14, 1.2, 1.8], [0.42, 0.72, 0.12, 0.08, 1, 1.4]];
  for (const [u, w2, w, d, h, z] of chunks) bx(u, w2, w, d, h, z, BRICK);
  g.line(P(0.24, 0.78, 1), P(0.72, 0.5, 3.8), BURNT, 1.1);                       // a charred roof beam across the heap
  g.line(P(0.25, 0.78, 1.4), P(0.71, 0.5, 4.2), '#7A6058', 0.4, 0.8);
  const loose = [[0.1, 0.8, 0.09, 0.11], [0.84, 0.8, 0.12, 0.08], [0.86, 0.3, 0.09, 0.12], [0.62, 0.16, 0.12, 0.08]];
  loose.forEach(([u, w2, w, d], i) => { const j = (hs(v, i, 3) - 0.5) * 0.08; bx(u + j, w2 - j, w, d, 1.3, 0, BRICK); });
}

// Tower (1x1): a tapering mudbrick tower with arrow slits, a teal shield on its lit face, a fighting platform with
// merlons, and a pennant in the Defence colour.
export function tower(g, x, y) {
  const F = tb(g, x + 0.2, y + 0.2, 0.6, 0.6, 22, 0, 0.05, MUD2);
  crs(g, F, 22, '#9A7A5A', 3);
  door(g, F, 0.38, 0.62, 5.2);
  qd(g, F.L, 0.46, 0.54, 13, 17, DOOR);
  qd(g, F.R, 0.46, 0.54, 13, 17, DOOR);
  const s = F.L(0.5, 9.6);                                                       // the shield painted on the lit face
  g.ell(s, 2.4, 2.6, SHIELD, { outline: true });
  g.circ(s, 0.8, SHIELD_BOSS);
  box(g, x + 0.2, y + 0.2, 0.6, 0.6, 1.6, 22, MUD);                              // the platform's ledge
  const z = 23.6, m = 0.12, at = [0, 0.24, 0.48];
  for (const u of at) box(g, x + 0.2 + u, y + 0.2, m, m, 2.6, z, MUD2);          // merlons, back row first
  for (const u of at.slice(1)) box(g, x + 0.2, y + 0.2 + u, m, m, 2.6, z, MUD2);
  pennant(g, U(p(x + 0.42, y + 0.42), z), 7, DEFENCE_EMBLEM);
  for (const u of at.slice(1)) box(g, x + 0.68, y + 0.2 + u, m, m, 2.6, z, MUD2);
  for (const u of at) box(g, x + 0.2 + u, y + 0.68, m, m, 2.6, z, MUD2);
}

// Barracks (2x2): a mudbrick barrack block along the back with shields hung on its lit face, an armoury at the side, a
// drill yard of packed sand in front with a spear rack and a straw target, a low enclosure wall with an opening, and a
// pennant in the Defence colour. Soldiers waiting at the barracks stand in the yard (render/units.js).
export function barracks(g, X, Y) {
  g.poly(quad(X + 0.06, Y + 0.06, 1.88, 1.88, 0), '#E8D3A6', { outline: true });  // the drill yard
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) g.circ(p(X + 0.3 + hs(i, 1, 5) * 1.4, Y + 0.9 + hs(i, 2, 5) * 0.9), 0.6, TERRAIN.dotDark, { alpha: 0.6 });
  box(g, X + 0.06, Y + 0.06, 0.06, 1.88, 2.6, 0, MUD2);                          // the enclosure's back left side
  const B = box(g, X + 0.12, Y + 0.12, 1.76, 0.66, 11, 0, MUD2);                 // the barrack block
  crs(g, B, 11, '#9A7A5A', 3);
  parapet(g, X + 0.12, Y + 0.12, 1.76, 0.66, 11);
  qd(g, B.L, 0, 1, 9, 10.2, DEFENCE_EMBLEM);
  qd(g, B.R, 0, 1, 9, 10.2, '#7A2E26');
  door(g, B, 0.46, 0.56, 6.6);
  for (const u of [0.12, 0.3, 0.7, 0.88]) qd(g, B.L, u, u + 0.03, 4.6, 7.6, DOOR);
  for (const u of [0.21, 0.38, 0.63, 0.8]) {                                     // shields hung between the slits
    const q = B.L(u, 6.4);
    g.ell(q, 1.6, 1.8, SHIELD, { outline: true });
    g.circ(q, 0.55, SHIELD_BOSS);
  }
  const A = box(g, X + 1.34, Y + 0.78, 0.54, 0.5, 7, 0, MUD2);                    // the armoury
  parapet(g, X + 1.34, Y + 0.78, 0.54, 0.5, 7);
  door(g, A, 0.36, 0.64, 4.6);
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {                                                  // the spear rack
    const q = p(X + 0.3 + i * 0.1, Y + 0.95);
    g.line(q, U(q, 12), WOOD, 0.5);
    g.poly([U(q, 12), [q[0] - 0.6, q[1] - 10.6], [q[0] + 0.6, q[1] - 10.6]], STONE[2]);
  }
  box(g, X + 0.24, Y + 0.92, 0.46, 0.06, 0.6, 5, TIMBER, 0);                     // the rack's crossbar
  const t = p(X + 1.0, Y + 1.12);                                                // the straw target on its post
  g.line(t, U(t, 7), WOOD, 0.8);
  g.ell(U(t, 7.6), 2.4, 2.6, '#E2C27E', { outline: true });
  g.ell(U(t, 7.6), 1.4, 1.5, RED);
  g.ell(U(t, 7.6), 0.5, 0.55, '#F6ECD6');
  box(g, X + 1.88, Y + 0.06, 0.06, 1.88, 2.6, 0, MUD2);                          // the enclosure's right side
  box(g, X + 0.06, Y + 1.88, 0.7, 0.06, 2.6, 0, MUD2);                           // the front, with an opening
  box(g, X + 1.24, Y + 1.88, 0.7, 0.06, 2.6, 0, MUD2);
  pennant(g, U(p(X + 1.84, Y + 0.16), 11), 8, DEFENCE_EMBLEM);
}

// Wall pieces. A piece stands on its tile's centre line, WALL.t tiles thick: a post at the centre and an arm to each
// side that links to wall, plain-faced so neighbouring arms meet in one unbroken band, with mudbrick courses, a coping,
// merlons and a dark line at the foot. links: { n, e, s, w }, each 0 (nothing), 1 (standing wall, a gate, or a tower on
// a wall) or 2 (a breach: the arm ends in a broken stub).
export const WALL = { h: 6, t: 0.3, cap: 1.2, merlon: 1.6, gateH: 10.5 };
const CAP = ['#EBCB96', '#D8B17A', '#AE9080'];
const BROKEN = ['#D6B07E', '#BF9762', '#957A6A'];

function band(g, x, y, w, d, h) {
  const F = tb(g, x, y, w, d, h, 0, 0, MUD2, 0);
  for (let s = 2; s < h - 0.5; s += 2) {
    g.line(F.L(0, s), F.L(1, s), '#9A7A5A', 0.4, 0.28);
    g.line(F.R(0, s), F.R(1, s), '#7E6A5E', 0.4, 0.28);
  }
  g.line(F.L(0, 0), F.L(1, 0), INK, 0.9, 0.22);
  g.line(F.R(0, 0), F.R(1, 0), INK, 0.9, 0.22);
  return F;
}

function arm(g, x, y, w, d, full) {
  const h = full ? WALL.h : WALL.h * 0.55;
  band(g, x, y, w, d, h);
  if (!full) return;
  const C = tb(g, x - (d > w ? 0.03 : 0), y - (w > d ? 0.03 : 0), w + (d > w ? 0.06 : 0), d + (w > d ? 0.06 : 0), WALL.cap, h, 0, CAP, 0);
  g.line(C.L(0, WALL.cap), C.L(1, WALL.cap), '#FFFFFF', 0.5, 0.45);
  const cx = x + w / 2 - 0.05, cy = y + d / 2 - 0.05;
  box(g, cx, cy, 0.1, 0.1, WALL.merlon, h + WALL.cap, CAP, 0);
}

export function wallPiece(g, x, y, links = {}) {
  const t = WALL.t, a = 0.5 - t / 2, half = 0.5;
  const L = { n: links.n || 0, e: links.e || 0, s: links.s || 0, w: links.w || 0 };
  const stub = 0.32;
  if (L.n) arm(g, x + a, L.n === 1 ? y : y + half - stub, t, L.n === 1 ? half : stub, L.n === 1);
  if (L.w) arm(g, L.w === 1 ? x : x + half - stub, y + a, L.w === 1 ? half : stub, t, L.w === 1);
  const lone = !L.n && !L.e && !L.s && !L.w;
  if (lone) arm(g, x + 0.2, y + a, 0.6, t, true);                                // a single tile: a short block
  else arm(g, x + a, y + a, t, t, true);                                         // the post where the arms meet
  if (L.e) arm(g, x + half, y + a, L.e === 1 ? half : stub, t, L.e === 1);
  if (L.s) arm(g, x + a, y + half, t, L.s === 1 ? half : stub, L.s === 1);
}

// A gate: the wall drawn over a road (spec 4.13). Two tall piers at the tile's ends along the wall, joined by a painted
// lintel high enough for the road to pass under. alongX: the wall runs along x (the road crosses along y).
export function gatePiece(g, x, y, alongX = true) {
  const t = WALL.t + 0.06, a = 0.5 - t / 2, H = WALL.gateH, pier = 0.26;
  const pierAt = (u) => (alongX ? band(g, x + u, y + a, pier, t, H) : band(g, x + a, y + u, t, pier, H));
  const capAt = (u) => (alongX ? box(g, x + u - 0.02, y + a - 0.03, pier + 0.04, t + 0.06, 1.2, H, CAP, 0) : box(g, x + a - 0.03, y + u - 0.02, t + 0.06, pier + 0.04, 1.2, H, CAP, 0));
  pierAt(0); capAt(0);
  const Lt = alongX ? box(g, x + pier, y + a, 1 - 2 * pier, t, 2.6, H - 2.6, MUD2, 0) : box(g, x + a, y + pier, t, 1 - 2 * pier, 2.6, H - 2.6, MUD2, 0);
  const F = alongX ? Lt.L : Lt.R;                                                // the lintel's face toward the viewer
  g.path([['M', F(0, 0)], ['L', F(0, -2.4)], ['Q', F(0.06, 0), F(0.5, 0)], ['Q', F(0.94, 0), F(1, -2.4)], ['L', F(1, 0)], ['Z']], MUD2[1]);   // the arch
  g.stroke([['M', F(0, -2.4)], ['Q', F(0.06, 0), F(0.5, 0)], ['Q', F(0.94, 0), F(1, -2.4)]], INK, 0.5, 0.4);
  qd(g, F, 0, 1, 0.3, 0.9, RED);
  qd(g, F, 0, 1, 0.9, 1.6, TEAL);
  qd(g, F, 0, 1, 1.6, 2.2, GOLD);
  g.line(F(0, 0), F(1, 0), INK, 0.6, 0.35);
  pierAt(1 - pier); capAt(1 - pier);
}

// A breach (spec 4.13): broken stone where a wall tile was knocked down: low ragged stumps along the line and fallen
// bricks, until the player draws wall over it again.
export function breachPiece(g, x, y, alongX = true) {
  const c = p(x + 0.5, y + 0.5);
  g.radial([c[0], c[1] + 0.5], 11, 5, '#8C7A6A', 0.22);
  const t = WALL.t, a = 0.5 - t / 2;
  const chunk = (u, len, h) => (alongX ? box(g, x + u, y + a, len, t, h, 0, BROKEN, 0) : box(g, x + a, y + u, t, len, h, 0, BROKEN, 0));
  chunk(0, 0.2, 2.8);
  chunk(0.26, 0.16, 1.2);
  chunk(0.58, 0.14, 1.6);
  chunk(0.82, 0.18, 2.4);
  for (const [u, v, w, d] of [[0.3, 0.16, 0.12, 0.08], [0.6, 0.74, 0.1, 0.12], [0.16, 0.7, 0.12, 0.09], [0.74, 0.2, 0.09, 0.12]]) box(g, x + u, y + v, w, d, 1.2, 0, BRICK, 0);
}

// The 'wall' slot (the Wall card): a short run of three linked pieces. The 'gate' slot: a gate on a strip of road
// between two wall pieces.
export function wallRun(g, x, y) {
  wallPiece(g, x - 1, y, { e: 1 });
  wallPiece(g, x, y, { w: 1, e: 1 });
  wallPiece(g, x + 1, y, { w: 1 });
}
export function gateRun(g, x, y) {
  const road = [['M', p(x + 0.5, y - 0.4)], ['L', p(x + 0.5, y + 1.4)]];
  for (const [col, w, a] of [[SHADOW, 15, 0.12], [TERRAIN.roadEdge, 12, 1], [TERRAIN.road, 10, 1]]) g.stroke(road, col, w, a);
  wallPiece(g, x - 1, y, { e: 1 });
  gatePiece(g, x, y, true);
  wallPiece(g, x + 1, y, { w: 1 });
}

export const RUBBLE_VARIANTS = 3;
const RUBBLE_SLOT = { w: 1, d: 1, height: 5, bounds: boundsFor(1, 1, 5), shadows: [] };
export const DEFENCE_ART = {
  firehouse: { w: 1, d: 1, height: 19, bounds: boundsFor(1, 1, 19), shadows: [[0.12, 0.12, 0.66, 0.6, 11]], draw: firehouse },

  wall: { w: 1, d: 1, height: 9, bounds: [-32, -20, 32, 28], shadows: [], draw: wallRun },

  rubble: { ...RUBBLE_SLOT, draw: (g, x, y) => rubble(g, x, y, 0) },
};
```

```js
// The art slot a building shows: houses by tier, granaries, storehouses and bazaars by how full they are
// (stages.js), and farms by their crop's growth, which runs on the game day, so a farm needs the world (without
// one, its plain type slot). Everything else is its type.
export function slotFor(b, world = null) {
  if (b.type === 'house') return `house.t${b.tier}`;
  if (b.type === 'granary') return `granary.s${granaryStage(b)}`;
  if (b.type === 'storehouse') return `storehouse.s${storehouseStage(b)}`;
```

with:

```js
// The art slot a building shows: houses by tier, granaries, storehouses and bazaars by how full they are
// (stages.js), and farms by their crop's growth, which runs on the game day, so a farm needs the world (without
// one, its plain type slot). Rubble picks one of its heaps by id, so a burned 2x2 shows four different heaps.
// Everything else is its type.
export function slotFor(b, world = null) {
  if (b.type === 'house') return `house.t${b.tier}`;
  if (b.type === 'rubble') return `rubble.v${b.id % RUBBLE_VARIANTS}`;
  if (b.type === 'granary') return `granary.s${granaryStage(b)}`;
  if (b.type === 'storehouse') return `storehouse.s${storehouseStage(b)}`;
```

### Task C2: Walls on the map, and flames

**Model hint:** opus (art and motion rules).

**Files:**
- Create: `src/render/terrainWalls.js` — the wall layer: `wallCode`, `runsAlongX`, `wallPieceAt`, `drawWalls`
- Modify: `src/render/terrainBaker.js` — the chunk signature mixes each tile's wall code; `bakeChunk` draws the walls after the roads
- Modify (replace the stub file): `src/render/fire.js` — `drawFires`, `flame`, `roofPoint`, `FLAME_STEP_MS`, `SMOKE_RISE_MS`, `SMOKE_PUFFS`, `FLAME`
- Modify: `src/ui/text.js` — Track C's section: `ART_TEXT.burning`
- Create: `tests/stage3/art/wallsMap.test.js`, `tests/stage3/art/fireArt.test.js`; Modify: `tests/stage3/art.all.js`
- Modify: `sw-files.js` (regenerated; it gains `./src/render/terrainWalls.js`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `world.wall` (0 none, > 0 a standing wall's hit points, -1 a breach; a gate is a wall tile on a road; a tower on a wall tile keeps its wall value) and `world.road`; `wallPiece`, `gatePiece`, `breachPiece` (C1); `b.fire` (`{ stage: 'blaze', ... }` or `{ stage: 'fire', ... }`, contract); `ART`, `slotFor`.
- Produces: walls drawn in the baked terrain, a chunk re-baking when a wall tile under it or in its two-tile ring appears, breaks or goes (the contract's "re-baked on wallVersion": the signature mixes each tile's wall code, which changes exactly when the sim bumps `wallVersion`, so only the chunks a change touches re-bake, and a hit that does not break a tile re-bakes nothing); `drawFires(g, world, range, now, { reducedMotion })` (contract signature; `range` may be null for the whole map; it never touches `g` when nothing burns); `ART_TEXT.burning = 'Burning'`.

The look: a wall is a continuous mudbrick band about 6 art px high (courses, a coping and merlons) along the tile centres, joining its neighbours; where it crosses a road it is a gate, two taller piers under a painted lintel and arch; a breach is low broken stone. Walls are terrain, so a building or unit standing on the tile right behind a wall is drawn over the wall's top by at most about 3 art px; units on the tile behind do not overlap the band at all (it stands at the tile centre). Flames: a blaze is one small flame on the roof, a fire three larger flames under a column of soft smoke puffs; a flame's shape steps every 500 ms (2 Hz at most), out of step by building id; its colours and size never change (no flash), and it is orange and gold, never a saturated red; smoke rises and fades smoothly over 3 s. Under reduced motion: still flames and a pale "Burning" label, no smoke.

```js
  it('stands a gate taller than the wall and a breach lower', () => {
    const wall = inkTop((g) => wallPiece(g, 0, 0, { n: 1, s: 1 }));
    const gate = inkTop((g) => gatePiece(g, 0, 0, false));
    const breach = inkTop((g) => breachPiece(g, 0, 0, false));
    expect(gate).toBeLessThan(wall - 3);
    expect(breach).toBeGreaterThan(wall + 3);
  });
});
```

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { drawFires, roofPoint, FLAME_STEP_MS, SMOKE_PUFFS } from '../../../src/render/fire.js';
import { ART, slotFor } from '../../../src/render/art/registry.js';
import { makeDraw } from '../../../src/render/art/ctx.js';
import { p, U } from '../../../src/render/iso.js';
import { ART_TEXT } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';
import { makeTestWorld, addRaw } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';
import { makeCanvas, canvasHash, nearColour } from '../../helpers/canvas.js';

const BLAZE = { stage: 'blaze', days: 1, need: 2, fought: 0 };
const FIRE = { stage: 'fire', days: 2, left: 9 };

function burningPotter(fire) {
  const w = makeTestWorld({ fertile: [] });
  const b = addRaw(w, 'potter', 10, 10);
  b.fire = { ...fire };
  return { w, b };
}

// One frame of drawFires on a canvas centred on building b, counting the drawing calls it made.
function frame(w, b, now, opts = {}, range = null) {
  const c = makeCanvas(240, 220), ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  const q = p(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.d / 2);
  ctx.translate(120 - q[0] * 2, 180 - q[1] * 2);
  const g = makeDraw(ctx, 2);
  const calls = { path: 0, radial: [], text: [] };
  const { path, radial, text } = g;
  g.path = (...a) => { calls.path++; return path(...a); };
  g.radial = (q2, rx, ry, col, a) => { calls.radial.push(a); return radial(q2, rx, ry, col, a); };
  g.text = (q2, s, o) => { calls.text.push(s); return text(q2, s, o); };
  drawFires(g, w, range, now, opts);
  return { c, calls };
}

// Solid-ish pixels and their mean brightness.
function look(c) {
  const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data;
  let n = 0, lum = 0, red = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
    if (d[i + 3] < 128) continue;
    n++;
    lum += 0.2126 * d[i] + 0.7152 * d[i + 1] + 0.0722 * d[i + 2];
    if (nearColour([d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]], '#E8201C', 50)) red++;
  }
  return { n, mean: n ? lum / n : 0, red };
}

describe('s3 art fire', () => {
  it('stands a blaze as one small flame on the roof, and a fire as three larger flames under a column of smoke', () => {
    const blaze = burningPotter(BLAZE), fire = burningPotter(FIRE);
    const roof = roofPoint(blaze.w, blaze.b);
    expect(roof).toEqual(U(p(11, 11), Math.round(ART[slotFor(blaze.b, blaze.w)].height * 0.62)));
    const a = frame(blaze.w, blaze.b, 1000, { reducedMotion: false });
    const b = frame(fire.w, fire.b, 1000, { reducedMotion: false });
    expect([a.calls.path, a.calls.radial.length]).toEqual([2, 0]);              // one flame (its outer and inner shapes), no smoke
    expect([b.calls.path, b.calls.radial.length]).toEqual([6, SMOKE_PUFFS]);   // three flames and the smoke column
    expect(look(b.c).n).toBeGreaterThan(look(a.c).n * 3);
  });
  it('changes a flame\'s shape at most twice a second, never its brightness, and never in red', () => {
    const { w, b } = burningPotter(BLAZE);
    let last = null, changes = 0;
    const means = [], sizes = [];
    for (let t = 0; t < 5000; t += 20) {
      const { c } = frame(w, b, t, { reducedMotion: false });
      const h = canvasHash(c), l = look(c);
      if (last !== null && h !== last) {
        changes++;
        expect([t, Math.floor(t / FLAME_STEP_MS) !== Math.floor((t - 20) / FLAME_STEP_MS)]).toEqual([t, true]);   // only on a step
      }
      last = h;
      means.push(l.mean); sizes.push(l.n);
      expect(l.red).toBe(0);
    }
    expect(FLAME_STEP_MS).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(500);
    expect(changes).toBeGreaterThan(5);                                          // it does move
    expect(changes).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10);                                     // 5 s at 2 Hz
    expect(Math.max(...means) - Math.min(...means)).toBeLessThan(12);            // no flash: the same colours throughout
    expect(Math.min(...sizes) / Math.max(...sizes)).toBeGreaterThan(0.8);
  });
  it('lets the smoke rise and fade smoothly, with no puff popping in or out', () => {
    const { w, b } = burningPotter(FIRE);
    let prev = null;
    for (let t = 0; t < 6000; t += 16) {
      const alphas = frame(w, b, t, { reducedMotion: false }).calls.radial;
      if (prev) for (let i = 0; i < alphas.length; i++) expect([t, i, Math.abs(alphas[i] - prev[i]) < 0.05]).toEqual([t, i, true]);
      prev = alphas;
    }
  });
  it('shows still flames and the word "Burning" under reduced motion, with no smoke', () => {
    expect(ART_TEXT.burning).toBe('Burning');
    for (const fire of [BLAZE, FIRE]) {
      const { w, b } = burningPotter(fire);
      const shots = [0, 700, 2600, 4100].map((t) => frame(w, b, t, { reducedMotion: true }));
      expect(new Set(shots.map((s) => canvasHash(s.c))).size).toBe(1);
      expect([shots[0].calls.text, shots[0].calls.radial.length]).toEqual([['Burning'], 0]);
    }
  });
  it('draws only the burning buildings in range, and nothing at all where nothing burns', () => {
    const { w, b } = burningPotter(BLAZE);
    const other = addRaw(w, 'potter', 20, 20, { fire: { ...BLAZE } });
    addRaw(w, 'potter', 4, 20);                                                  // not burning
    expect(frame(w, b, 0).calls.path).toBe(4);
    expect(frame(w, b, 0, {}, { x0: 8, y0: 8, x1: 14, y1: 14 }).calls.path).toBe(2);
    other.fire = null;
    b.fire = null;
    expect(drawFires(null, w, null, 0)).toBe(undefined);                         // never touches the canvas
  });
});
```

```js
// Walls on the map (spec 4.13, 5.4): a continuous mudbrick band along the wall tiles (world.wall), a gate arch where a
// wall crosses a road, and broken stone at a breach. Baked into the terrain chunks after the roads (terrainBaker.js), so
// a chunk re-bakes only when a wall tile in it, or in the two-tile ring it draws, appears, goes or breaks: its
// signature mixes each tile's wallCode, which changes exactly when the sim bumps world.wallVersion. Pieces are drawn
// back to front (by x + y), so arms that meet across a tile edge join into one band.
import { idx, inBounds } from '../sim/grid.js';
import { wallPiece, gatePiece, breachPiece } from './art/defence.js';

// 0 no wall, 1 a standing wall (a gate, or a tower's wall tile, included), 2 a breach. Off the map is 0.
export function wallCode(world, x, y) {
  if (!world.wall || !inBounds(world.size, x, y)) return 0;
  const v = world.wall[idx(world.size, x, y)];
  return v > 0 ? 1 : v < 0 ? 2 : 0;
}

const isRoad = (world, x, y) => inBounds(world.size, x, y) && Boolean(world.road[idx(world.size, x, y)]);

// Whether the wall through tile (x, y) runs along x: it links east or west; failing that, north or south means along
// y; a lone gate turns across its road.
export function runsAlongX(world, x, y) {
  if (wallCode(world, x - 1, y) || wallCode(world, x + 1, y)) return true;
  if (wallCode(world, x, y - 1) || wallCode(world, x, y + 1)) return false;
  return !(isRoad(world, x - 1, y) || isRoad(world, x + 1, y));
}

// What one wall tile draws: null, or { kind: 'wall' | 'gate' | 'breach', links, alongX }.
export function wallPieceAt(world, x, y) {
  const code = wallCode(world, x, y);
  if (!code) return null;
  if (code === 2) return { kind: 'breach', alongX: runsAlongX(world, x, y) };
  if (isRoad(world, x, y)) return { kind: 'gate', alongX: runsAlongX(world, x, y) };
  return { kind: 'wall', links: { n: wallCode(world, x, y - 1), e: wallCode(world, x + 1, y), s: wallCode(world, x, y + 1), w: wallCode(world, x - 1, y) } };
}

export function drawWalls(g, world, range) {
  if (!world.wall) return;
  for (let sum = range.x0 + range.y0; sum <= range.x1 + range.y1; sum++) {
    for (let x = range.x0; x <= range.x1; x++) {
      const y = sum - x;
      if (y < range.y0 || y > range.y1) continue;
      const piece = wallPieceAt(world, x, y);
      if (!piece) continue;
      if (piece.kind === 'wall') wallPiece(g, x, y, piece.links);
      else if (piece.kind === 'gate') gatePiece(g, x, y, piece.alongX);
      else breachPiece(g, x, y, piece.alongX);
    }
  }
}
```

Replace the whole of `src/render/fire.js` with:

```js
// Flames and smoke (spec 5.4), drawn from the world's fire state (b.fire, src/sim/fire.js), so they survive a reload.
// Stage 3 contract: createUI passes drawFires to renderFrame as opts.fire, which calls it once a frame in art px (the
// camera's origin set) after the depth-sorted sprites and before the effects and overlays.
//
// A blaze is one small flame on the roof; a fire is three larger flames and a column of the potter's soft smoke puffs.
// A flame's shape (its tip's sway and its embers) steps once every FLAME_STEP_MS, so it changes at 2 Hz at most, each
// building out of step by its id; its colours and size never change, so nothing flashes, and it is orange and gold,
// never a saturated red. Smoke puffs rise and fade smoothly over SMOKE_RISE_MS. Under reduced motion a burning building
// shows still flames and the word "Burning" (ART_TEXT.burning) on a pale label, and no smoke.
import { ART, slotFor } from './art/registry.js';
import { p, U } from './iso.js';
import { ART_TEXT } from '../ui/text.js';

export const FLAME_STEP_MS = 500;
export const SMOKE_RISE_MS = 3000;
export const SMOKE_PUFFS = 4;
export const FLAME = { outer: '#E07B39', mid: '#F2A93B', core: '#FCE6A6', ember: '#F6C05A', smoke: '#BDB3BE' };
const LEAN = [-0.8, 0.5, 1, -0.3];            // the tip's sway at each of four steps, in art px per unit of size
const LABEL = { fill: '#FFF8EA', text: '#3B2A14', size: 5.5 };

const inRange = (b, r) => !r || (b.x <= r.x1 && b.x + b.w - 1 >= r.x0 && b.y <= r.y1 && b.y + b.d - 1 >= r.y0);

// One flame standing on art point q: an orange teardrop, a gold heart, a pale core and two embers above its tip.
export function flame(g, q, size, step) {
  const [x, y] = q, w = 2.2 * size, h = 6.5 * size, lean = LEAN[step % LEAN.length] * size;
  const shape = (k, tip, fill) => g.path([
    ['M', [x - w * k, y]], ['Q', [x - w * k * 1.15, y - h * k * 0.55], [x + tip, y - h * k]],
    ['Q', [x + w * k * 1.15, y - h * k * 0.55], [x + w * k, y]], ['Q', [x, y + w * k * 0.45], [x - w * k, y]], ['Z'],
  ], fill);
  shape(1, lean, FLAME.outer);
  shape(0.62, lean * 0.7, FLAME.mid);
  g.ell([x, y - h * 0.12], w * 0.32, w * 0.26, FLAME.core);
  const side = step % 2 ? 1 : -1;
  g.circ([x + lean * 1.3 + side * size, y - h - (1 + (step % 3)) * size * 1.2], 0.45 * size, FLAME.ember);
  g.circ([x + lean * 0.6 - side * 1.4 * size, y - h * 0.8 - (step % 2) * size], 0.35 * size, FLAME.ember);
}

// Where a building's flames stand: on its roof, at the footprint's centre, about two thirds of its art height up.
export function roofPoint(world, b) {
  const def = ART[slotFor(b, world)];
  const z = Math.max(4, Math.round((def ? def.height : 10) * 0.62));
  return U(p(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.d / 2), z);
}

function label(g, q, str) {
  const ctx = g.ctx;
  ctx.font = `700 ${LABEL.size * g.scale}px system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif`;
  const w = ctx.measureText(str).width / g.scale + 5, h = LABEL.size + 2.6, [x, y] = q, r = h / 2;
  g.path([['M', [x - w / 2 + r, y - r]], ['L', [x + w / 2 - r, y - r]], ['Q', [x + w / 2, y - r], [x + w / 2, y]], ['Q', [x + w / 2, y + r], [x + w / 2 - r, y + r]],
    ['L', [x - w / 2 + r, y + r]], ['Q', [x - w / 2, y + r], [x - w / 2, y]], ['Q', [x - w / 2, y - r], [x - w / 2 + r, y - r]], ['Z']], LABEL.fill, { alpha: 0.94, outline: true });
  g.text([x, y + 0.2], str, { size: LABEL.size, color: LABEL.text, weight: '700' });
}

// A fire's column of smoke over art point q: SMOKE_PUFFS puffs, each rising about 22 art px and fading as it goes,
// spaced evenly in time and out of step with other buildings by id.
function smoke(g, q, now, id) {
  const offset = ((id * 0.618) % 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < SMOKE_PUFFS; i++) {
    const t = (now / SMOKE_RISE_MS + i / SMOKE_PUFFS + offset) % 1;
    const a = 0.5 * Math.min(1, t / 0.15) * (1 - t);
    const r = 2.6 + t * 3.6;
    g.radial([q[0] + 1.5 + t * 4, q[1] - 10 - t * 22], r, r * 0.8, FLAME.smoke, a);
  }
}

export function drawFires(g, world, range, now, { reducedMotion = false } = {}) {
  for (const id in world.buildings) {
    const b = world.buildings[id];
    if (!b.fire || !inRange(b, range)) continue;
    const q = roofPoint(world, b), big = b.fire.stage === 'fire';
    const step = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.floor(now / FLAME_STEP_MS) + b.id;
    if (big && !reducedMotion) smoke(g, q, now, b.id);
    if (big) {
      const k = Math.min(2, b.w);
      flame(g, [q[0] - 5 * k, q[1] + 1.5], 1.15, step + 1);
      flame(g, [q[0] + 5 * k, q[1] + 2], 1.05, step + 2);
      flame(g, [q[0], q[1] - 1], 1.5, step);
    } else {
      flame(g, q, 0.85, step);
    }
    if (reducedMotion) label(g, [q[0], q[1] - (big ? 15 : 10)], ART_TEXT.burning);
  }
}
```

### Task C3: Units: raiders, soldiers, health bars, arrows and the firehouse walker

**Model hint:** opus (art and motion).

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/render/art/figures.js` — `raider` and `soldier` (1.5x, told apart by shape), the `firefighter` kind, `UNIT_KINDS`, `UNIT_SCALE`, slots `fig.raider` and `fig.soldier`
- Modify (replace the stub file): `src/render/units.js` — `unitsAt`, `drawUnitMarks`, `ARROW_MS`, `STILL_ARROW_MS`, `BAR`, `BAR_COLOUR` (`UNIT_ID_BASE` kept)
- Modify: `src/render/walkers.js` — `KIND_BY_TYPE.firehouse = 'firefighter'`
- Modify: `tests/render/figuresArt.test.js` — the slot count includes the two unit slots
- Create: `tests/stage3/art/unitsArt.test.js`; Modify: `tests/stage3/art.all.js`
- Modify: `sw-files.js` (regenerated)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `world.raid.active.raiders` (`{ id, x, y, hp, hit }`, tile coordinates, maybe fractional), `world.soldiers` (`{ id, barracks, x, y, hp, hit, task }`), `world.raid.active.shots` (`[{ from: { x, y }, to: { x, y } }]`, the day's tower shots), `UNITS` (hit points), `ART.tower.height`, the renderer's walker path (`fig.<kind>` slots, depth key `x + y + 0.01`).
- Produces (contract): `unitsAt(world, timeDays, range = null)` returning `{ id: UNIT_ID_BASE + unit id, kind: 'raider' | 'soldier', x, y, dir }` in range, raiders first, then soldiers, each in the world's order; `drawUnitMarks(g, world, range, timeDays, now, { reducedMotion })`; figure slots `fig.raider`, `fig.soldier`, `fig.firefighter`.

How units move: the sim moves a unit once a day; `unitsAt` glides each from where it was drawn to its new spot over the next game day (`timeDays` minus the frame it saw the change), from a per-world record kept in a WeakMap outside the world, so nothing is saved and a reload shows each unit where it stands. A soldier standing on its own barracks' footprint waits in the barracks' yard, in a row by id (drawn after the barracks: its depth key is past the building's). Health bars appear once `hit` is true, as long as `hp` over the kind's full hit points. A new day's shots (keyed on `world.day` and their count) start a volley: each arrow flies for 0.3 s from the tower's platform to the raider in a shallow arc, or shows as a still line for 0.6 s under reduced motion.

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { unitsAt, drawUnitMarks, UNIT_ID_BASE, ARROW_MS, STILL_ARROW_MS, BAR, BAR_COLOUR } from '../../../src/render/units.js';
import { fig, raider, soldier, FIGURE_KINDS, UNIT_KINDS, UNIT_SCALE } from '../../../src/render/art/figures.js';
import { KIND_BY_TYPE, walkersAt } from '../../../src/render/walkers.js';
import { ART } from '../../../src/render/art/registry.js';
import { makeDraw } from '../../../src/render/art/ctx.js';
import { createRenderer } from '../../../src/render/renderer.js';
import { createCamera } from '../../../src/render/camera.js';
import { makeTestWorld, setRoad, addRaw, staffAll } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';
import { makeCanvas } from '../../helpers/canvas.js';

// A raid under way with raiders at the given tiles (hit raiders carry hp below 10), shots and no soldiers yet.
function raidWorld(raiders, shots = []) {
  const w = makeTestWorld({ fertile: [] });
  w.raid.active = {
    index: 0, entry: { x: 31, y: 10 }, dir: 'east', size: raiders.length, target: 'storehouse', day: 0, phase: 'attack', targetId: null,
    struck: [], wait: 0, byTowers: 0, bySoldiers: 0, burned: 0, stolen: 0, shots,
    raiders: raiders.map(([x, y, hp = 10], i) => ({ id: 1 + i, x, y, hp, hit: hp < 10 })),
  };
  return w;
}

// A figure drawn alone; returns its alpha mask and the inked height in art px.
function mask(draw) {
  const c = makeCanvas(160, 200), ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.translate(80, 160);
  draw(makeDraw(ctx, 3));
  const d = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data;
  const on = new Uint8Array(c.width * c.height);
  let top = c.height;
  for (let i = 0; i < on.length; i++) if (d[i * 4 + 3] > 100) { on[i] = 1; top = Math.min(top, Math.floor(i / c.width)); }
  return { on, height: (160 - top) / 3 };
}

// drawUnitMarks with its line and poly calls recorded.
function marks(w, timeDays, now, opts = {}) {
  const ctx = makeCanvas(64, 64).getContext('2d');
  const g = makeDraw(ctx, 1);
  const calls = { line: [], poly: [] };
  const { line, poly } = g;
  g.line = (a, b, c, wd, al) => { calls.line.push({ a, b, c, al }); return line(a, b, c, wd, al); };
  g.poly = (pts, fill, o) => { calls.poly.push({ pts, fill }); return poly(pts, fill, o); };
  drawUnitMarks(g, w, null, timeDays, now, opts);
  return calls;
}

describe('s3 art units', () => {

    expect(r.height / citizen.height).toBeGreaterThan(1.5);                      // the body is 1.5x; the crest rises above it
    expect(s.height / citizen.height).toBeGreaterThan(2);                        // the tall spear
    let differ = 0, either = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < r.on.length; i++) { if (r.on[i] !== s.on[i]) differ++; if (r.on[i] || s.on[i]) either++; }
    expect(differ / either).toBeGreaterThan(0.4);                                // silhouettes differ, not just their colours
    for (const kind of UNIT_KINDS) expect([kind, ART[`fig.${kind}`].bounds]).toEqual([kind, [-21, -45, 21, 9]]);
  });

    const w = raidWorld([[20, 10]], [{ from: { x: 17, y: 10 }, to: { x: 20, y: 10 } }]);
    expect([ARROW_MS, STILL_ARROW_MS]).toEqual([300, 600]);

    expect(mid[0].b[0]).toBeGreaterThan(first[0].b[0]);                         // the head moves toward the raider (east)

    expect(arrows(5000).length).toBe(1);

    const a = still(9000), b = still(9000 + STILL_ARROW_MS - 1);

    expect(b[0]).toEqual(a[0]);                                                  // the same still line

  it('draws units in the depth-sorted pass through the walkers list', () => {

    const base = renderer.renderFrame(w, cam, { view: { width: 300, height: 200 }, walkers: [] }).sprites;
    const withUnits = renderer.renderFrame(w, cam, { view: { width: 300, height: 200 }, walkers: unitsAt(w, 0) }).sprites;
    expect(withUnits).toBe(base + 1);
```

```js
}

// A raider at tile point (gx, gy): a dark figure in a crested helmet with a round shield on the left arm and a short
// axe in the right hand.
const RAIDER = { body: '#3E3446', kilt: '#55465A', helm: '#6A5A4E', crest: '#8A2E26', shield: '#6E5A3E', rim: '#B39466' };
export function raider(g, gx, gy, z = 0, sc = UNIT_SCALE) {
  const c = U(p(gx, gy), z), X = c[0], Y = c[1], s = sc;
  g.ell([X, Y], 3 * s, 1.1 * s, SHADOW, { alpha: 0.3 });
  g.line([X - 0.9 * s, Y], [X - 1.1 * s, Y - 3.4 * s], RAIDER.body, 1.2 * s);          // legs astride
  g.line([X + 0.9 * s, Y], [X + 1.1 * s, Y - 3.4 * s], RAIDER.body, 1.2 * s);
  g.poly([[X - 2 * s, Y - 2.6 * s], [X + 2 * s, Y - 2.6 * s], [X + 1.5 * s, Y - 5.7 * s], [X - 1.5 * s, Y - 5.7 * s]], RAIDER.kilt);
  g.poly([[X - 1.6 * s, Y - 5.6 * s], [X + 1.6 * s, Y - 5.6 * s], [X + 1.9 * s, Y - 8.8 * s], [X - 1.9 * s, Y - 8.8 * s]], RAIDER.body);
  g.line([X + 1.8 * s, Y - 8.4 * s], [X + 3.2 * s, Y - 6 * s], RAIDER.body, 0.9 * s);   // the axe arm, raised
  g.line([X + 3.2 * s, Y - 6 * s], [X + 3.6 * s, Y - 12 * s], WOOD, 0.6 * s);
  g.poly([[X + 3.4 * s, Y - 12.4 * s], [X + 5.4 * s, Y - 11.6 * s], [X + 3.6 * s, Y - 10.2 * s]], STONE[2]);
  g.circ([X + 0.2 * s, Y - 10.4 * s], 1.5 * s, RAIDER.body);                            // the head
  g.path([['M', [X - 1.7 * s, Y - 10.6 * s]], ['Q', [X + 0.2 * s, Y - 13.6 * s], [X + 1.9 * s, Y - 10.6 * s]], ['Z']], RAIDER.helm);
  g.path([['M', [X - 2 * s, Y - 11 * s]], ['Q', [X - 0.6 * s, Y - 16.2 * s], [X + 2.4 * s, Y - 13.4 * s]],
    ['Q', [X + 0.4 * s, Y - 13.4 * s], [X - 2 * s, Y - 11 * s]], ['Z']], RAIDER.crest);   // the crest, sweeping back
  g.circ([X - 2.4 * s, Y - 6.4 * s], 2.6 * s, RAIDER.shield, { stroke: RAIDER.rim, strokeWidth: 0.6 * s });   // the round shield
  g.circ([X - 2.4 * s, Y - 6.4 * s], 0.7 * s, RAIDER.rim);
}

// A soldier at tile point (gx, gy): a white kilt and a teal collar, a tall spear held upright and a tall, round-topped
// teal shield in front.
export function soldier(g, gx, gy, z = 0, sc = UNIT_SCALE) {
  const c = U(p(gx, gy), z), X = c[0], Y = c[1], s = sc, sk = '#A0663F', hair = '#1E150E';
  g.ell([X, Y], 3 * s, 1.1 * s, SHADOW, { alpha: 0.25 });
  g.line([X + 3 * s, Y + 0.6 * s], [X + 3 * s, Y - 20 * s], WOOD, 0.6 * s);           // the spear, taller than the man
  g.poly([[X + 3 * s, Y - 22.4 * s], [X + 3.8 * s, Y - 19.6 * s], [X + 2.2 * s, Y - 19.6 * s]], GOLD);
  g.line([X - 0.9 * s, Y], [X - 0.9 * s, Y - 3.4 * s], sk, 1.1 * s);
  g.line([X + 0.9 * s, Y], [X + 0.9 * s, Y - 3.4 * s], sk, 1.1 * s);
  g.poly([[X - 2 * s, Y - 2.6 * s], [X + 2 * s, Y - 2.6 * s], [X + 1.5 * s, Y - 5.7 * s], [X - 1.5 * s, Y - 5.7 * s]], '#FAF6EC', { outline: true });
  g.poly([[X - 1.5 * s, Y - 5.6 * s], [X + 1.5 * s, Y - 5.6 * s], [X + 1.7 * s, Y - 8.7 * s], [X - 1.7 * s, Y - 8.7 * s]], sk);
  g.line([X - 1.5 * s, Y - 8.5 * s], [X + 1.5 * s, Y - 8.5 * s], TEAL, 1 * s);
  g.line([X + 1.8 * s, Y - 8.4 * s], [X + 3 * s, Y - 6.4 * s], sk, 0.9 * s);           // the hand on the spear
  g.circ([X - 0.2 * s, Y - 10.8 * s], 1.75 * s, hair);
  g.circ([X + 0.25 * s, Y - 10.3 * s], 1.4 * s, sk);
  g.line([X - 1.6 * s, Y - 11.4 * s], [X + 1.6 * s, Y - 11.4 * s], '#FAF6EC', 0.6 * s);   // a white headband
  g.path([['M', [X - 3.8 * s, Y - 1.4 * s]], ['L', [X - 3.8 * s, Y - 7.6 * s]], ['Q', [X - 2.3 * s, Y - 10.6 * s], [X - 0.8 * s, Y - 7.6 * s]],
    ['L', [X - 0.8 * s, Y - 1.4 * s]], ['Z']], TEAL, { stroke: TEAL_DARK, strokeWidth: 0.5 * s });   // the shield, round-topped

}
```

Replace the whole of `src/render/units.js` with:

```js
// Raiders and soldiers (spec 5.4). Stage 3 contract: units are depth-sorted with the walkers: createUI appends
// unitsAt's entries to the walkers list it hands renderFrame, which draws each as the figure slot fig.<kind>
// (src/render/art/figures.js: 'raider' and 'soldier', 1.5 times a citizen's size). Health bars and arrows are drawn on
// top by drawUnitMarks, which renderFrame calls as opts.units after the sprites (art px).
//
// Units move one step a day in the sim (world.raid.active.raiders, world.soldiers: tile coordinates, maybe fractional).
// The drawing glides each one from where it was drawn to its new spot over the next game day, from a per-world record
// kept outside the world (a WeakMap, like walkers.js's loops), so nothing is saved and a reload shows each unit where it
// stands. A soldier standing on its own barracks waits in the barracks' yard, in a row by id.
import { UNITS } from '../data/raids.js';
import { ART } from './art/registry.js';
import { p, U } from './iso.js';

// Unit ids in the walkers list are UNIT_ID_BASE + the unit's id, so they never meet a walker's (a building id).
export const UNIT_ID_BASE = 100000;
export const ARROW_MS = 300;                 // a tower's arrow flies for 0.3 s
export const STILL_ARROW_MS = 600;           // under reduced motion it shows as a still line for this long
export const BAR = { w: 9, h: 1.8, lift: 27 };   // a health bar: art px wide and tall, and its height over the feet
export const BAR_COLOUR = { back: '#2A2230', raider: '#F08A70', soldier: '#7FD8CF' };
const ARROW = '#3E3040';

const tracks = new WeakMap();                // world -> Map(unit id -> { x, y, fromX, fromY, at, dir })
const volleys = new WeakMap();               // world -> { key, start }: when the day's tower shots were first drawn

const clamp01 = (v) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
const glide = (t, timeDays) => {
  const f = clamp01(timeDays - t.at);
  return { x: t.fromX + (t.x - t.fromX) * f, y: t.fromY + (t.y - t.fromY) * f };
};
const dirOf = (dx, dy) => (Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dy) ? (dx > 0 ? 1 : dx < 0 ? 3 : 2) : (dy > 0 ? 2 : 0));

// Every unit with the map point its feet stand on (tile centre), before gliding.
function standing(world) {
  const out = [];
  const active = world.raid && world.raid.active;
  if (active && active.raiders) for (const u of active.raiders) out.push({ u, kind: 'raider', x: u.x + 0.5, y: u.y + 0.5 });
  const waiting = new Map();                 // barracks id -> soldiers waiting in its yard so far
  for (const u of world.soldiers || []) {
    const b = world.buildings[u.barracks];
    const home = b && u.x >= b.x && u.x < b.x + b.w && u.y >= b.y && u.y < b.y + b.d;
    if (!home) { out.push({ u, kind: 'soldier', x: u.x + 0.5, y: u.y + 0.5 }); continue; }
    const rank = waiting.get(b.id) || 0;
    waiting.set(b.id, rank + 1);
    out.push({ u, kind: 'soldier', x: b.x + 0.35 + 0.42 * rank, y: b.y + b.d - 0.28 });
  }
  return out;
}

// The units as drawn at timeDays: each glides from where it was drawn when its spot last changed, over one game day.
function placed(world, timeDays) {
  let m = tracks.get(world);
  if (!m) { m = new Map(); tracks.set(world, m); }
  const seen = new Set(), out = [];
  for (const s of standing(world)) {
    seen.add(s.u.id);
    let t = m.get(s.u.id);
    if (!t) { t = { x: s.x, y: s.y, fromX: s.x, fromY: s.y, at: timeDays, dir: 2 }; m.set(s.u.id, t); }
    else if (t.x !== s.x || t.y !== s.y) {
      const now = glide(t, timeDays);
      Object.assign(t, { fromX: now.x, fromY: now.y, x: s.x, y: s.y, at: timeDays, dir: dirOf(s.x - now.x, s.y - now.y) });
    }
    out.push({ ...s, ...glide(t, timeDays), dir: t.dir });
  }
  for (const id of [...m.keys()]) if (!seen.has(id)) m.delete(id);
  return out;
}

const inRange = (x, y, r) => !r || (x >= r.x0 && x <= r.x1 + 1 && y >= r.y0 && y <= r.y1 + 1);

// The units in range as walker entries: { id: UNIT_ID_BASE + unit id, kind: 'raider' | 'soldier', x, y, dir }, moving
// smoothly between days (timeDays is the day plus the frame's fraction). Raiders come from world.raid.active, soldiers
// from world.soldiers.
export function unitsAt(world, timeDays, range = null) {
  const out = [];
  for (const s of placed(world, timeDays)) if (inRange(s.x, s.y, range)) out.push({ id: UNIT_ID_BASE + s.u.id, kind: s.kind, x: s.x, y: s.y, dir: s.dir });
  return out;
}

function healthBar(g, s) {
  const max = UNITS[s.kind].hp, share = clamp01(s.u.hp / max);
  const [x, y] = U(p(s.x, s.y), BAR.lift), w = BAR.w, h = BAR.h;
  const rect = (x0, x1) => [[x0, y - h / 2], [x1, y - h / 2], [x1, y + h / 2], [x0, y + h / 2]];
  g.poly(rect(x - w / 2 - 0.4, x + w / 2 + 0.4), BAR_COLOUR.back, { alpha: 0.8 });
  if (share > 0) g.poly(rect(x - w / 2, x - w / 2 + w * share), BAR_COLOUR[s.kind]);
}

// A tower shot's path in art px: from the tower's platform to the raider's chest.
function shotPath(shot) {
  const from = U(p(shot.from.x + 0.5, shot.from.y + 0.5), ART.tower.height - 6);
  const to = U(p(shot.to.x + 0.5, shot.to.y + 0.5), 10);
  return { from, to };
}

// Health bars over units that have been hit, and the day's tower arrows (world.raid.active.shots) as thin strokes that
// fly for ARROW_MS, or a still line for STILL_ARROW_MS under reduced motion. A new day's shots start a new volley.
export function drawUnitMarks(g, world, range, timeDays, now, { reducedMotion = false } = {}) {
  const active = world.raid && world.raid.active;
  const shots = (active && active.shots) || [];
  if (!active && !(world.soldiers && world.soldiers.length)) return;
  for (const s of placed(world, timeDays)) if (s.u.hit && inRange(s.x, s.y, range)) healthBar(g, s);
  if (!shots.length) return;
  const key = `${world.day}:${shots.length}`;
  let v = volleys.get(world);
  if (!v || v.key !== key) { v = { key, start: now }; volleys.set(world, v); }
  const age = now - v.start;
  for (const shot of shots) {
    const { from, to } = shotPath(shot);
    if (reducedMotion) {
      if (age < STILL_ARROW_MS) g.line(from, to, ARROW, 0.5, 0.6);
      continue;
    }
    if (age >= ARROW_MS) continue;
    const f = age / ARROW_MS, lift = 8 * f * (1 - f);
    const at = (k) => [from[0] + (to[0] - from[0]) * k, from[1] + (to[1] - from[1]) * k - 8 * k * (1 - k)];
    const head = [from[0] + (to[0] - from[0]) * f, from[1] + (to[1] - from[1]) * f - lift];
    const tail = at(Math.max(0, f - 0.18));
    g.line(tail, head, ARROW, 0.6);
    g.line(tail, [tail[0] + (tail[0] - head[0]) * 0.25, tail[1] + (tail[1] - head[1]) * 0.25], '#F6ECD6', 0.6, 0.9);   // the fletching
  }
}
```

### Task C4: Ambient life and the idle frame-rate cap

**Model hint:** opus (motion, budget and calm rules).

**Files:**
- Modify (replace the stub file): `src/render/ambient.js` — `createAmbient` (`draw`, `treeSlot`, `stats`), `createFrameGate`, `drawAmbientLate`, and the pure helpers its tests read: `glintAt`, `riverRows`, `reedTips`, `treeLean`, `windOf`, `rareAt`, `GLINT_STEPS`, `LEVEL_HOLD_MS`, `RESTORE_AFTER_MS`
- Modify: `src/data/ambient.js` — `treeLeanSteps: 4` (Track C tunes this file)
- Modify: `src/render/art/nature.js` — lean slots `palm.l-4` ... `palm.l4` and `acacia.l-4` ... `acacia.l4` for tree sway
- Modify: `src/render/fire.js` — `drawFires` first draws the frame's late ambient layer
- Create: `tests/stage3/art/ambient.test.js`; Modify: `tests/stage3/art.all.js`
- Modify: `sw-files.js` (regenerated)
- `src/render/loop.js` needs no change: Track 0's `allowFrame` already asks the gate before each draw.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `AMBIENT` (ruling 133's numbers), `riverSpans`, `riverBanks`, `smoothPath` (`terrainWater.js`), `isWorking`, `BIG` (`art/housing.js`: which homes have a yard pool), `ART`, `slotFor`, `hash2`; `createUI`'s `createAmbient({ enabled: () => settings.get().ambient && !settings.reducedMotion() })`, `opts.ambient: (g, r) => ambient.draw(g, world, r, t)`, `opts.fire` (`drawFires`, after the sprites) and `allowFrame: (t) => frameGate.allow(t, world.speed === 0)`.
- Produces (contract): `createAmbient({ enabled, clock })` → `{ draw(g, world, range, now), treeSlot(world, x, y, slot, now), stats: { ms, dropped } }` (`clock`, the real clock for the budget only, is an added option for tests; `treeSlot` is added for the renderer seam in this track's CONTRACT NOTE); `createFrameGate({ idleAfterMs, fpsCap })` → `{ noteInput(now), allow(now, paused) }`; `drawAmbientLate(g)`.

What it draws (spec 5.6, ruling 133), all on the real clock (so it carries on while paused), out of step by tile or building hash, for visible tiles only:
- **Ground layer** (`draw`, under the sprites): water glints on most river tiles, drifting downstream at 0.2 tiles a second and fading in and out over a 4-7 s life (batched into one stroke per alpha step, `GLINT_STEPS` = 12); a faint ripple line inside each bank shifting about 1 px back and forth over 5 s as a slow wave along the bank; two swaying blade tips (+-3 degrees over 3-6 s) over each reed clump the terrain bakes (`terrainWater.js` places them by the same hashes); rare life on the river: a felucca drifting downstream and three ducks by a bank.
- **Late layer** (`drawAmbientLate`, called by `drawFires` after the sprites, same frame only): a lighter band crossing each working grain, barley or flax field in the wind's direction every 6 s (clipped to the field, never over the farmhouse); a glint on each garden pool and Villa or Estate yard pool; smoke puffs (a new one every 2-3 s, each rising a tile and fading over two of those periods, leaning downwind) from a working potter's kiln, a working brewhouse and the roof of every lived-in Townhouse and up; a bird gliding across the view (no wing flapping: nothing changes direction more than once a second). A field or pool item is left out while something taller than a field stands just in front of it.
- **Rare life**: each kind's n-th appearance starts 0-30 s into its n-th 90 s window, so they come 60-120 s apart, and each lasts under 60 s (bird 9 s, ducks 24 s, felucca 40 s), so at most one of each is on screen.
- **Budget**: `stats.ms` is the last whole frame's cost (both layers); over `AMBIENT.budgetMs` on a running average it drops rare life, then smoke, then sway (`AMBIENT.dropOrder`; the water always stays), at most one kind every 2 s and never in the first 2 s; a dropped kind comes back only after 10 s under half the budget, so kinds never blink in and out. Measured on the stress city at laptop size in headless Edge: about 0.6 ms a frame.
- **Wind** is a direction per seed (`windOf`). **Idle cap**: paused, with no input for 2 s, a frame is allowed once 1000/30 ms (less 4 ms of slack) has passed since the last one drawn, so a 60 Hz or a 120 Hz display draws 30 a second.

```js
// A draw object that records its calls (and still draws), on its own canvas.
function spyDraw() {
  const g = makeDraw(makeCanvas(64, 64).getContext('2d'), 1);
  const calls = [];
  for (const k of ['line', 'stroke', 'poly', 'radial', 'path', 'circ', 'ell', 'clip']) {
    const f = g[k];
    g[k] = (...a) => { calls.push({ k, a }); return f(...a); };
  }
  return { g, calls };
}
// One whole frame: the ground layer, then the late layer as drawFires runs it after the sprites.
function frame(ambient, world, now, range = ALL) {
  const s = spyDraw();
  ambient.draw(s.g, world, range, now);
  const ground = s.calls.length;
  drawAmbientLate(s.g);
  return { ground: s.calls.slice(0, ground), late: s.calls.slice(ground) };
}
const on = () => createAmbient({ enabled: () => true });
// Direction changes in a sampled series (a sign change of its steps).

  let n = 0, last = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < series.length; i++) {
    const d = Math.sign(series[i] - series[i - 1]);
    if (d && last && d !== last) n++;
    if (d) last = d;
  }
  return n;
}

    const rows = riverRows(w, 0, 31);

    for (let t = 0; t <= 12000; t += 100) {
      const tips = angles(t);
      tips.forEach((tip, i) => { maxDeg = Math.max(maxDeg, Math.abs(Math.atan2(tip[0] - bases[i][0], bases[i][1] - tip[1]) * 180 / Math.PI)); });
      firstTip.push(tips[0][0]);
    }
    expect(maxDeg).toBeLessThanOrEqual(AMBIENT.reedSwayDeg + 1e-9);
    expect(maxDeg).toBeGreaterThan(AMBIENT.reedSwayDeg * 0.9);
    expect(turns(firstTip)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);                          // 12 s at 3-6 s a sway
    expect(turns(firstTip)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(8);
    const lean = [];
    for (let t = 0; t <= 12000; t += 100) lean.push(treeLean(w, 5, 9, t));
    expect(Math.max(...lean.map(Math.abs))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(AMBIENT.treeSwayDeg);
    expect([turns(lean) >= 3, turns(lean) <= 6]).toEqual([true, true]);
    expect(treeLean(w, 5, 9, 3000) === treeLean(w, 6, 9, 3000)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('picks a tree\'s lean slot for the depth pass, or the still tree while ambient motion is off', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    const a = on();
    const slots = new Set();
    for (let t = 0; t < 6000; t += 100) slots.add(a.treeSlot(w, 5, 9, 'palm', t));
    for (const s of slots) expect([s, Boolean(ART[s] && ART[s].draw)]).toEqual([s, true]);
    expect(slots.size).toBeGreaterThan(5);
    expect([...slots].every((s) => s === 'palm' || /^palm\.l-?[1-4]$/.test(s))).toBe(true);
    expect(createAmbient({ enabled: () => false }).treeSlot(w, 5, 9, 'acacia', 1234)).toBe('acacia');
  });
  it('runs a lighter band across a working field in the wind\'s direction every 6 s, and over no field that is idle or hidden', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    const farm = w.buildings[w.occ[10 * 32 + 8]];
    const band = (now) => frame(on(), w, now).late.find((c) => c.k === 'poly' && c.a[1] === '#FBF3C6');
    const centre = (c) => c.a[0].reduce((s, q) => [s[0] + q[0] / 4, s[1] + q[1] / 4], [0, 0]);
    const wind = windOf(w);
    const a = band(1000), b = band(1400);
    expect([Boolean(a), Boolean(b)]).toEqual([true, true]);
    const moved = [centre(b)[0] - centre(a)[0], centre(b)[1] - centre(a)[1]];
    const windArt = [(wind.x - wind.y) * 16, (wind.x + wind.y) * 8];
    expect(moved[0] * windArt[0] + moved[1] * windArt[1]).toBeGreaterThan(0);   // downwind
    expect(centre(band(1000 + AMBIENT.cropBandEveryMs))).toEqual(centre(a));
    farm.staff = 0;
    expect(band(1000)).toBe(undefined);
    staffAll(w);
    addRaw(w, 'house', farm.x + 2, farm.y + 1, { tier: 5, residents: 10 });        // a Townhouse just in front of the field
    expect(band(1000)).toBe(undefined);
  });
  it('puffs smoke from working kilns and the brewhouse and lived-in Townhouses and up, rising and fading smoothly', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    setRoad(w, 26, 16, 26, 30);
    const potter = addRaw(w, 'potter', 27, 18);
    addRaw(w, 'house', 27, 22, { tier: 4, residents: 10 });
    staffAll(w);
    const puffs = (now) => frame(on(), w, now).late.filter((c) => c.k === 'radial').map((c) => c.a[4]);
    expect(puffs(1000).length).toBe(2);                                          // the kiln's two puffs; a House has no chimney smoke
    addRaw(w, 'house', 27, 24, { tier: 5, residents: 10 });
    expect(puffs(1000).length).toBe(4);
    potter.staff = 0;
    expect(puffs(1000).length).toBe(2);
    let prev = null;
    for (let t = 0; t < 8000; t += 16) {
      const now = puffs(t);
      if (prev) now.forEach((al, i) => expect([t, i, Math.abs(al - prev[i]) < 0.05]).toEqual([t, i, true]));
      prev = now;
    }
  });
  it('brings each kind of rare life at most one at a time, 60 to 120 s apart', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    for (const kind of AMBIENT.rareKinds) {
      const starts = [];
      let was = false;
      for (let t = 0; t < 30 * 60000; t += 250) {
        const a = rareAt(w, kind, t);
        if (a && !was) starts.push(t);
        was = Boolean(a);
      }
      expect([kind, starts.length >= 15]).toEqual([kind, true]);
      for (let i = 1; i < starts.length; i++) {
        const gap = starts[i] - starts[i - 1];
        expect([kind, gap >= 60000 - 250 && gap <= 120000 + 250]).toEqual([kind, true]);

  it('keeps to its budget: over it, drops rare life, then smoke, then sway, keeps the water, and brings them back after a calm spell', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    let cost = 3, t = 0;
    const a = createAmbient({ enabled: () => true, clock: () => (t += cost) });
    const run = (ms, step = 16) => { let f = null; for (let n = 0; n < ms; n += step) { now += step; f = frame(a, w, now); } return f; };
    let now = 0;
    run(LEVEL_HOLD_MS - 100);
    expect(a.stats.dropped).toEqual([]);                                         // never at once
    run(200);
    expect(a.stats.dropped).toEqual(['rare']);
    run(LEVEL_HOLD_MS);
    expect(a.stats.dropped).toEqual(['rare', 'smoke']);
    const last = run(LEVEL_HOLD_MS);
    expect(a.stats.dropped).toEqual(['rare', 'smoke', 'sway']);
    expect(last.ground.filter((c) => c.k === 'stroke').length).toBeGreaterThan(2);   // the water stays
    run(LEVEL_HOLD_MS * 2);
    expect(a.stats.dropped).toEqual(['rare', 'smoke', 'sway']);
    cost = 0.1;
    run(RESTORE_AFTER_MS - 1000);
    expect(a.stats.dropped.length).toBe(3);                                      // not back yet: no blinking in and out
    run(2000);
    expect(a.stats.dropped).toEqual(['rare', 'smoke']);
    expect(a.stats.ms).toBeLessThan(AMBIENT.budgetMs);
  });
  it('draws the late layer once, for its own frame only', () => {
    const w = riverWorld();
    setRoad(w, 26, 16, 26, 30);

    staffAll(w);

    const one = spyDraw(), two = spyDraw();
    a.draw(one.g, w, ALL, 1000);

    const after = one.calls.length;
    drawAmbientLate(one.g);
    expect(one.calls.length).toBe(after);

  it('costs well under its budget on the stress city at laptop size (a mid-range phone is slower; the drop order covers it)', () => {
    const world = buildStressCity(createWorld({ seed: 3 }));
    const renderer = createRenderer({ canvas: makeCanvas(1280, 800), dpr: 1, maxBakesPerFrame: Infinity });
    const cam = createCamera({ x: 32, y: 32, zoom: 0.75 });

      if (i >= 10) ms.push(a.stats.ms);
    }
    ms.sort((x, y) => x - y);

  });
});

describe('s3 art frame gate', () => {
  it('caps frames at 30 a second once the game is paused and idle for 2 s, never while it runs or just after input', () => {
    const gate = createFrameGate();
    const count = (from, frames, paused) => { let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) if (gate.allow(from + (i * 1000) / 60, paused)) n++; return n; };
    expect(count(0, 60, false)).toBe(60);                                        // running: every frame of a 60 Hz second
    gate.noteInput(1000);

    const idle = count(3000, 60, true);

    expect(count(4500, 30, false)).toBe(30);
```

```js
// Ambient life (spec 5.6): water glints, bank ripples, reed and tree sway, crop ripple, smoke, and rare birds, feluccas
// and ducks, on the real clock, out of step by tile hash, over the baked terrain for visible tiles only. Numbers in
// src/data/ambient.js. Stage 3 contract: createUI makes one per game and passes its draw to renderFrame as
// opts.ambient, which calls it once a frame in art px right after the terrain chunks.
//
// Two layers. The ground layer (glints and ripples on the river, swaying reed tips, a felucca and ducks) is drawn by
// draw(), under the sprites. What must show over buildings (crop bands on working fields, glints on garden and villa
// pools, chimney and kiln smoke, a bird crossing) is the late layer: draw() leaves it for drawAmbientLate(g), which
// drawFires (render/fire.js, opts.fire, right after the sprites) calls with the same frame's draw object, so it runs
// in the same frame or not at all. A late item at a field or pool is left out while something taller than a field
// stands just in front of it (it would show through that building).
//
// Calm (spec 5.4, 5.6): every motion is slow and smooth; a glint or puff fades in and out over seconds; nothing
// changes direction or brightness more than once a second. Rare life and the drop order keep the frame inside its
// budget: over AMBIENT.budgetMs (a running average), rare life goes first, then smoke, then sway; the water stays.
// A dropped kind returns only after RESTORE_AFTER_MS well under budget, so kinds never blink in and out.
import { AMBIENT } from '../data/ambient.js';
import { hash2 } from '../sim/rng.js';
import { idx, inBounds } from '../sim/grid.js';
import { isWorking } from '../sim/labour.js';
import { p, U } from './iso.js';
import { riverSpans, riverBanks, smoothPath } from './terrainWater.js';
import { ART, slotFor } from './art/registry.js';
import { BIG } from './art/housing.js';
import { TERRAIN, WOOD, SHADOW } from './art/palette.js';

export const LEVEL_HOLD_MS = 2000;           // the budget can drop one more kind at most this often
export const RESTORE_AFTER_MS = 10000;       // and brings one back only after this long at under half the budget
const FIELDS = ['farm_grain', 'farm_barley', 'farm_flax'];
const SMOKE_FROM = { potter: [1.52, 0.52, 9], brewery: [0.66, 0.46, 10] };   // tile offsets and art height of the kiln and brewhouse
const RARE_WINDOW_MS = 90000;                // one appearance per kind per window, starting 0-30 s in: 60-120 s apart
const RARE_MS = { bird: 9000, felucca: 40000, ducks: 24000 };
const SALT = { glint: 501, ripple: 502, reed: 503, tree: 504, crop: 505, pool: 506, smoke: 507, rare: 508, wind: 509 };

// The idle frame rate (spec 5.6): paused, with no input for idleAfterMs, frames are capped at fpsCap. createUI notes every
// pointer, key and wheel input and the game loop asks allow(now, paused) before drawing a frame (it still runs the sim).
// A frame is allowed once 1000 / fpsCap ms (less a few ms of slack, so a 60 Hz display draws every second frame) have
// passed since the last one drawn.
export function createFrameGate({ idleAfterMs = AMBIENT.idleAfterMs, fpsCap = AMBIENT.idleFpsCap } = {}) {
  let lastInput = -Infinity, lastDrawn = -Infinity;
  const gap = 1000 / fpsCap - 4;
  return {
    noteInput(now) { lastInput = now; },
    allow(now, paused) {
      if (!paused || now - lastInput < idleAfterMs || now - lastDrawn >= gap) { lastDrawn = now; return true; }
      return false;
    },
  };
}

const unit = (a, b, c) => hash2(a, b, c);               // 0..1, stateless
const between = ([lo, hi], h) => lo + (hi - lo) * h;
const wave = (now, period, phase) => Math.sin((2 * Math.PI * now) / period + phase * 2 * Math.PI);

// The wind (spec 5.6: fixed per seed), as a unit vector in tile space.
export function windOf(world) {
  const a = unit(world.seed | 0, 0, SALT.wind) * 2 * Math.PI;
  return { x: Math.cos(a), y: Math.sin(a) };
}

// A tree's lean in degrees at time now: +-AMBIENT.treeSwayDeg over 4-6 s, out of step by tile.
export function treeLean(world, x, y, now) {
  const period = between(AMBIENT.treeSwayPeriodMs, unit(x, y, (world.seed | 0) + SALT.tree));
  return AMBIENT.treeSwayDeg * wave(now, period, unit(y, x, (world.seed | 0) + SALT.tree));
}

// The river's rows in [y0, y1] as row -> { left, right, centre, width } in tile x (the drawn banks, wobble included).
export function riverRows(world, y0, y1) {
  const rows = new Map();
  const { left, right, centre } = riverBanks(world, y0, y1);
  for (let i = 0; i < left.length; i++) rows.set(left[i][1] - 0.5, { left: left[i][0], right: right[i][0], centre: centre[i][0], width: centre[i][2] });
  return rows;
}

// River tile (x, y)'s glint at time now (most tiles have one): { x, y } in tiles and its alpha, or null. Each glint lives
// 4-7 s, drifting downstream (+y) at AMBIENT.glintDriftTilesPerSecond and fading in and out, then starts again.
export function glintAt(world, x, y, now, rows) {
  const seed = world.seed | 0, h = unit(x, y, seed + SALT.glint);
  if (h > 0.7) return null;
  const life = between(AMBIENT.glintFadeMs, unit(y, x, seed + SALT.glint));
  const t = ((now + h * life * 7) % life) / life;
  const gy = y + 0.2 + unit(x + 7, y, seed) * 0.6 + AMBIENT.glintDriftTilesPerSecond * (t * life) / 1000;
  const row = rows.get(Math.floor(gy));
  if (!row) return null;
  const gx = Math.min(row.right - 0.35, Math.max(row.left + 0.35, x + 0.2 + unit(x, y + 7, seed) * 0.6));
  return { x: gx, y: gy, alpha: 0.75 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t) };
}

// Water glints: short pale strokes on the river's tiles in range. Strokes are batched into one path per step of
// GLINT_STEPS alpha steps (one stroke call each, not one per glint), so a glint's fade moves in small even steps.
export const GLINT_STEPS = 12;
function drawGlints(g, world, range, now, rows) {
  const spans = riverSpans(world), buckets = [];
  for (let y = Math.max(0, range.y0); y <= Math.min(world.size - 1, range.y1); y++) {
    const s = spans[y];
    if (!s) continue;
    for (let x = Math.max(s[0], range.x0); x <= Math.min(s[1], range.x1); x++) {
      const gl = glintAt(world, x, y, now, rows);
      if (!gl) continue;
      const k = Math.round((gl.alpha / 0.75) * GLINT_STEPS);
      if (k <= 0) continue;
      const q = p(gl.x, gl.y);
      (buckets[k] || (buckets[k] = [])).push(['M', [q[0] - 2.2, q[1] + 0.4]], ['L', [q[0] + 2.2, q[1] - 0.4]]);
    }
  }
  for (let k = 1; k <= GLINT_STEPS; k++) if (buckets[k]) g.stroke(buckets[k], TERRAIN.foam, 0.7, (0.75 * k) / GLINT_STEPS);
}

// Bank ripples: a faint line just inside each bank, shifting about a pixel back and forth over 5 s, out of step along it.
function drawRipples(g, rows, now) {
  const shift = AMBIENT.rippleShiftPx / 18;  // art px across the bank, in tiles
  for (const side of ['left', 'right']) {
    const pts = [];
    for (const [y, r] of rows) pts.push([r[side] + (side === 'left' ? 0.32 : -0.32) + shift * wave(now, AMBIENT.ripplePeriodMs, y * 0.13), y + 0.5]);
    if (pts.length > 1) g.stroke(smoothPath(pts), TERRAIN.ripple, 0.6, 0.45);
  }
}

// Reed tips: over each baked clump (terrainWater.js places them by the same hashes), two blades swaying +-3 degrees,
// out of step by clump; one stroke call per blade colour.
const REED_BLADES = [[-1.2, 6, '#4F8A2E'], [1.2, 7, '#6AA83A']];
export function reedTips(world, range, now, rows) {
  const seed = world.seed | 0, spans = riverSpans(world), out = REED_BLADES.map(() => []);
  for (const [y, r] of rows) {
    if (y < range.y0 || y > range.y1) continue;
    const s = spans[y], w = r.left - s[0] + 0.05;
    for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
      const t = 0.15 + hash2(y, j, seed) * 0.7;
      const clumps = [];
      if (hash2(y, j + 4, seed) > 0.35) clumps.push(p(s[0] - 0.12 + w, y + t));
      if (hash2(y, j + 8, seed) > 0.35) clumps.push(p(s[1] + 1.12 + w, y + t));
      for (const q of clumps) {
        const k = unit(Math.round(q[0]), Math.round(q[1]), seed + SALT.reed);
        const a = ((AMBIENT.reedSwayDeg * wave(now, between(AMBIENT.reedSwayPeriodMs, k), k * 3.1)) * Math.PI) / 180;
        REED_BLADES.forEach(([dx, len], i) => {
          const base = [q[0] + dx, q[1] - 2.5];
          out[i].push(['M', base], ['L', [base[0] + Math.sin(a) * len, base[1] - Math.cos(a) * len]]);
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}
function drawReeds(g, world, range, now, rows) {
  reedTips(world, range, now, rows).forEach((segs, i) => { if (segs.length) g.stroke(segs, REED_BLADES[i][2], 0.7); });
}

const inRange = (b, r) => b.x <= r.x1 && b.x + b.w - 1 >= r.x0 && b.y <= r.y1 && b.y + b.d - 1 >= r.y0;

// Whether anything taller than a field stands on the tiles just in front of b's footprint (it would cover a late item).
function screened(world, b) {
  const tall = (x, y) => {
    if (!inBounds(world.size, x, y)) return false;
    const o = world.occ[idx(world.size, x, y)];
    const def = o ? ART[slotFor(world.buildings[o], world)] : null;
    return Boolean(def && def.height > 12);
  };
  for (let j = 0; j <= b.d; j++) if (tall(b.x + b.w, b.y + j)) return true;
  for (let i = 0; i < b.w; i++) if (tall(b.x + i, b.y + b.d)) return true;
  return false;
}

// Crop ripple: a lighter band crossing a working field in the wind's direction every AMBIENT.cropBandEveryMs.
function drawCrops(g, world, b, now, wind) {
  const P = AMBIENT.cropBandEveryMs, t = ((now + unit(b.id, 0, SALT.crop) * P) % P) / P;
  const X = b.x, Y = b.y, z = 2.2, c = 1.35;
  g.save();
  g.clip([U(p(X, Y), z), U(p(X + 2, Y), z), U(p(X + 2, Y + c), z), U(p(X + c, Y + c), z), U(p(X + c, Y + 2), z), U(p(X, Y + 2), z)]);
  const s = -0.6 + t * 3.2;                                  // the band's distance along the wind from the field's upwind corner
  const ox = X + 1 - wind.x * 1.6 + wind.x * s, oy = Y + 1 - wind.y * 1.6 + wind.y * s;
  const nx = -wind.y * 2, ny = wind.x * 2, hw = 0.16;
  g.poly([U(p(ox - nx - wind.x * hw, oy - ny - wind.y * hw), z), U(p(ox + nx - wind.x * hw, oy + ny - wind.y * hw), z),
    U(p(ox + nx + wind.x * hw, oy + ny + wind.y * hw), z), U(p(ox - nx + wind.x * hw, oy - ny + wind.y * hw), z)], '#FBF3C6', { alpha: 0.22 });
  g.restore();
}

// A glint on a pool (gardens; Villas and Estates, whose yard has one): it drifts a little and fades in and out.
function drawPoolGlint(g, b, rect, now) {
  const [u, v, w, d] = rect, life = between(AMBIENT.glintFadeMs, unit(b.id, 1, SALT.pool));
  const t = ((now + unit(b.id, 2, SALT.pool) * life) % life) / life;
  const q = p(b.x + u + w * (0.3 + 0.4 * t), b.y + v + d * 0.5);
  g.line([q[0] - 1.4, q[1] + 0.3], [q[0] + 1.4, q[1] - 0.3], TERRAIN.foam, 0.6, 0.85 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t));
}

// Smoke: puffs from a working kiln or brewhouse, or the roof of a lived-in Townhouse and up, one every 2-3 s, each
// rising about a tile and fading over two of those periods, leaning with the wind.
function drawSmoke(g, b, base, now, wind) {
  const P = between(AMBIENT.smokeEveryMs, unit(b.id, 3, SALT.smoke)), off = unit(b.id, 4, SALT.smoke) * P;
  const rise = 16 * AMBIENT.smokeRiseTiles;
  for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
    const a = ((now + off) / (2 * P) + k / 2) % 1;          // this puff's age, 0 to 1 over its life of 2P: a new one every P
    const alpha = 0.42 * Math.min(1, a / 0.15) * (1 - a);
    const r = 1.6 + a * 2.6;
    const drift = p(wind.x * a * 0.3, wind.y * a * 0.3);
    g.radial([base[0] + drift[0], base[1] - 2 - rise * a + drift[1]], r, r * 0.8, '#F4F0F2', alpha);
  }
}

function smokeBase(world, b) {
  const at = SMOKE_FROM[b.type];
  if (at) return isWorking(world, b) ? U(p(b.x + at[0], b.y + at[1]), at[2]) : null;
  if (b.type === 'house' && b.tier >= 5 && b.residents > 0) {
    const def = ART[slotFor(b, world)];
    return U(p(b.x + b.w * 0.3, b.y + b.d * 0.3), Math.round(def.height * 0.8));
  }
  return null;
}

// The art box of the visible range, for rare life that crosses the view.
function artBox(range) {
  const pts = [p(range.x0, range.y0), p(range.x1 + 1, range.y0), p(range.x1 + 1, range.y1 + 1), p(range.x0, range.y1 + 1)];
  return { l: Math.min(...pts.map((q) => q[0])), r: Math.max(...pts.map((q) => q[0])), t: Math.min(...pts.map((q) => q[1])), b: Math.max(...pts.map((q) => q[1])) };
}

// Rare life on a fixed schedule from the real clock and the seed: kind k's n-th appearance starts 0-30 s into its n-th
// 90 s window and lasts RARE_MS[k], so at most one of each is on screen and they come 60-120 s apart. Returns the
// appearance under way as { t (0..1 through it), h (its own hash) }, or null.
export function rareAt(world, kind, now) {
  const k = AMBIENT.rareKinds.indexOf(kind) + 1, n = Math.floor(now / RARE_WINDOW_MS);
  const start = n * RARE_WINDOW_MS + unit(n, k, (world.seed | 0) + SALT.rare) * 30000;
  const t = (now - start) / RARE_MS[kind];
  return t >= 0 && t < 1 ? { t, h: unit(n, k + 10, (world.seed | 0) + SALT.rare) } : null;
}

function drawBird(g, box, a) {
  const fromLeft = a.h < 0.5, x = fromLeft ? box.l + (box.r - box.l) * a.t : box.r - (box.r - box.l) * a.t;
  const y = box.t + (box.b - box.t) * (0.2 + 0.4 * a.h) - Math.sin(Math.PI * a.t) * 6;
  const dir = fromLeft ? 1 : -1;
  g.ell([x, y + 14], 2.4, 0.8, SHADOW, { alpha: 0.12 });
  g.stroke([['M', [x - 3.2, y - 1.2]], ['Q', [x - 1.4, y - 2], [x, y]], ['Q', [x + 1.4, y - 2], [x + 3.2, y - 1.2]]], '#3A3040', 0.6);
  g.circ([x + dir * 0.4, y - 0.2], 0.5, '#3A3040');
}

function drawFelucca(g, rows, range, a) {
  const ys = [...rows.keys()].filter((y) => y >= range.y0 && y <= range.y1 - 8);
  if (!ys.length) return;
  const y = ys[Math.floor(a.h * ys.length)] + 8 * a.t;     // downstream at about AMBIENT.glintDriftTilesPerSecond
  const row = rows.get(Math.floor(y));
  if (!row) return;
  const q = p(row.centre, y);
  g.ell([q[0] + 1, q[1] + 1.2], 6, 1.6, SHADOW, { alpha: 0.18 });
  g.path([['M', [q[0] - 5.5, q[1] - 1]], ['Q', [q[0], q[1] + 2.6], [q[0] + 5.5, q[1] - 1.6]], ['L', [q[0] + 3.5, q[1] - 0.2]], ['L', [q[0] - 4, q[1] + 0.4]], ['Z']], WOOD, { outline: true });
  g.line([q[0], q[1] - 0.2], [q[0] + 0.4, q[1] - 11], '#5A4030', 0.5);
  g.path([['M', [q[0] + 0.4, q[1] - 11.5]], ['Q', [q[0] + 4.6, q[1] - 6], [q[0] + 4.4, q[1] - 1.6]], ['L', [q[0] - 2.6, q[1] - 1.8]], ['Z']], '#F7F2E8', { outline: true });
}

function drawDucks(g, rows, range, a) {
  const ys = [...rows.keys()].filter((y) => y >= range.y0 && y <= range.y1);
  if (!ys.length) return;
  const y = ys[Math.floor(a.h * ys.length)], row = rows.get(y), left = a.h < 0.5;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const x = left ? row.left + 0.3 + i * 0.12 : row.right - 0.3 - i * 0.12;
    const q = p(x, y + 0.3 + 0.4 * a.t + i * 0.15);
    g.ell([q[0], q[1]], 1.6, 0.8, '#8A6A4A', { outline: true });
    g.circ([q[0] + (left ? -1.2 : 1.2), q[1] - 1.2], 0.7, '#2E5E3A');
    g.ell([q[0], q[1] + 0.9], 2.2, 0.5, TERRAIN.ripple, { alpha: 0.4 });
  }
}

const lateByG = new WeakMap();               // the frame's draw object -> its late layer

// The late layer of the frame g belongs to (crop bands, pool glints, smoke, birds), drawn once; render/fire.js calls it
// right after the sprites. Does nothing for a frame without one.
export function drawAmbientLate(g) {
  if (!g) return;
  const fn = lateByG.get(g);
  if (!fn) return;
  lateByG.delete(g);
  fn();
}

// enabled() says whether to draw at all: the Ambient motion setting and not reduced motion (createUI decides).
// clock() is the real clock in ms, for the frame budget only.
export function createAmbient({ enabled = () => true, clock = () => performance.now() } = {}) {
  let level = 0, avg = null, lastChange = -Infinity, calmSince = null;
  let pending = null;                        // this frame's ground cost, until its late layer adds its own
  const stats = { ms: 0, dropped: [] };

  function account(ms, now) {
    if (lastChange === -Infinity) lastChange = now;   // a cold first frame (caches warming) never drops a kind at once
    stats.ms = ms;
    avg = avg === null ? ms : avg * 0.8 + ms * 0.2;
    const order = AMBIENT.dropOrder;
    if (avg > AMBIENT.budgetMs) {
      calmSince = null;
      if (level < order.length && now - lastChange >= LEVEL_HOLD_MS) { level++; lastChange = now; avg = AMBIENT.budgetMs * 0.75; }
    } else if (avg < AMBIENT.budgetMs / 2 && level > 0) {
      if (calmSince === null) calmSince = now;
      if (now - calmSince >= RESTORE_AFTER_MS && now - lastChange >= LEVEL_HOLD_MS) { level--; lastChange = now; calmSince = now; }
    } else calmSince = null;
    stats.dropped = order.slice(0, level);
  }

  function draw(g, world, range, now) {
    if (pending) { account(pending.ms, pending.now); pending = null; }   // the last frame had no late layer
    if (!enabled() || !g || !range) return;
    const started = clock();
    const off = new Set(AMBIENT.dropOrder.slice(0, level));
    const rows = riverRows(world, range.y0 - 2, range.y1 + 2);
    const wind = windOf(world);
    if (rows.size) {
      drawGlints(g, world, range, now, rows);
      drawRipples(g, rows, now);
      if (!off.has('sway')) drawReeds(g, world, range, now, rows);
      if (!off.has('rare')) {
        const boat = rareAt(world, 'felucca', now), ducks = rareAt(world, 'ducks', now);
        if (boat) drawFelucca(g, rows, range, boat);
        if (ducks) drawDucks(g, rows, range, ducks);
      }
    }
    pending = { ms: clock() - started, now };
    lateByG.set(g, () => {
      const lateStart = clock();
      for (const id in world.buildings) {
        const b = world.buildings[id];
        if (!inRange(b, range)) continue;
        if (FIELDS.includes(b.type) && !off.has('sway') && isWorking(world, b) && !screened(world, b)) drawCrops(g, world, b, now, wind);
        else if (b.type === 'garden' && !screened(world, b)) drawPoolGlint(g, b, [0.2, 0.56, 0.36, 0.28], now);
        else if (b.type === 'house' && BIG[b.tier] && BIG[b.tier].pool && !screened(world, b)) drawPoolGlint(g, b, [0.32, 1.24, 0.6, 0.3], now);
        if (!off.has('smoke')) {
          const base = smokeBase(world, b);
          if (base) drawSmoke(g, b, base, now, wind);
        }
      }
      if (!off.has('rare')) {
        const bird = rareAt(world, 'bird', now);
        if (bird) drawBird(g, artBox(range), bird);
      }
      const ms = (pending ? pending.ms : 0) + clock() - lateStart;
      pending = null;
      account(ms, now);
    });
  }

  // The art slot a tree shows at time now: its lean slot (palm.l-4 ... palm.l4, art/nature.js), or the still slot while ambient
  // motion is off or sway is dropped. For the renderer's depth pass (see the Stage 3 plan's contract note: a seam the
  // renderer does not have yet).
  function treeSlot(world, x, y, slot, now) {
    if (!enabled() || level >= AMBIENT.dropOrder.indexOf('sway') + 1) return slot;
    const k = Math.round((treeLean(world, x, y, now) / AMBIENT.treeSwayDeg) * AMBIENT.treeLeanSteps);
    return k ? `${slot}.l${k}` : slot;
  }

  return { draw, treeSlot, stats };
}
```

```js
};

// Lean slots for ambient sway (spec 5.6, render/ambient.js treeSlot): each tree again, leant k steps of
// AMBIENT.treeSwayDeg / AMBIENT.treeLeanSteps degrees about the foot of its trunk (k from -steps to steps, not 0).
function leant(draw, deg) {
  return (g, x, y) => {
    const base = p(x + 0.5, y + 0.5), a = (deg * Math.PI) / 180, s = g.scale;
    g.save();
    g.ctx.translate(base[0] * s, base[1] * s);
    g.ctx.rotate(a);
    g.ctx.translate(-base[0] * s, -base[1] * s);
    draw(g, x, y);
    g.restore();
  };
}
for (const slot of ['palm', 'acacia']) {
  const def = NATURE_ART[slot], [l, t, r, b] = def.bounds;
  for (let k = -AMBIENT.treeLeanSteps; k <= AMBIENT.treeLeanSteps; k++) {
    if (k) NATURE_ART[`${slot}.l${k}`] = { ...def, bounds: [l - 2, t - 1, r + 2, b], draw: leant(def.draw, (k * AMBIENT.treeSwayDeg) / AMBIENT.treeLeanSteps) };
  }
}
```
