# Track D: interface and sound

CONTRACT NOTE: `src/ui/text.js` is one ES module, so every track's section shares its top-level scope. Two tracks that each declare the same top-level name in their sections (a `const dirWord`, a `function durationText`, or the same import such as `import { FIRE } from '../data/fire.js'`) make the merged file a SyntaxError and the whole game fails to load. Track D starts every top-level name in its section with `dui` and renames its imports with `as` (`import { FIRE as duiFire }`); imports are hoisted, so they sit inside the section and the shared lines at the top of the file stay untouched. The controller should ask Tracks A, B, C and E to do the same (each with its own prefix) before they merge.
CONTRACT NOTE: Track 0's comment in Track A's text section lists "the fire row" among A's words, but the tracks table gives the fire row to D3 (spec 4.12's table of fire-row cases). Track D words the fire row in `DANGER_UI_TEXT`; Track A should not add fire-row words.
CONTRACT NOTE: Track 0's comment in Track B's text section lists "directions" and "the report" among B's words, while the contract's alerts paragraph gives D the captions and D3 the summary's report. Track D words the direction names, the countdown, the raid report (from `raid.last`'s contracted fields) and every tribute and festival sentence itself, so it can test them before B lands; B words only its `ALERT_TEXT` codes, `REASONS` and mood rows. If B also adds report words, the integrator keeps D's.
CONTRACT NOTE: `createUI` passes the sheet parts as `[danger.sheetParts, scoreUi.sheetParts]`, so in the summary D's last raid report comes before E's score section; the contract's prose says E's first. Nothing in Track D depends on the order; the controller can swap the array in `createUI.js` if the spec's order matters.
CONTRACT NOTE: `createUI`'s `viewAlert` (contract-owned) opens the summary for any alert without a building, which is wrong for a raid's alert (a map point). Track D handles View for point alerts itself: the banner calls `alerts.action(alert, 'view')` and `danger.onAlertAction` moves the camera; the minimap sheet's list (sheets.js, D's) does the same. Welcome back's alert list (Track E's `welcomeBack.js`) still goes through `viewAlert`, so a raid alert's View there opens the summary until E or the controller routes it through `alerts.action`.
CONTRACT NOTE: The contract gives a barracks' training no unit (`b.progress` is Track B's), so the barracks sheet shows "Soldiers 3 of 4" and the training rule from the data, not spec 6.3's "next in 12 days"; and `raid.last` holds only the city's `byTowers` and `bySoldiers`, so "what it stopped in the last raid" is worded for the towers (or soldiers) together.
CONTRACT NOTE: Spec 6.3 asks for `role="alert"` on critical alerts, but Stage 2's `tests/ui/alerts.test.js` pins that banner rows carry no role (`#live` is the one announcer, so nothing is read twice). Track D keeps that single announcer.
CONTRACT NOTE: The fire-risk legend says "A staffed firehouse reaches it" and "No staffed firehouse reaches it" (spec: "a firehouse reaches it"), because the dot follows `staffedCover`, as the fire row, the problem markers and the critical `fire` alert do. A firehouse under half staffed cuts risk but cannot put a blaze out, so a plain "reaches it" would contradict the fire row.
CONTRACT NOTE: Ruling 111 (the legend shrinks to an icon under a banner) replaces the Stage 2 behaviour of ruling 64 (the desirability scale keeps its words under a banner) on phones; Task D1 updates the two Stage 2 tests that pinned it.

## Track D: Interface and sound

**Track:** D, `ui`, test prefix `s3 ui`, worktree `C:\dev\thebes-s3-ui` on branch `s3-ui`, cut from the Track 0 commit. Every command below runs from the worktree's root.

**What it builds:** the three alert tiers with one ranked banner, "+N more", rolled-up fires and the raid warning's countdown chip, Pay tribute, minimap point pins and the legend's icon under a banner (D1); the On a fire reactions, captions, the raid horn, the coin tick, the well's ripple and the Settings rows (D2); the tribute sheet, the fire row, the firehouse, tower, barracks and rubble rows, the temple's festival and the summary's raid report (D3); the fire-risk overlay and its legend, the firehouse's placing words, the wall tool's words and gate ghosts, and the rubble demolish bar (D4).

**Files:** `src/ui/alerts.js`, `minimap.js`, `overlayUi.js`, `sheets.js`, `danger.js`, a new `src/ui/dangerSheets.js` (D3; Track D's own file, imported only by `danger.js`), `menu.js`, `placement.js`, `confirmBar.js`, `src/render/overlays.js`, `src/render/effects.js`, `src/data/ui.js` (`AUTO_OVERLAY` only), Track D's sections of `src/ui/text.js` and `css/ui.css`, `tests/stage3/ui.all.js` and `tests/stage3/ui/*.test.js`, plus three Stage 2 test files whose pinned lists D changes (`tests/ui/overlaysStage2.test.js`, `tests/ui/overlayUi.test.js`, `tests/render/overlays.test.js`).

**Verified:** every task below was applied in order to a copy of the repository with Track 0 applied, and each task's tests and the full suite were run from that copy: 993, 1001, 1009 and 1018 tests, `ALL PASSED` after D1, D2, D3 and D4. The code is that code.

**How the words follow the sim:** every sentence the danger interface shows is computed from the sim's own function, and the tests set the world up both ways: the defence line and the tribute sheet from `tributeQuote`/`payTribute`, the fire row from `staffedCover`, `fireBand` and the firehouses whose road reach takes the building in, the festival button from `festivalStatus`, the rubble words from `rubbleCostOf` and `previewDemolishArea`, the firehouse's placing line from `fireCoverage`'s own reach test, the wall line from `previewWall`'s shape. Where a rule belongs to Track A or B and is still a STUB, the tests set the world's state by hand to the contract's shapes (a `raid.warning`, a `raid.last`, a `b.fire`, a soldier) and never assert a STUB's default beyond the contract's own `previewWall` refusal.

```js
import { rigUI } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';

function rig() {
  const { root, cleanup } = mount('<div id="banner"></div><p id="live"></p>');
  const world = makeTestWorld({ gold: 1000 });
  setRoad(world, 0, 10, 31, 10);
  const potter = addRaw(world, 'potter', 2, 11);
  const granary = addRaw(world, 'granary', 6, 11);
  const farm = addRaw(world, 'farm_grain', 2, 8, { blocked: 'no_storage' });
  staffAll(world);
  return { root, world, potter, granary, farm, banner: root.querySelector('#banner'), live: root.querySelector('#live'), cleanup };
}
// A raid warning set by hand in the contract's shape (src/sim/raids.js), and its alert as raidAlerts words it.
function warn(world, { first = false, size = 6, arrives = 72 } = {}) {
  world.raid.warning = { index: first ? 0 : 1, entry: { x: 31, y: 16 }, dir: 'east', size, tribute: first ? null : 240, target: 'storehouse', day: 0, arrives, first };
  return { code: 'raid_warning', x: 31, y: 16, dir: 'east', arrives };
}
const click = (node) => fire(node, 'click');

describe('s3 ui alert tiers', () => {
  it('ranks an active raid, a raid warning, a fire, debt and save failing as critical, in that order', () => {
    const r = rig();
    try {
      expect(CRITICAL_RANK).toEqual(['raid', 'raid_warning', 'fire', 'debt', 'save_failed']);
      for (const c of CRITICAL_RANK) expect(CRITICAL.has(c)).toBe(true);
      for (const c of ['blaze', 'fire_risk', 'no_storage']) expect(CRITICAL.has(c)).toBe(false);
      const list = [{ code: 'save_failed' }, { code: 'debt' }, { code: 'fire', id: r.potter.id }, { code: 'blaze', id: r.granary.id },
        { code: 'raid', x: 20, y: 16, left: 4 }, { code: 'raid_warning', x: 31, y: 16, dir: 'east', arrives: 90 }, { code: 'fire_risk', id: r.farm.id }];
      const t = triage(r.world, list);
      expect(t.critical.map((a) => a.code)).toEqual(['raid', 'raid_warning', 'fire', 'debt', 'save_failed']);
      expect(t.ordinary.map((a) => a.code)).toEqual(['blaze', 'fire_risk']);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('shows one banner with "+N more" that opens the list, and rolls repeated fires into one line whose View steps through them', () => {
    const r = rig();
    try {
      let alerts = [{ code: 'fire', id: r.potter.id }, { code: 'fire', id: r.granary.id }, { code: 'debt' }, { code: 'save_failed' }, { code: 'no_storage', id: r.farm.id }];
      const viewed = [], actions = [];
      const a = createAlerts({ world: r.world, banner: r.banner, live: r.live, root: r.root, onView: (x) => viewed.push(x.id), onAction: (x, k) => actions.push([x.code, k]), getAlerts: () => alerts });
      a.refresh();
      expect(r.banner.querySelectorAll('.critical').length).toBe(1);
      const row = r.banner.querySelector('.critical');
      expect(row.querySelector('strong').textContent).toBe(D.firesTitle(2));
      expect(row.textContent).toContain(D.firesFix);
      expect(row.querySelector('.more').textContent).toBe('+2 more');                       // debt and save failing wait in the list
      expect(row.querySelector('.view').getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe(viewLabel(D.firesTitle(2)));
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) click(row.querySelector('.view'));
      expect(viewed).toEqual([r.potter.id, r.granary.id, r.potter.id]);
      click(row.querySelector('.more'));
      expect(actions).toEqual([['fire', 'more']]);
      expect(a.count()).toBe(1);                                                             // the badge counts the warnings only
      alerts = [{ code: 'fire', id: r.granary.id }, { code: 'debt' }];
      a.refresh();
      const one = r.banner.querySelector('.critical');
      expect(one.querySelector('strong').textContent).toBe(alertText({ code: 'fire', id: r.granary.id }, r.world).title);   // one fire: its own words (Track A's)
      expect(one.querySelector('.more').textContent).toBe('+1 more');
      alerts = [{ code: 'debt' }];
      a.refresh();
      expect(r.banner.querySelector('.more')).toBe(null);
      alerts = [];
      a.refresh();
      expect([r.banner.children.length, r.root.classList.contains('has-banner')]).toEqual([0, false]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('words a raid warning\'s defence from the sim\'s quote, offers Pay tribute except on the first raid, and Views its map point', () => {
    const r = rig();
    try {
      let alerts = [warn(r.world), { code: 'debt' }];
      const actions = [], viewed = [];
      const a = createAlerts({ world: r.world, banner: r.banner, live: r.live, root: r.root, onView: (x) => viewed.push(x.code), onAction: (x, k) => actions.push([x.code, k]), getAlerts: () => alerts });
      a.refresh();
      const q = tributeQuote(r.world);
      expect([q.towersNeeded, q.towersHave, q.buildN, q.buildCost]).toEqual([2, 0, 2, 300]);
      let row = r.banner.querySelector('.critical');
      expect(row.querySelector('.defence').textContent).toBe('or build 2 towers facing east (≈ 300 gold)');
      expect(row.querySelector('.more').textContent).toBe('+1 more');
      click(row.querySelector('.tribute'));
      click(row.querySelector('.view'));
      expect([actions, viewed]).toEqual([[['raid_warning', 'tribute'], ['raid_warning', 'view']], []]);   // a point: no building to select
      // Two working towers beat six raiders (ceil(6 / 3)): the line follows the quote, not a guess.
      addRaw(r.world, 'tower', 12, 11); addRaw(r.world, 'tower', 14, 11);
      staffAll(r.world);
      a.refresh();
      expect(tributeQuote(r.world).buildN).toBe(0);
      expect(r.banner.querySelector('.defence').textContent).toBe('Your towers can beat this raid');
      r.world.buildings[Object.values(r.world.buildings).find((b) => b.type === 'tower').id].paused = true;
      a.refresh();
      expect(r.banner.querySelector('.defence').textContent).toBe('or build 1 tower facing east (≈ 150 gold)');
      alerts = [warn(r.world, { first: true, size: 3 })];
      a.refresh();
      row = r.banner.querySelector('.critical');
      expect(row.querySelector('.tribute')).toBe(null);                                   // the first raid cannot be paid off
      expect(row.querySelector('.defence').textContent).toBe('Your towers can beat this raid');
      for (const t of Object.values(r.world.buildings)) if (t.type === 'tower') r.world.buildings[t.id].paused = true;
      a.refresh();
      expect(r.banner.querySelector('.defence').textContent).toBe('Build 1 tower facing east (≈ 150 gold)');
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('collapses a raid warning to a countdown chip in the same slot, counting down with the days, and shows it again', () => {
    const r = rig();
    try {
      const alerts = [warn(r.world, { arrives: 72 })];
      const a = createAlerts({ world: r.world, banner: r.banner, live: r.live, root: r.root, getAlerts: () => alerts });
      a.refresh();

      const chip = r.banner.querySelector('.critical.chip');
      expect(chip.querySelector('.expand').textContent).toBe('Raid from the east · 2 m 12 d');   // its words show the whole warning again
      expect(chip.querySelector('.expand').getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');

      a.refresh();

      r.world.day = 65;

      expect(r.banner.querySelector('.chip .expand').textContent).toBe('Raid from the east · 7 d');
      click(r.banner.querySelector('.expand'));
      expect([r.banner.querySelector('.chip'), Boolean(r.banner.querySelector('.defence'))]).toEqual([null, true]);
      expect(D.chip('north', 90)).toBe('Raid from the north · 3 m 0 d');

  it('pins a raid\'s map point on the minimap with an arrow pointing into the map', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();

    const pins = minimapPins(w, [{ code: 'fire', id: potter.id }, { code: 'raid_warning', x: 31, y: 16, dir: 'east', arrives: 90 }, { code: 'raid', x: 10, y: 0 }, { code: 'no_road', id: 999 }]);
    expect(pins.length).toBe(3);

    expect(pins[2].dy).toBeGreaterThan(0.9);                                              // no dir: towards the middle

    const scale = 128 / 32;

    mm.render([{ code: 'raid_warning', x: 31, y: 16, dir: 'east', arrives: 90 }]);
    const arrow = pixelAt(mm.canvas, 29.6 * scale, 16.5 * scale);                          // on the arrow, west of the pin
    const bad = [parseInt(UI.bad.slice(1, 3), 16), parseInt(UI.bad.slice(3, 5), 16), parseInt(UI.bad.slice(5, 7), 16)];
    expect(Math.abs(arrow[0] - bad[0]) + Math.abs(arrow[1] - bad[1]) + Math.abs(arrow[2] - bad[2])).toBeLessThan(30);
    expect(before[0] === arrow[0] && before[1] === arrow[1]).toBe(false);
  });

  it('Views a raid\'s map point from the alert list, closing the sheet', () => {
    const { root, cleanup } = mount('<section id="sheet"></section>');
    try {

      const minimap = { canvas: document.createElement('canvas'), render() {}, tileFromPoint: () => ({ x: 0, y: 0 }) };
      createSheets({ container: root.querySelector('#sheet'), store, world, placement: null, cameraControl, minimap, getAlerts: () => [{ code: 'raid', x: 20, y: 7, left: 3 }] });
      store.set(openSheet(store.get(), 'minimap'));
      click(root.querySelector('.alert-list .view'));
      expect([panned, store.get().sheet]).toEqual([[[20.5, 7.5]], null]);
    } finally { cleanup(); }
  });

  it('closes the sheet of a building that vanished without handing later subscribers an older state', async () => {
    const { root, cleanup } = mount('<section id="sheet"></section>');
    try {
      const world = makeTestWorld();
      const store = createStore(INITIAL_UI_STATE);
      createSheets({ container: root.querySelector('#sheet'), store, world, placement: null, cameraControl: null, minimap: null });
      const seen = [];
      store.subscribe((s) => seen.push(s.sheet));                                         // subscribed after the sheets
      store.set(select(store.get(), 999));                                                // a building that burned down
      await Promise.resolve();
      expect(store.get().sheet).toBe(null);
      expect(seen).toEqual([{ kind: 'info', id: 999 }, null]);                             // never the old sheet after the new
      expect(root.querySelector('#sheet').hidden).toBe(true);

  });
```

**3a. Replace the whole of `src/ui/alerts.js` with:**

```js
// Alert triage (spec 6.3): critical alerts share one banner under the top bar; the rest feed the badge and the
// minimap sheet's list. Every change is announced once through the aria-live region (spec 6.8).
// Stage 3 (Track D): three tiers and one banner. The banner holds the highest-ranked critical (an active raid, a raid
// warning, a fire no staffed firehouse reaches, debt, save failing); the others wait behind "+N more", which opens the
// minimap sheet's list. Repeated fires roll into one line whose View steps through them. A raid warning carries Pay
// tribute (not on the first raid) beside the defence it could buy, and collapses to a countdown chip in the same slot.
import { alertsFor } from '../sim/alerts.js';
import { tributeQuote } from '../sim/raids.js';
import { summaryData } from './hud.js';
import { alertText, dateText, plural, viewLabel, T, DANGER_UI_TEXT } from './text.js';
import { el, button, clear, setText } from './components.js';

// The sim has no severity field, so the UI decides (1a follow-up). CRITICAL_RANK is the banner's order (spec 6.3).
export const CRITICAL_RANK = ['raid', 'raid_warning', 'fire', 'debt', 'save_failed'];
export const CRITICAL = new Set(CRITICAL_RANK);

const keyOf = (a) => `${a.code}:${a.id === undefined ? '' : a.id}:${a.level || ''}`;
const rankOf = (a) => CRITICAL_RANK.indexOf(a.code);
// A raid's alerts sit at a map point (the entry, or the band's centre), not on a building.
export const isPointAlert = (a) => (a.id === undefined || a.id === null) && Number.isFinite(a.x) && Number.isFinite(a.y);

export function triage(world, alerts = alertsFor(world)) {
  const all = alerts.filter((a) => a.id === undefined || a.id === null || Boolean(world.buildings[a.id]));
  const critical = all.filter((a) => CRITICAL.has(a.code)).sort((a, b) => rankOf(a) - rankOf(b));   // stable: ascending id within a code
  return { all, critical, ordinary: all.filter((a) => !CRITICAL.has(a.code)) };
}

export function mapSummaryText(world, alerts) {
  const d = summaryData(world);
  const head = `${T.gold} ${d.gold}. ${plural(d.people, 'person', 'people')}. ${T.mood} ${d.mood}. ${dateText(d.date)}.`;
  if (!alerts.length) return `${head} ${T.noAlerts}.`;
  return `${head} ${plural(alerts.length, 'alert', 'alerts')}: ${alerts.map((a) => alertText(a, world).title).join('. ')}.`;
}

// What the one banner shows for a critical list (ranked), or null: the alerts its row stands for (every fire when the top
// one is a fire), its words, the defence line and tribute for a raid warning, the countdown chip's words, and how many
// other criticals wait behind "+N more". Pure, so the banner and the tests share it.
export function bannerModel(world, critical) {
  if (!critical.length) return null;
  const top = critical[0];
  const group = top.code === 'fire' ? critical.filter((a) => a.code === 'fire') : [top];
  const D = DANGER_UI_TEXT;
  const words = group.length > 1 ? { title: D.firesTitle(group.length), fix: D.firesFix } : alertText(top, world);
  const m = { code: top.code, group, title: words.title, fix: words.fix, more: critical.length - group.length, defence: '', tribute: false, chip: '' };
  if (top.code === 'raid_warning') {
    const q = tributeQuote(world);
    if (q) { m.defence = D.defenceLine(q, top.dir); m.tribute = !q.hidden; }
    m.chip = D.chip(top.dir, Math.max(0, top.arrives - world.day));
  }
  return m;
}

// onAction (Stage 3): a button on an alert other than View, as onAction(alert, kind): 'tribute' (Pay tribute), 'more' (+N
// more: the alert list) and 'view' for an alert at a map point (the danger interface moves the camera there).
export function createAlerts({ world, banner, live, onView = () => {}, onAction = () => {}, onNewCritical = () => {}, root = document.body, getAlerts = () => alertsFor(world) }) {
  let current = { all: [], critical: [], ordinary: [] };
  let lastKeys = null;
  let lastCriticalKeys = null;
  let lastSig = null;
  let step = 0;                     // the rolled-up fire row's View: which fire it shows next
  const collapsed = new Set();      // raid warnings (by arrival day) the player shrank to the chip

  function announce() {
    const keys = current.all.map(keyOf).sort().join('|');
    if (keys === lastKeys) return;
    lastKeys = keys;
    if (!current.all.length) { setText(live, T.noAlerts); return; }
    setText(live, `${plural(current.all.length, 'alert', 'alerts')}: ${current.all.map((a) => alertText(a, world).title).join('. ')}`);
  }

  function view(m) {
    const a = m.group[step % m.group.length];
    step += 1;
    if (isPointAlert(a)) onAction(a, 'view');
    else onView(a);
  }

  function renderBanner(m) {
    const focused = banner.contains(document.activeElement) ? [...document.activeElement.classList].find((c) => ['view', 'tribute', 'collapse', 'expand', 'more'].includes(c)) : null;
    clear(banner);
    root.classList.toggle('has-banner', Boolean(m));
    if (!m) return;
    const D = DANGER_UI_TEXT;
    const top = m.group[0];
    const viewButton = button(T.view, { class: 'view', 'aria-label': viewLabel(m.chip && collapsed.has(top.arrives) ? m.chip : m.title), onClick: () => view(m) });
    const more = m.more > 0 ? button(D.more(m.more), { class: 'more quiet', 'aria-label': D.moreLabel(m.more), onClick: () => onAction(top, 'more') }) : null;
    if (m.chip && collapsed.has(top.arrives)) {
      // The chip is one line: its words are the button that shows the whole warning again, then View.
      banner.append(el('div', { class: 'critical chip', dataset: { code: m.code } }, [
        el('span', { class: 'icon', 'aria-hidden': 'true', text: '⚑' }),
        el('span', { class: 'text' }, [
          button(m.chip, { class: 'expand quiet', 'aria-expanded': 'false', title: D.expand, onClick: () => { collapsed.delete(top.arrives); refresh(true); } }),
        ]),
        el('span', { class: 'buttons' }, [viewButton, more]),
      ]));
    } else {
      banner.append(el('div', { class: 'critical', dataset: { code: m.code } }, [
        el('span', { class: 'icon', 'aria-hidden': 'true', text: m.chip ? '⚑' : '⚠' }),
        el('span', { class: 'text' }, [
          el('strong', { text: m.title }), ' ', el('span', { class: 'small', text: m.fix }),
          m.defence ? el('span', { class: 'defence small' }, [m.defence]) : null,
        ]),
        el('span', { class: 'buttons' }, [
          viewButton,
          m.tribute ? button(D.payTribute, { class: 'tribute', onClick: () => onAction(top, 'tribute') }) : null,
          m.chip ? button(D.collapse, { class: 'collapse quiet', 'aria-expanded': 'true', 'aria-label': D.collapseLabel, onClick: () => { collapsed.add(top.arrives); refresh(true); } }) : null,
          more,
        ]),
      ]));
    }
    if (focused) {
      const again = banner.querySelector(`.${focused}`) || banner.querySelector('.view');
      if (again) again.focus();
    }
  }

  function refresh(force = false) {
    current = triage(world, getAlerts());
    const criticalKeys = current.critical.map(keyOf).sort().join('|');
    if (criticalKeys !== lastCriticalKeys) {
      const before = new Set((lastCriticalKeys || '').split('|').filter(Boolean));
      if (current.critical.some((a) => !before.has(keyOf(a)))) onNewCritical();   // a fresh problem, not a cleared one
      lastCriticalKeys = criticalKeys;
      step = 0;
    }
    // The row is rebuilt only when what it says changes (a new top alert, the countdown's day, a collapse), so a
    // daily refresh keeps the same row and its focus.
    const m = bannerModel(world, current.critical);
    const sig = m ? JSON.stringify([criticalKeys, m.title, m.fix, m.defence, m.tribute, m.chip, m.more, m.chip ? collapsed.has(m.group[0].arrives) : false]) : '';
    if (force || sig !== lastSig) { lastSig = sig; renderBanner(m); }
    announce();
  }

  return {
    refresh: () => refresh(false),
    count: () => current.ordinary.length,
    list: () => current.all,
    critical: () => current.critical,
    action: (alert, kind) => onAction(alert, kind),
  };
}
```

**3b. Replace the whole of `src/ui/minimap.js` with:**

```js
// The minimap (spec 6.3): the whole map top-down, the current view outlined, alert pins. Tapping it jumps.
// Stage 3 (Track D): a pin can mark a map point as well as a building. A raid's alerts (no building, an x and y) get a
// larger pin with an arrow pointing into the map from the edge they come from (spec 4.13), so the pin says where by shape.
import { T as TER } from '../sim/terrain.js';
import { TERRAIN, UI, INK } from '../render/art/palette.js';
import { allBuildings } from '../sim/world.js';
import { screenToTile } from '../render/camera.js';

const COLOURS = { [TER.DESERT]: TERRAIN.sand, [TER.FERTILE]: TERRAIN.fertile, [TER.ROCKY]: TERRAIN.rocky, [TER.WATER]: TERRAIN.water, [TER.BANK]: TERRAIN.bank, [TER.MEADOW]: TERRAIN.grass };

const INTO = { east: [-1, 0], west: [1, 0], north: [0, 1], south: [0, -1] };

// The pins for a list of alerts, in tile units: { x, y, point, dx, dy }. A building's pin sits on its centre; a point
// alert's at its tile's centre, with (dx, dy) the unit arrow into the map (from its dir, else towards the map's middle).
export function minimapPins(world, alerts = []) {
  const out = [];
  for (const a of alerts) {
    const b = a.id ? world.buildings[a.id] : null;
    if (b) { out.push({ x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.d / 2, point: false, dx: 0, dy: 0 }); continue; }
    if (a.id !== undefined && a.id !== null) continue;          // a building that is gone
    if (!Number.isFinite(a.x) || !Number.isFinite(a.y)) continue;
    const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(world.size - 1, a.x)) + 0.5, y = Math.max(0, Math.min(world.size - 1, a.y)) + 0.5;
    let [dx, dy] = INTO[a.dir] || [world.size / 2 - x, world.size / 2 - y];
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    out.push({ x, y, point: true, dx: dx / len, dy: dy / len });
  }
  return out;
}

export function createMinimap({ world, cam, view, size = 160, dpr = 1 }) {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = Math.round(size * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.round(size * dpr);
  canvas.style.width = `${size}px`;
  canvas.style.height = `${size}px`;
  canvas.className = 'minimap-canvas';
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const scale = (size * dpr) / world.size;

  // Terrain never changes in Stage 1, so it is baked once.
  const ground = document.createElement('canvas');
  ground.width = canvas.width; ground.height = canvas.height;
  const gctx = ground.getContext('2d');
  for (let y = 0; y < world.size; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < world.size; x++) {
      gctx.fillStyle = COLOURS[world.terrain[y * world.size + x]] || TERRAIN.sand;
      gctx.fillRect(x * scale, y * scale, Math.ceil(scale), Math.ceil(scale));
    }
  }

  function render(alerts = []) {
    ctx.drawImage(ground, 0, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = TERRAIN.road;
    for (let i = 0; i < world.road.length; i++) if (world.road[i]) ctx.fillRect((i % world.size) * scale, Math.floor(i / world.size) * scale, Math.ceil(scale), Math.ceil(scale));
    for (const b of allBuildings(world)) {
      ctx.fillStyle = b.type === 'house' ? (b.tier > 0 ? TERRAIN.roadPebble : TERRAIN.plot) : UI.housing;
      ctx.fillRect(b.x * scale, b.y * scale, Math.max(1, b.w * scale), Math.max(1, b.d * scale));
    }
    const v = view();
    const corners = [[0, 0], [v.width, 0], [v.width, v.height], [0, v.height]].map(([sx, sy]) => screenToTile(cam, v, sx, sy));
    ctx.strokeStyle = UI.halo;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, dpr * 1.5);
    ctx.beginPath();
    corners.forEach((t, i) => { const px = t.x * scale, py = t.y * scale; if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py); });
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = TERRAIN.grid;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, dpr * 0.5);
    ctx.stroke();
    for (const pin of minimapPins(world, alerts)) {
      const px = pin.x * scale, py = pin.y * scale;
      ctx.fillStyle = UI.bad;
      if (pin.point) {
        // An arrow from the pin into the map, then the pin: a ringed disc twice a building pin's size.
        const r = Math.max(4, dpr * 5), len = r * 2.6, nx = -pin.dy, ny = pin.dx;
        const tip = [px + pin.dx * len, py + pin.dy * len], base = [px + pin.dx * r * 0.6, py + pin.dy * r * 0.6];
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(tip[0], tip[1]);
        ctx.lineTo(base[0] + nx * r, base[1] + ny * r);
        ctx.lineTo(base[0] - nx * r, base[1] - ny * r);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, dpr);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = UI.halo;
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, dpr * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        continue;
      }
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(px, py, Math.max(2, dpr * 3), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function tileFromPoint(px, py) {
    const clamp = (v) => Math.max(0, Math.min(world.size - 1, Math.floor(v)));
    return { x: clamp((px * dpr) / scale), y: clamp((py * dpr) / scale) };
  }

  render();
  return { canvas, render, tileFromPoint };
}
```

```js
// Stage 3 (spec 6.3, ruling 111): on a phone (portrait or compact) with a critical banner up, the strip shrinks to one
// icon button beside the banner (css/ui.css, Track D), so the goals strip stays above the middle of the screen; tapping
// it opens the full legend (the container's 'open' class) and tapping it again shrinks it. The icon is always in the
// strip's place in the DOM; the stylesheet shows one or the other.
export function createOverlayLegend({ container, store }) {
  let lastKind = undefined;

  function render() {
    const kind = store.get().overlay;
    if (kind === lastKind) return;
    lastKind = kind;
    clear(container);
    container.classList.remove('open');
    if (!kind) return;
    const toggle = iconButton(DANGER_UI_TEXT.legendOpen(OVERLAY_NAMES[kind]), '◧', { class: 'legend-icon', 'aria-expanded': 'false' });
    toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = container.classList.toggle('open');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? DANGER_UI_TEXT.legendClose : DANGER_UI_TEXT.legendOpen(OVERLAY_NAMES[kind]));
      toggle.title = toggle.getAttribute('aria-label');
    });
    container.append(toggle);
```

```js
import { openSheet, closeSheet } from './modes.js';

export function createDanger(ctx) {
  // D1: the banner's other buttons (src/ui/alerts.js). View on a raid's alert moves the camera to its map point (it has no
  // building to select); "+N more" opens the minimap sheet, whose list holds every alert.
  function onAlertAction(alert, action) {
    if (action === 'view' && Number.isFinite(alert.x) && Number.isFinite(alert.y)) {
      const s = ctx.store.get();
      if (s.sheet) ctx.store.set(closeSheet(s));
      ctx.cameraControl.panTo(alert.x + 0.5, alert.y + 0.5);
    } else if (action === 'more') ctx.store.set(openSheet(ctx.store.get(), 'minimap'));
  }
  return {
    sheets: {},
    sheetParts: { building: () => [], house: () => [], actions: () => [], summary: () => [] },
    onEvents() {},
    refresh() {},
    onAlertAction,
    onCommand() {},
    destroy() {},
  };
}
```

```js
// Every track's section shares this module's top-level scope, so Track D's own names start with "dui" (its imports too,
// renamed with "as"; imports are hoisted, so they sit here in the section and the shared lines at the top stay as they are).
import { DAYS_PER_MONTH as duiMonthDays } from '../sim/time.js';
// Directions as raids name them (src/sim/raids.js entryDir), and a span of game days in words ("2 months 12 days") and
// as the countdown chip writes it ("2 m 12 d"). A game month is DAYS_PER_MONTH days (src/sim/time.js).
const duiDirWords = { north: 'north', east: 'east', south: 'south', west: 'west' };
const duiDir = (dir) => duiDirWords[dir] || dir;
function duiDuration(days) {
  const m = Math.floor(days / duiMonthDays), d = days % duiMonthDays;
  const parts = [m ? plural(m, 'month', 'months') : '', d || !m ? plural(d, 'day', 'days') : ''];
  return parts.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
}
const duiCountdown = (days) => {
  const m = Math.floor(days / duiMonthDays), d = days % duiMonthDays;
  return m ? `${m} m ${d} d` : `${d} d`;
};
// D1: the one banner (spec 6.3). The defence line follows tributeQuote (src/sim/raids.js): buildN is the towers needed
// for the warned raid less the working towers, buildCost their price in this city; at 0 the towers can beat it (ruling 108).
Object.assign(DANGER_UI_TEXT, {
  dir: duiDir, duration: duiDuration, countdown: duiCountdown,
  firesTitle: (n) => `${n} buildings on fire`,
  firesFix: 'No staffed firehouse reaches them',             // the 'fire' code: a blaze or fire no staffed firehouse reaches
  more: (n) => `+${n} more`,
  moreLabel: (n) => `${plural(n, 'more critical alert', 'more critical alerts')}: open the alert list`,
  payTribute: 'Pay tribute',
  collapse: 'Shrink', collapseLabel: 'Shrink the raid warning to its countdown', expand: 'Show the whole warning',
  chip: (dir, days) => `Raid from the ${duiDir(dir)} · ${duiCountdown(days)}`,
  defenceLine: (q, dir) => (q.buildN > 0
    ? `${q.hidden ? 'Build' : 'or build'} ${plural(q.buildN, 'tower', 'towers')} facing ${duiDir(dir)} (≈ ${q.buildCost} gold)`
    : 'Your towers can beat this raid'),
  legendOpen: (name) => `Show the legend: ${name}`, legendClose: 'Hide the legend',
});
// ── end s3 ui ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

```css
/* D1: the one banner (spec 6.3). Words first, then the buttons; on a narrow phone the buttons wrap under the words and
   keep their 44 px. A raid warning's defence line sits on its own line; its countdown chip is the same row, one line. */
#banner .critical { flex-wrap: wrap; row-gap: 4px; }
#banner .critical .icon { flex: none; }
#banner .critical .text { flex: 1 1 6em; }
#banner .critical .defence { display: block; }
#banner .critical .buttons { flex: 0 1 auto; max-width: 100%; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-left: auto; }
#banner .critical .more { white-space: nowrap; }
#banner .critical.chip .expand { font-weight: 700; text-align: left; padding: 0 4px; }
/* A phone at larger text keeps the banner to its title and buttons: the fix stays for screen readers and in the alert
   list (the minimap sheet), so the banner and the goals strip end above the middle of the screen (ruling 111). */
body:is([data-layout="portrait"], [data-layout="compact"]):is([data-text-size="125"], [data-text-size="150"]) #banner .critical .text > .small:not(.defence) { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
/* The legend under a banner on a phone (ruling 111): one 44 px icon at the right end of the banner's row, so the goals
   strip keeps its place; tapped, the full legend opens in its own row. Wide screens keep the full strip. */
#legend .legend-icon { display: none; }
body.has-banner:not([data-layout="wide"]) #legend .legend-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
body.has-banner:not([data-layout="wide"]) #legend:not(.open) .strip { display: none; }
body.has-banner:not([data-layout="wide"]) #legend.open { flex-direction: row-reverse; align-items: center; }   /* open: the icon ends the strip's row */
body.has-banner:not([data-layout="wide"]) #legend:not(.open):not(:empty) { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; }
body.has-banner:not([data-layout="wide"]) #banner:has(+ #legend:not(.open):not(:empty)) { max-width: calc(100% - var(--tap) - 6px); }
/* ── end s3 ui ── */
```

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { firstWatered, placeName } from '../../../src/ui/danger.js';
import { createSettings } from '../../../src/ui/settings.js';
import { createMenuSheets } from '../../../src/ui/menu.js';

const noStorage = { getItem: () => null, setItem: () => {} };
const settingsWith = (patch = {}, reduced = true) => {
  const s = createSettings({ storage: noStorage, root: document.body, systemReducedMotion: () => reduced });
  s.set(patch);
  return s;
};
const quietSfx = (log) => ({ play: (n) => { log.push(n); return true; }, buzz: () => false, unlock: () => false, names: [] });

describe('s3 ui speed reactions', () => {
  it('drops a running game to 1x on a fire no staffed firehouse reaches (Just tell me), and leaves a paused game paused', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI({ settings: settingsWith({ fireReaction: 'inform' }) });
    try {
      const potter = addRaw(r.world, 'potter', 20, 11);
      r.ui.speedControl.set(3);
      r.ui.onEvents([{ type: 'fire', id: potter.id, covered: true, first: false }]);
      expect(r.world.speed).toBe(3);                                                   // a covered blaze: no change (spec 4.3)
      r.ui.onEvents([{ type: 'fire', id: potter.id, covered: false, first: false }]);
      expect(r.world.speed).toBe(1);
      r.ui.speedControl.set(2);
      r.ui.onEvents([{ type: 'fire_grow', id: potter.id, covered: false }]);
      expect(r.world.speed).toBe(2);                                                   // the same fire growing: no second reaction
      const granary = Object.values(r.world.buildings).find((b) => b.type === 'granary');
      r.ui.speedControl.set(0);
      r.ui.onEvents([{ type: 'fire', id: granary.id, covered: false, first: false }]);
      expect(r.world.speed).toBe(0);                                                   // "drop to 1x" never starts a paused game
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });

  it('pauses on Pause, and on Go to it drops to 1x and moves the camera to the fire', async () => {

      r.ui.speedControl.set(2);

      expect(r.world.speed).toBe(0);

      r.ui.speedControl.set(3);

      expect([r.world.speed, r.cam.x, r.cam.y]).toEqual([1, bazaar.x + bazaar.w / 2, bazaar.y + bazaar.d / 2]);   // reduced motion: an instant cut

      expect(r.world.speed).toBe(0);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});

  function rig(reduced = false) {
    const { root, cleanup } = mount('<div id="body"></div>');
    const settings = createSettings({ storage: noStorage, root, systemReducedMotion: () => reduced });
    const store = createStore(INITIAL_UI_STATE);

    const r = rig(false);
    try {
      const choices = [...r.body.querySelectorAll('.choice.fireReaction')];
      expect(choices.map((b) => [b.dataset.value, b.textContent])).toEqual([['pause', 'Pause'], ['goto', 'Go to it'], ['inform', 'Just tell me']]);
      expect(r.body.querySelector('.choice.fireReaction[data-value="inform"]').getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true');

      expect(r.settings.get().fireReaction).toBe('goto');
      expect(r.body.querySelector('.fire-note').textContent).toBe(D.onAFireNote);
      const ambient = r.body.querySelector('.switch.ambient');

      fire(ambient, 'click');
      expect([r.settings.get().ambient, ambient.getAttribute('aria-checked')]).toEqual([false, 'false']);
      fire(ambient, 'click');
      fire(r.body.querySelector('.choice.reducedMotion[data-value="on"]'), 'click');
      expect([ambient.getAttribute('aria-checked'), ambient.querySelector('.state').textContent, ambient.disabled, note.hidden]).toEqual(['false', T.off, true, false]);
      expect(r.settings.get().ambient).toBe(true);                                     // the choice is kept for when motion is back
      fire(r.body.querySelector('.choice.reducedMotion[data-value="off"]'), 'click');
      expect([ambient.getAttribute('aria-checked'), ambient.disabled]).toEqual(['true', false]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }

      expect(levels.map((b) => b.textContent)).toEqual(DIFFICULTY_ORDER.map((d) => DIFFICULTY_NAMES[d]));

      }
```

**3a. Replace the whole of `src/ui/danger.js` with** (it keeps D1's `onAlertAction` as it was):

```js
// The danger interface (spec 4.3, 4.12, 4.13, 6.3): the speed reactions and the On a fire setting, the raid horn and the
// coin tick, the tribute confirmation sheet, the festival button, the fire row and the defence rows on building sheets,
// and the last raid's report in the summary. Stage 3 contract: Track D implements createDanger; createUI makes one per
// game (after the alerts, speed control and toasts, before the sheets) and calls it only through this shape.
//
// ctx: { world, store, settings, sfx, toasts, celebrations, effects, cameraControl, speedControl, alerts, root, doc, now,
// clock, hooks, afterCommand, refresh, onView, showMeAt, selectBuilding }. createDanger must not call refresh or
// afterCommand while it is being created (the sheets do not exist yet); every later call is fine.
//
// Returns:
//   sheets      custom sheet kinds it owns -> render(body, { close }) (createSheets' custom sheets; the heading is
//               T[kind], so each kind it adds needs a T entry in Track D's section of text.js)
//   sheetParts  { building(b), house(h), actions(b), summary() }, each returning an array of DOM nodes (empty for none):
//               rows after a building sheet's reach row, rows after a home's checklist, buttons at the front of a
//               building sheet's actions, and nodes in the summary after the goals
//   onEvents(events)  every batch of sim events: the loop's and those settle returns after a command
//   refresh()   after every command and every game day, once the alerts and the chrome are up to date
//   onAlertAction(alert, action)  an alert's button other than View was pressed (alerts.action; 'tribute' for Pay tribute)
//   onCommand(e)  after every command, with createUI's afterCommand record ({ kind, result, text, undoable }), before the
//               settle (a placed well's ripple, a tip on placing a firehouse)
//   destroy()   when the interface goes
// ctx.screenshotMode() enters screenshot mode (the store's screenshot flag; Back, Esc, a tap or a click leaves it).
// ctx.fireTip(trigger) asks for a tip (src/data/tips.js triggers), as createUI does for its own.
import { BUILDINGS } from '../data/buildings.js';
import { allBuildings, housesOf } from '../sim/world.js';
import { roadReach, reachDistance } from '../sim/reach.js';
import { isWorking } from '../sim/labour.js';
import { openSheet, closeSheet } from './modes.js';
import { buildingName, tierName, DANGER_UI_TEXT } from './text.js';

// The homes a newly placed water provider is the first to water (spec 5.4's ripple): those it reaches by the coveredBy rule
// (src/sim/housing.js) that no other working water provider reaches. Plots count, as "Gives water to N homes" counts them.
export function firstWatered(world, well) {
  const def = BUILDINGS[well.type];
  const mine = roadReach(world, well, def.reach);
  const others = allBuildings(world).filter((b) => b.id !== well.id && BUILDINGS[b.type].provides === def.provides && isWorking(world, b));
  return housesOf(world).filter((h) => reachDistance(mine, world, h) <= def.reach
    && !others.some((o) => reachDistance(roadReach(world, o, BUILDINGS[o.type].reach), world, h) <= BUILDINGS[o.type].reach));
}

// A building in a sentence: a home by its tier ("the hut"), anything else by its type ("the potter").
export const placeName = (b) => (b.type === 'house' ? tierName(b.tier) : buildingName(b.type)).toLowerCase();

export function createDanger(ctx) {
  const D = DANGER_UI_TEXT;
  const reacted = new Set();      // buildings whose uncovered fire the speed already reacted to (a blaze that grows: once)

  // D2: the On a fire setting (spec 4.3), for a blaze or fire no staffed firehouse reaches after the city's first (the sim
  // paused for that one itself): Pause; Go to it (drop to 1x and move the camera there, an instant cut under reduced
  // motion); Just tell me (drop to 1x; the banner says the rest). Dropping to 1x leaves a paused game paused.
  function reactToFire(id) {
    const how = ctx.settings.get().fireReaction;
    if (how === 'pause') { if (ctx.world.speed !== 0) ctx.speedControl.set(0); return; }
    if (ctx.world.speed > 1) ctx.speedControl.set(1);
    const b = ctx.world.buildings[id];
    if (how === 'goto' && b) ctx.cameraControl.panTo(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.d / 2);
  }

  // Captions are the info tier (spec 6.3): one line in the caption row, no sound, nothing to tap.
  const caption = (text) => ctx.celebrations.show({ tier: 'info', text });

  function onEvents(events) {
    let fireAt = null, paused = false;
    for (const e of events) {
      if (e.type === 'fire' && e.first) paused = true;                       // the city's first: the sim has paused
      else if ((e.type === 'fire' || e.type === 'fire_grow') && !e.covered && !reacted.has(e.id)) { reacted.add(e.id); if (fireAt === null) fireAt = e.id; }
      else if (e.type === 'fire_out') {
        reacted.delete(e.id);
        const b = ctx.world.buildings[e.id];
        if (b) caption(D.putOut(e.stage, placeName(b)));
      } else if (e.type === 'burned') reacted.delete(e.id);
      else if (e.type === 'raid_warning') ctx.sfx.play('horn');              // once, as the warning appears (spec 5.5)
      else if (e.type === 'raid_end' && e.report) caption(D.raidReport(e.report));
      else if (e.type === 'month' && ctx.world.stats.lastMonth && ctx.world.stats.lastMonth.taxes > 0) ctx.sfx.play('coin');   // the month's taxes arrived
    }
    if (fireAt !== null && !paused) reactToFire(fireAt);
  }

  // D2: a well's ripple (spec 5.4): one ring on each home it is the first to water; effects.ripple is nothing under
  // reduced motion.
  function onCommand(e) {
    if (!e || !e.undoable || e.kind !== 'building' || !e.result || !e.result.ok) return;
    const b = ctx.world.buildings[e.result.id];
    if (!b || BUILDINGS[b.type].provides !== 'water') return;
    const at = ctx.now();
    for (const h of firstWatered(ctx.world, b)) ctx.effects.ripple(h.x + h.w / 2, h.y + h.d / 2, at);
  }

  // D1: the banner's other buttons (src/ui/alerts.js). View on a raid's alert moves the camera to its map point (it has no
  // building to select); "+N more" opens the minimap sheet, whose list holds every alert.
  function onAlertAction(alert, action) {
    if (action === 'view' && Number.isFinite(alert.x) && Number.isFinite(alert.y)) {
      const s = ctx.store.get();
      if (s.sheet) ctx.store.set(closeSheet(s));
      ctx.cameraControl.panTo(alert.x + 0.5, alert.y + 0.5);
    } else if (action === 'more') ctx.store.set(openSheet(ctx.store.get(), 'minimap'));
  }

  return {
    sheets: {},
    sheetParts: { building: () => [], house: () => [], actions: () => [], summary: () => [] },
    onEvents,
    refresh() {},
    onAlertAction,
    onCommand,
    destroy() { reacted.clear(); },
  };
}
```

```js
  // Stage 3 (Track D, spec 5.6): Ambient motion is Off while reduced motion is on (createUI's ambient layer runs only when
  // both allow it), so the switch shows Off, is disabled and says why; the reduced-motion choices re-sync it.
  function ambientRow() {
    const D = DANGER_UI_TEXT;
    const r = switchRow(D.ambient, 'ambient');
    const b = r.querySelector('button'), state = b.querySelector('.state');
    const note = el('p', { class: 'ambient-note small muted', text: D.ambientReduced });
    const sync = () => {
      const reduced = settings.reducedMotion();
      b.disabled = reduced;
      note.hidden = !reduced;
      const on = !reduced && Boolean(settings.get().ambient);
      b.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(on));
      state.textContent = on ? T.on : T.off;
    };
    b.addEventListener('click', sync);
    sync();
    return { row: el('div', {}, [r, note]), sync };
  }

  function settingsSheet(body) {
    const D = DANGER_UI_TEXT;
    const ambient = ambientRow();
    const motion = choiceRow(T.reducedMotion, 'reducedMotion', [['system', T.followSystem], ['on', T.on], ['off', T.off]]);
    for (const c of motion.querySelectorAll('button')) c.addEventListener('click', ambient.sync);
    body.append(
      switchRow(T.sound, 'sound'), switchRow(T.vibration, 'vibration'),
      switchRow(T.keyboardShortcuts, 'keyboardShortcuts'), switchRow(T.leftHanded, 'leftHanded'),
      choiceRow(T.textSize, 'textSize', [[100, '100%'], [125, '125%'], [150, '150%']]),
      motion,
      // Spec 4.3: what a fire no staffed firehouse reaches does to the speed, after the city's first (which always pauses).
      choiceRow(D.onAFire, 'fireReaction', FIRE_REACTIONS.map((k) => [k, D.fireReactions[k]])),
      el('p', { class: 'fire-note small muted', text: D.onAFireNote }),
      ambient.row,
      choiceRow(T.helpLevel, 'help', [['full', HELP_NAMES.full], ['tips', HELP_NAMES.tips], ['off', HELP_NAMES.off]]),
```

**3d. `src/ui/text.js`, Track D's section. Insert just above the end marker. In `src/ui/text.js`, replace:**

```js
// ── end s3 ui ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

**with:**

```js
// D2: captions, the raid report and the Settings rows. A blaze or a fire goes out only where a firehouse reaches it
// (src/sim/fire.js: a covered and staffed blaze, a covered fire at 25% x coverage a day), so the caption names the
// firehouse. The report reads raid.last's fields (src/sim/raids.js): size, towers, byTowers, bySoldiers, burned, stolen.
const duiLosses = (r) => [r.burned ? plural(r.burned, 'building burned', 'buildings burned') : '', r.stolen ? `${r.stolen} gold stolen` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || 'nothing lost';
function duiRaidReport(r) {
  const from = `Raid from the ${duiDir(r.dir)}`;
  if (r.won) {
    const stopped = [r.towers || r.byTowers ? `${plural(r.towers, 'tower', 'towers')} stopped ${r.byTowers} of ${r.size}` : '', r.bySoldiers ? `soldiers stopped ${r.bySoldiers}` : ''].filter(Boolean);
    return `${from} beaten: ${stopped.length ? `${stopped.join(', ')}; ` : ''}${duiLosses(r)}.`;
  }
  const did = listText([r.burned ? `burned ${plural(r.burned, 'building', 'buildings')}` : '', r.stolen ? `took ${r.stolen} gold` : ''].filter(Boolean));
  const stopped = [r.byTowers ? `Towers stopped ${r.byTowers} of ${r.size}` : '', r.bySoldiers ? `${r.byTowers ? 'soldiers' : 'Soldiers'} stopped ${r.bySoldiers}` : ''].filter(Boolean);
  return `${from}: ${did ? `raiders ${did}` : 'the raiders struck and left'}.${stopped.length ? ` ${stopped.join(', ')}.` : ''}`;
}
Object.assign(DANGER_UI_TEXT, {
  putOut: (stage, name) => `The firehouse put out a ${stage === 'fire' ? 'fire' : 'blaze'} at the ${name}`,
  raidReport: duiRaidReport,
  onAFire: 'On a fire', fireReactions: { pause: 'Pause', goto: 'Go to it', inform: 'Just tell me' },
  onAFireNote: "For a fire no staffed firehouse reaches. The city's first one always pauses the game.",
  ambient: 'Ambient motion', ambientReduced: 'Off while Reduce motion is on',
});
// ── end s3 ui ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

### Task D3: The tribute sheet, the fire row, the danger buildings' rows, the festival and the raid report

**Model hint:** opus (every sentence follows a sim rule; the tests set the world both ways).

**Files:**
- Create: `src/ui/dangerSheets.js`, `tests/stage3/ui/dangerSheets.test.js`
- Modify: `src/ui/danger.js`, `src/ui/sheets.js`, `src/render/overlays.js` (a tower's range and a barracks' patrol highlight), `src/ui/text.js` (Track D's section), `css/ui.css` (Track D's section), `tests/stage3/ui.all.js`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `canBurn`, `fireStarted`, `fireRiskOf`, `fireBand`, `staffedCover`, `clearRubble` (`src/sim/fire.js`); `roadReach`, `adjacentRoadTiles` (`src/sim/reach.js`, the same test `fireCoverage` makes); `isWorking`, `staffRatio`; `tributeQuote`, `payTribute` (`src/sim/raids.js`); `festivalStatus`, `holdFestival` (`src/sim/festival.js`); `rubbleCostOf`, `canAfford`, `dateParts`; `world.raid.warning`, `world.raid.last`, `world.soldiers` (`{ id, barracks, ... }`), `world.wall`; `DEFENCE`, `FESTIVAL`, `FIRE` data; `ctx.showMeAt`, `ctx.selectBuilding`, `ctx.afterCommand`, `ctx.toasts`, `ctx.store`.
- Produces: the `tribute` sheet kind (heading `T.tribute`, opened by `danger.onAlertAction(alert, 'tribute')`); `danger.sheetParts` `building(b)` (the fire row, then the firehouse's, tower's, barracks' or rubble's rows), `house(h)` (the fire row), `actions(b)` (the temple's Hold a festival, rubble's Clear), `summary()` (the last raid's report); `fireRowModel(world, b)` and `firehousesReaching(world, b)` (exported from `src/ui/dangerSheets.js`); `rangeTiles(world, b)` and `RANGE_OF` (`src/render/overlays.js`); rubble's sheet has no Demolish (Clear is its demolish).

```js
      expect(report.textContent).toBe('Raid from the north: raiders burned 3 buildings and took 120 gold. Towers stopped 1 of 6.');
      expect(report.previousElementSibling.textContent).toBe(D.lastRaid);
      expect(report.nextElementSibling.textContent).toBe('Ended Year 4, month 6, day 5');
      expect(createDanger({}).sheetParts.summary()).toEqual([]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});
```

**3a. Create `src/ui/dangerSheets.js`:**

```js
// The danger interface's sheets and sheet parts (spec 4.12, 4.13, 6.3), for src/ui/danger.js: the tribute confirmation
// sheet, the fire row on every building and home sheet, the firehouse, tower, barracks and rubble rows, the temple's
// Hold a festival, and the last raid's report in the summary. Every sentence is computed from the sim's own rules
// (src/sim/fire.js coverage, src/sim/raids.js tributeQuote and raid.last, src/sim/festival.js festivalStatus), so the
// words say what the sim does. Each function takes the danger interface's context (ctx) and returns DOM nodes.
import { BUILDINGS } from '../data/buildings.js';
import { FIRE } from '../data/fire.js';
import { DEFENCE, FESTIVAL } from '../data/raids.js';
import { MIN_STAFF_RATIO } from '../data/labour.js';
import { ECONOMY } from '../data/economy.js';
import { allBuildings } from '../sim/world.js';
import { roadReach, adjacentRoadTiles } from '../sim/reach.js';
import { isWorking, staffRatio } from '../sim/labour.js';
import { canBurn, fireStarted, fireRiskOf, fireBand, staffedCover, clearRubble } from '../sim/fire.js';
import { tributeQuote, payTribute } from '../sim/raids.js';
import { festivalStatus, holdFestival } from '../sim/festival.js';
import { rubbleCostOf } from '../sim/costs.js';
import { canAfford } from '../sim/money.js';
import { dateParts } from '../sim/clock.js';
import { idx } from '../sim/grid.js';
import { el, button } from './components.js';
import { dateText, plural, viewLabel, T, DANGER_UI_TEXT } from './text.js';

const D = DANGER_UI_TEXT;
const centre = (b) => ({ x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.d / 2 });

// The firehouses whose road reach (FIRE.reach) takes in a road tile next to b, working or not: fireCoverage's own test
// (src/sim/fire.js) without its working filter, so the row can say "short of workers" or "paused" of one that reaches but
// does not cover. Best first: working, then the best staffed, then the lowest id.
export function firehousesReaching(world, b) {
  const adj = adjacentRoadTiles(world, b);
  if (!adj.length) return [];
  return allBuildings(world)
    .filter((f) => f.type === 'firehouse' && adj.some((t) => roadReach(world, f, FIRE.reach).has(t)))
    .sort((a, c) => Number(isWorking(world, c)) - Number(isWorking(world, a)) || staffRatio(world, c) - staffRatio(world, a) || a.id - c.id);
}

// The fire row (spec 4.12) as { text, burning, action }: action null, { kind: 'showMe' } (the firehouse card with its
// ghost by the building) or { kind: 'view', id } (the firehouse that reaches it but is short of workers or paused).
export function fireRowModel(world, b) {
  if (!canBurn(b)) return { text: D.neverBurns, burning: false, action: null };
  if (!b.fire && !fireStarted(world)) return { text: D.riskStartsAtTown, burning: false, action: null };
  const staffed = staffedCover(world, b);
  const reaching = staffed ? [] : firehousesReaching(world, b);
  const f = reaching[0] || null;
  // Why no staffed firehouse covers it: none reaches it (Show me), or the one that does is paused or short of workers (View).
  const why = f ? (f.paused ? D.whyPaused : D.whyShort) : D.whyNone;
  const action = staffed ? null : f ? { kind: 'view', id: f.id } : { kind: 'showMe' };
  if (b.fire) {
    const head = b.fire.stage === 'fire' ? D.burningFor(b.fire.left) : D.blaze;
    const tail = staffed ? (b.fire.stage === 'fire' ? D.fighting : D.puttingOut) : f ? why : D.noneReaches;
    return { text: `${head}, ${tail}`, burning: true, action };
  }
  return { text: D.riskLine(fireBand(fireRiskOf(world, b)), staffed ? D.reaches : why), burning: false, action };
}

export function fireRow(ctx, b) {
  const m = fireRowModel(ctx.world, b);
  const out = [el('div', { class: 'row fire-row' }, [el('span', { class: 'muted', text: D.fireLabel }), el('span', { class: m.burning ? 'coral' : '', text: m.text })])];
  if (m.action && m.action.kind === 'showMe') {
    out.push(el('div', { class: 'fix fire-fix' }, [button(T.showMe, { class: 'show-me primary', 'aria-label': `${T.showMe}: ${D.buildFirehouse}`,
      onClick: () => ctx.showMeAt({ category: 'services', item: 'firehouse', ...centre(b) }) })]));
  } else if (m.action) {
    out.push(el('div', { class: 'fix fire-fix' }, [button(T.view, { class: 'view quiet', 'aria-label': viewLabel(BUILDINGS.firehouse.name), onClick: () => ctx.selectBuilding(m.action.id) })]));
  }
  return out;
}

const row = (label, value) => el('div', { class: 'row' }, [el('span', { class: 'muted', text: label }), el('span', { text: value })]);
const line = (text, cls = 'small muted') => el('p', { class: cls, text });
const needed = (type) => Math.ceil(BUILDINGS[type].workers * MIN_STAFF_RATIO);   // the fewest workers that make it work

// The firehouse: what it covers, or why it covers nothing; and whether it is staffed enough to put fires out.
function firehouseRows(world, b) {
  if (b.paused) return [line(D.coversNothingPaused)];
  if (!isWorking(world, b)) return [line(D.coversNothingUntil(needed('firehouse'), BUILDINGS.firehouse.workers))];
  const reach = roadReach(world, b, FIRE.reach);
  const n = allBuildings(world).filter((x) => canBurn(x) && adjacentRoadTiles(world, x).some((t) => reach.has(t))).length;
  const out = [line(D.covers(n), 'small')];
  if (staffRatio(world, b) < FIRE.staffedAt) out.push(line(D.tooShortToFight(Math.ceil(BUILDINGS.firehouse.workers * FIRE.staffedAt), BUILDINGS.firehouse.workers), 'small coral'));
  return out;
}

function towerRows(world, b) {
  const out = [row(D.range, D.tiles(DEFENCE.towerRange)), line(D.towerDoes(DEFENCE.towerRange))];
  const hp = world.wall[idx(world.size, b.x, b.y)];
  if (hp > 0) out.push(row(D.onTheWall, D.hitPoints(hp, DEFENCE.towerOnWallHp)));
  if (world.raid.last) out.push(line(D.lastRaidTowers(world.raid.last)));
  return out;
}

function barracksRows(world, b) {
  const n = world.soldiers.filter((s) => s.barracks === b.id).length;
  const out = [row(D.soldiers, `${n} of ${DEFENCE.soldiersPerBarracks}`), row(D.patrol, D.tiles(DEFENCE.patrol))];
  if (b.paused) out.push(line(D.notTrainingPaused));
  else if (!isWorking(world, b)) out.push(line(D.notTrainingUntil(needed('barracks'), BUILDINGS.barracks.workers)));
  else out.push(line(D.trains(DEFENCE.trainDays)));
  out.push(line(D.soldiersPay(DEFENCE.soldierPay)));
  if (world.raid.last) out.push(line(D.lastRaidSoldiers(world.raid.last)));
  return out;
}

// Rows after a building sheet's reach row: the fire row, then the danger buildings' own rows.
export function buildingParts(ctx, b) {
  const world = ctx.world;
  if (b.type === 'rubble') return [line(D.rubbleRow(rubbleCostOf(world)), 'small'), line(D.rubbleDrag)];
  const out = fireRow(ctx, b);
  if (b.type === 'firehouse') out.push(...firehouseRows(world, b));
  if (b.type === 'tower') out.push(...towerRows(world, b));
  if (b.type === 'barracks') out.push(...barracksRows(world, b));
  return out;
}

// Buttons at the front of a building sheet's actions: the temple's Hold a festival, rubble's Clear.
export function actionParts(ctx, b) {
  if (b.type === 'temple') return festivalParts(ctx);
  if (b.type === 'rubble') return rubbleParts(ctx, b);
  return [];
}

function festivalParts(ctx) {
  const s = festivalStatus(ctx.world);
  if (s.reason === 'locked') return [];                                   // festivals come with Town
  const hold = button(D.holdFestival(s.cost), { class: s.can ? 'festival primary' : 'festival', disabled: !s.can, onClick: () => {
    const r = holdFestival(ctx.world);
    if (!r.ok) return;
    ctx.toasts.show(D.festivalHeld);
    ctx.afterCommand({ kind: 'festival', result: r, text: D.festivalHeld, undoable: false });
  } });
  const notes = [];
  if (s.activeFor > 0) notes.push(D.festivalOn(FESTIVAL.mood, s.activeFor));
  if (s.reason === 'too_soon') notes.push(D.nextFestival(s.nextIn));
  else if (s.reason === 'no_temple') notes.push(D.festivalNeedsTemple);
  else if (s.reason === 'no_gold') notes.push(D.wouldPassDebt(-ECONOMY.debtFloor));
  else if (s.can) notes.push(D.festivalDoes(FESTIVAL.mood, FESTIVAL.days, FESTIVAL.every));
  return [el('div', { class: 'festival-group' }, [hold, ...notes.map((t) => line(t))])];
}

function rubbleParts(ctx, b) {
  const cost = rubbleCostOf(ctx.world);
  const can = canAfford(ctx.world, cost);
  const clear = button(D.clearFor(cost), { class: 'clear danger', disabled: !can, onClick: () => {
    const r = clearRubble(ctx.world, b.x, b.y);
    if (r.ok) ctx.afterCommand({ kind: 'demolish', result: r, text: D.cleared, undoable: true });
  } });
  return [el('div', { class: 'festival-group' }, [clear, can ? null : line(D.wouldPassDebt(-ECONOMY.debtFloor))])];
}

// The summary's last raid report (spec 4.13), after the goals: the report's words and the day it ended.
export function summaryParts(ctx) {
  const last = ctx.world.raid.last;
  if (!last) return [];
  return [el('h3', { text: D.lastRaid }), el('p', { class: 'raid-report', text: D.raidReport(last) }), line(D.endedOn(dateText(dateParts({ day: last.day }))))];
}

// The tribute confirmation sheet (spec 4.13): the cost, the gold afterwards, what it cancels and what it does not, two
// buttons named for their outcome and neither the default; the rule's own words when it cannot be paid.
export function tributeSheet(ctx) {
  return (body, { close }) => {
    const world = ctx.world;
    const q = tributeQuote(world);
    if (!q) { body.append(el('p', { text: D.noWarning })); return; }
    const w = world.raid.warning;
    if (q.hidden) { body.append(el('p', { text: D.firstRaid }), el('p', { text: D.capital(D.defenceLine(q, w.dir)) })); return; }
    body.append(
      el('p', { class: 'tribute-cost', text: D.tributeCost(q.cost) }),
      row(D.goldNow, String(world.gold)), row(D.goldAfter, String(world.gold - q.cost)),
      el('p', { class: 'cancels', text: D.cancels(w.dir, q.size) }),
      el('p', { class: 'small muted', text: D.capital(D.defenceLine(q, w.dir)) }),
    );
    if (!q.payable) body.append(el('p', { class: 'why-not coral', text: D.tributeBelowZero(world.gold) }));
    const pay = button(D.payGold(q.cost), { class: 'pay', disabled: !q.payable, onClick: () => {
      const r = payTribute(world);
      if (!r.ok) return;
      close();
      ctx.toasts.show(D.tributePaid(r.cost));
      ctx.afterCommand({ kind: 'tribute', result: r, text: D.tributePaid(r.cost), undoable: false });
    } });
    body.append(el('div', { class: 'actions tribute-actions' }, [pay, button(D.keepGold, { class: 'keep', onClick: close })]));
  };
}
```

```js
// Stage 3 (Track D, spec 4.5, 6.3): a tower's range and a barracks' patrol are straight-line tiles from its centre, not road
// reach: the tiles whose centres lie within that distance, highlighted when the building is selected.
export const RANGE_OF = { tower: DEFENCE.towerRange, barracks: DEFENCE.patrol };
export function rangeTiles(world, b) {
  const r = RANGE_OF[b.type];
  if (!r) return [];
  const cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.d / 2, out = [];
  for (let y = Math.max(0, Math.floor(cy - r)); y <= Math.min(world.size - 1, Math.ceil(cy + r)); y++) {
    for (let x = Math.max(0, Math.floor(cx - r)); x <= Math.min(world.size - 1, Math.ceil(cx + r)); x++) {
      if ((x + 0.5 - cx) ** 2 + (y + 0.5 - cy) ** 2 <= r * r) out.push(idx(world.size, x, y));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export function drawReachHighlight(g, world, b) {
  tintTiles(g, world, RANGE_OF[b.type] ? rangeTiles(world, b) : reachTiles(world, b), UI.housing, 0.22);
```

```js
// D3: the danger sheets (src/ui/dangerSheets.js). The fire row reads src/sim/fire.js: "a firehouse reaches it" is
// staffedCover (coverage of FIRE.staffedAt or more); "short of workers" and "paused" name a firehouse whose road reach

// payTribute (src/sim/raids.js), the festival's festivalStatus (src/sim/festival.js).
import { FIRE as duiFire } from '../data/fire.js';
const duiFireFrom = MILESTONES.find((m) => m.id === duiFire.startsAt);
const duiBands = ['low', 'rising', 'high', 'can catch fire'];

  riskLine: (band, tail) => (band >= 3 ? `Can catch fire, ${tail}` : `Fire risk: ${duiBands[band]}, ${tail}`),
  reaches: 'a firehouse reaches it', whyNone: `no firehouse within ${duiFire.reach} road tiles`, noneReaches: 'no firehouse reaches it',
  whyShort: 'the firehouse is short of workers', whyPaused: 'the firehouse is paused',
  blaze: 'Blaze', burningFor: (left) => `Burning, ${plural(left, 'day', 'days')} left`, puttingOut: 'the firehouse is putting it out', fighting: 'the firehouse is fighting it',
  buildFirehouse: 'Build a firehouse near it',
  covers: (n) => `Covers ${plural(n, 'building that can burn', 'buildings that can burn')}`,
  coversNothingPaused: 'Covers nothing while it is paused',
  coversNothingUntil: (n, of) => `Covers nothing until it has ${n} of ${of} workers`,
  tooShortToFight: (n, of) => `Puts out blazes only with ${n} of ${of} workers or more`,
  range: 'Range', patrol: 'Patrol', soldiers: 'Soldiers', onTheWall: 'On the wall',
  tiles: (n) => plural(n, 'tile', 'tiles'), hitPoints: (hp, of) => `${hp} of ${of} hit points`,
  towerDoes: (r) => `Shoots the nearest raider within ${r} tiles once a day`,
  trains: (days) => `Trains one soldier every ${days} days at full staff, slower when short of workers`,
  notTrainingPaused: 'Not training while it is paused', notTrainingUntil: (n, of) => `Not training until it has ${n} of ${of} workers`,
  soldiersPay: (n) => `Each soldier is paid ${n} gold a month, in peace too`,
  lastRaidTowers: (r) => `Last raid: towers stopped ${r.byTowers} of ${r.size}`,
  lastRaidSoldiers: (r) => `Last raid: soldiers stopped ${r.bySoldiers} of ${r.size}`,
  rubbleRow: (cost) => `Rubble: clear it for ${cost} gold a tile`, rubbleDrag: 'Drag Demolish over rubble to clear many at once',
  clearFor: (cost) => `Clear, ${cost} gold`, cleared: 'Rubble cleared',
  holdFestival: (cost) => `Hold a festival, ${cost} gold`, festivalHeld: 'Festival held',
  festivalDoes: (mood, days, every) => `+${mood} mood for ${duiDuration(days)}; the next can follow ${duiDuration(every)} later`,
  festivalOn: (mood, days) => `Festival: +${mood} mood for ${duiDuration(days)} more`,
  nextFestival: (days) => `Next festival in ${duiDuration(days)}`,
  festivalNeedsTemple: 'A festival needs a working temple',
  wouldPassDebt: (n) => `Would put the treasury over ${n} gold in debt`,       // canAfford's floor (src/sim/money.js)
  lastRaid: 'Last raid', endedOn: (date) => `Ended ${date}`,
  noWarning: 'Tribute can be paid only while a raid is on its way', firstRaid: "The first raid can't be paid off.",
  capital: (s) => (s ? s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) : s),
  tributeCost: (cost) => `Pay ${cost} gold of tribute`, goldNow: 'Gold now', goldAfter: 'Gold afterwards',
  cancels: (dir, size) => `Cancels the raid from the ${duiDir(dir)} (${plural(size, 'raider', 'raiders')}). The next raid still comes.`,
  tributeBelowZero: (gold) => `You have ${gold} gold. Tribute can't put the treasury below 0.`,
  payGold: (cost) => `Pay ${cost} gold`, keepGold: 'Keep gold, defend', tributePaid: (cost) => `Tribute paid: ${cost} gold`,
});
```

**with:**

```js
// The fire-risk overlay (spec 4.12, 6.3): every building that can burn, tinted by its band in one ember hue light to dark
// (FIRE_ALPHA, which the legend uses too), with light diagonal hatching on High and dense cross-hatching on Can catch
// fire, and a filled dot where a staffed firehouse reaches it (staffedCover, as the fire row and the alerts say) or a
// hollow ring where none does. Buildings that never burn get nothing. fireRiskMarks is the list the draw and tests share.
export const FIRE_ALPHA = [0.12, 0.26, 0.4, 0.55];
export function fireRiskMarks(world, range = null) {
  const out = [];
  for (const b of allBuildings(world)) {
    if (!canBurn(b)) continue;
    const x = b.x + b.w / 2, y = b.y + b.d / 2;
    if (range && (x < range.x0 || x > range.x1 + 1 || y < range.y0 || y > range.y1 + 1)) continue;
    out.push({ id: b.id, x, y, b, band: fireBand(fireRiskOf(world, b)), has: staffedCover(world, b) });
  }
  return out;
}

// Diagonal stripes both ways as one repeating pattern on the art grid (the counterpart of the drawing context's one-way
// hatching), memoised per context and size.
const crossMemo = new WeakMap();
function crossHatch(g, color, gap) {
  const unit = g.scale * gap, px = Math.max(2, Math.round(unit));
  const key = `${color}|${gap}|${unit}`;
  let byKey = crossMemo.get(g.ctx);
  if (!byKey) { byKey = new Map(); crossMemo.set(g.ctx, byKey); }
  if (byKey.has(key)) return byKey.get(key);
  const tile = document.createElement('canvas');
  tile.width = tile.height = px;
  const t = tile.getContext('2d');
  t.strokeStyle = rgba(color, 0.85);
  t.lineWidth = Math.max(1, (0.9 * px) / gap);
  for (const c of [0, px, 2 * px]) {
    t.beginPath(); t.moveTo(c + px, -px); t.lineTo(c - px, px); t.stroke();
    t.beginPath(); t.moveTo(c - 2 * px, -px); t.lineTo(c, px); t.stroke();
  }
  const pattern = g.ctx.createPattern(tile, 'repeat');
  if (px !== unit) pattern.setTransform(new DOMMatrix().scale(unit / px));
  if (byKey.size >= 16) byKey.clear();
  byKey.set(key, pattern);
  return pattern;
}

function drawFireRisk(g, world, range) {
  const marks = fireRiskMarks(world, range);
  const foot = (m) => tilePolys(Array.from({ length: m.b.w * m.b.d }, (_, k) => [m.b.x + (k % m.b.w), m.b.y + Math.floor(k / m.b.w)]));
  const byBand = [[], [], [], []];
  for (const m of marks) byBand[m.band].push(...foot(m));
  byBand.forEach((polys, k) => g.polys(polys, FIRE_HUE, { alpha: FIRE_ALPHA[k] }));
  g.hatchPolys(byBand[2], FIRE_HUE, { fill: 0, line: 0.6, gap: 5 });
  if (byBand[3].length) g.polys(byBand[3], crossHatch(g, FIRE_HUE, 3));
  for (const m of marks) mark(g, m, FIRE_HUE);
}

// The placement preview's tint (spec 4.7): a teal wash on the tiles a building would make nicer, coral hatching on
```

```js
// The overlay legend strip under the top bar (spec 6.3): name, filled dot = has it, hollow ring = missing,
// and a x that turns the overlay off. A graded overlay (desirability, fire risk) shows its scale instead: a swatch and a
// label per band, hatched as on the map. Overlays combine with browsing, so the strip never changes the mode.
// Stage 3 (Track D): the scale is general (GRADED, one entry per graded overlay); fire risk's adds the dot and ring for
// "a firehouse reaches it" and a line on what never burns.
import { OVERLAYS, OVERLAY_HUE, GRADED_OVERLAYS, DESIRABILITY_ALPHA, FIRE_ALPHA } from '../render/overlays.js';
import { rgba } from '../render/art/ctx.js';
import { UI, TERRAIN } from '../render/art/palette.js';
import { DESIRABILITY_STEPS } from '../data/ui.js';
import { FIRE_BANDS } from '../data/fire.js';
import { toggleOverlay, cycleOverlay } from './modes.js';
import { OVERLAY_NAMES, OVERLAY_LEGEND, desirabilityBand, T, DANGER_UI_TEXT } from './text.js';
import { el, iconButton, clear } from './components.js';

const tint = (c) => `linear-gradient(${c}, ${c})`;
// One graded overlay's legend: its bands in order, each band's { label, words }, and its swatch as the map draws it.
const GRADED = {
  desirability: {
    bands: () => [-1, ...DESIRABILITY_STEPS.map((_, k) => k)],
    band: desirabilityBand,
    hatched: (k) => k < 0,
    swatch: (k) => (k < 0
      ? { backgroundImage: `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, ${UI.bad} 0 1.5px, ${TERRAIN.sand} 1.5px 4px)` }
      : { backgroundImage: tint(rgba(OVERLAY_HUE.desirability, DESIRABILITY_ALPHA[k])), backgroundColor: TERRAIN.sand }),
  },
  fire: {
    bands: () => FIRE_BANDS.map((_, k) => k),
    band: (k) => DANGER_UI_TEXT.fireBand(k),
    hatched: (k) => k >= 2,
    // High: light diagonal stripes; Can catch fire: dense stripes both ways (src/render/overlays.js drawFireRisk).
    swatch: (k) => {
      const hue = OVERLAY_HUE.fire, base = tint(rgba(hue, FIRE_ALPHA[k]));
      const one = `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, ${rgba(hue, 0.6)} 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px)`;
      const two = `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, ${rgba(hue, 0.85)} 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, ${rgba(hue, 0.85)} 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px)`;
      return { backgroundImage: k === 3 ? `${two}, ${base}` : k === 2 ? `${one}, ${base}` : base, backgroundColor: TERRAIN.sand };
    },
  },
};

function scale(kind) {
  const g = GRADED[kind];
  return el('span', { class: 'scale', role: 'list' }, g.bands().map((k) => {
    const b = g.band(k);
    return el('span', { class: 'band', role: 'listitem', 'aria-label': b.words, title: b.words, dataset: { band: String(k) } }, [
      el('span', { class: g.hatched(k) ? 'swatch hatch' : 'swatch', style: g.swatch(k), 'aria-hidden': 'true' }),
      el('span', { class: 'text small', 'aria-hidden': 'true', text: b.label }),
    ]);
  }));
}

function dotKeys(kind) {
  const [has, missing] = OVERLAY_LEGEND[kind];
  const colour = { color: OVERLAY_HUE[kind] };
  return [
    el('span', { class: 'key' }, [el('span', { class: 'dot', style: colour, 'aria-hidden': 'true' }), ' ', el('span', { class: 'text small', text: has })]),
    el('span', { class: 'key' }, [el('span', { class: 'ring', style: colour, 'aria-hidden': 'true' }), ' ', el('span', { class: 'text small', text: missing })]),
  ];
}

// Stage 3 (spec 6.3, ruling 111): on a phone (portrait or compact) with a critical banner up, the strip shrinks to one
// icon button beside the banner (css/ui.css, Track D), so the goals strip stays above the middle of the screen; tapping
// it opens the full legend (the container's 'open' class) and tapping it again shrinks it. The icon is always in the
// strip's place in the DOM; the stylesheet shows one or the other.
export function createOverlayLegend({ container, store }) {
  let lastKind = undefined;

  function render() {
    const kind = store.get().overlay;
    if (kind === lastKind) return;
    lastKind = kind;
    clear(container);
    container.classList.remove('open');
    if (!kind) return;
    const toggle = iconButton(DANGER_UI_TEXT.legendOpen(OVERLAY_NAMES[kind]), '◧', { class: 'legend-icon', 'aria-expanded': 'false' });
    toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = container.classList.toggle('open');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? DANGER_UI_TEXT.legendClose : DANGER_UI_TEXT.legendOpen(OVERLAY_NAMES[kind]));
      toggle.title = toggle.getAttribute('aria-label');
    });
    container.append(toggle);
    const graded = GRADED_OVERLAYS.includes(kind);
    const name = el('strong', { class: 'text', text: OVERLAY_NAMES[kind] });
    const close = iconButton(T.overlayOff, '✕', { class: 'close quiet', onClick: () => store.set(toggleOverlay(store.get(), kind)) });
    let keys;
    if (kind === 'fire') keys = [scale(kind), el('span', { class: 'fire-keys' }, [...dotKeys(kind), el('span', { class: 'text small never-burn', text: DANGER_UI_TEXT.neverBurnNote })])];
    else if (graded) keys = [scale(kind)];
    else keys = dotKeys(kind);
    container.append(el('div', { class: graded ? 'strip graded' : 'strip', role: 'group', 'aria-label': `${OVERLAY_NAMES[kind]} ${T.overlay.toLowerCase()}` }, [name, ...keys, close]));
  }
  render();
  store.subscribe(render);
  return { render, cycle: () => store.set(cycleOverlay(store.get(), OVERLAYS)) };
}
```

```js
const bad = (reason, cost, count, tiles = [], text = reasonText(reason)) => ({ state: 'bad', reason, warnings: [], text, effect: '', cost, count, tiles, refund: 0 });

// Stage 3 (Track D, spec 4.12): the buildings that can burn a firehouse at (x, y) would reach: fireCoverage's own test
// (src/sim/fire.js: a road tile next to the building within FIRE.reach road tiles of the firehouse), counted as if it
// were staffed. Uncached, like homesServedFrom, so a moving ghost leaves nothing in the reach cache.
export function firehouseReachFrom(world, x, y) {
  const def = BUILDINGS.firehouse;
  const reach = roadReach(world, { x, y, w: def.w, d: def.d }, FIRE.reach, { cache: false });
  if (!reach.size) return 0;
  let n = 0;
  for (const b of Object.values(world.buildings)) if (canBurn(b) && adjacentRoadTiles(world, b).some((t) => reach.has(t))) n++;
  return n;
}
```
