## Risks for the implementer and the integrator

- **text.js scope.** Track D's section declares only `dui`-prefixed names and aliased imports; if another track's section declares a name D also uses, the merged module will not load. See the first contract note; after each merge the test page shows a clash at once as `LOAD ERROR` (`Identifier ... has already been declared`).
- **Merges.** Track D edits only its own files and sections, plus three Stage 2 test files that pin the overlay list (`tests/ui/overlaysStage2.test.js`, `tests/ui/overlayUi.test.js`, `tests/render/overlays.test.js`); a track that edits the same lines of those tests (none is planned to) would conflict. `src/data/ui.js` changes one line (`AUTO_OVERLAY`). `sw-files.js` conflicts on every merge: regenerate it. `src/ui/dangerSheets.js` is a new file of Track D's; add it to the ownership table.
- **E's goals strip.** Task E4 adds the next-threshold bar and "1 of 10" to the goals strip. D1's test pins that under a debt banner the goals strip ends above the middle at 375×667 and 844×390 at 100-150% text, and the Stage 2 compact test pins 56% with the legend open; a taller strip after E merges could fail them. If it does, the strip's own height is the cause (E's), not the banner's; the banner already hides its fix line at 125% and 150% on phones.
- **After A and B merge.** The tests set fire and raid state by hand to the contract's shapes, so they keep passing with the real sim; the banner's raid-warning title and the single-fire title then show B's and A's `ALERT_TEXT` words (the tests compare against `alertText`, not literals). D's catch-up before its last task (merging `stage-3-danger`) should screenshot a real fire (`fireDay`) and a real warning (`raidDay`) once: the banner, the chip and the tribute sheet with B's words.
- **The tribute sheet re-renders daily** (createUI's `refreshDaily`) unless a button in it has focus, as every sheet does; when the raiders arrive while it is open it says "Tribute can be paid only while a raid is on its way" and Pay is gone, matching `payTribute`'s `no_warning`.
- **Wall gates.** The gate ghosts and the "N tiles, M gates on roads" line are tested against a hand-made preview in `previewWall`'s contracted shape (map indices in `tiles` and `gates`); when Track B's `previewWall` lands, check one drawn line over a road in the browser.
- **Caption time.** Danger captions use the celebrations row's tier `'info'`, which `CHEER_MS` (`src/data/ui.js`) does not list, so they show for the `'first'` tier's 2.5 s; the raid report also stays in the summary. If Josh wants longer, add `info` to `CHEER_MS` at integration (Track E edits celebrations for citizen remarks, so the controller should make that one-line change, not D).

# Track E: scoring and gamification

CONTRACT NOTE: The summary's parts run in createUI's order `[danger.sheetParts, scoreUi.sheetParts]`, so Track D's last raid report comes before Track E's score section, not after it as the contract's Interface bullet says. Track E cannot edit createUI, and the order works: E returns two nodes, the score section and then the feats section, so the feats sit directly above the achievements (spec 4.19: "listed under achievements in their own group"). If the controller wants the score first, swapping the two entries in createUI's `parts` list is a one-line change.
CONTRACT NOTE: The summary's achievements list belongs to Track D's `src/ui/sheets.js`, and it lists every `ACHIEVEMENTS` entry, so a Peaceful city shows "Raid breaker, 0 of 3" although it can never earn it. Track E exports `achievementsFor(world)` from `src/sim/achievements.js` and uses it in `checkAchievements` and Welcome back. Using it in `sheets.js` `achievementsSection` (`ACHIEVEMENTS` becomes `achievementsFor(world)` in its three uses) is left to Track D or Track F.
CONTRACT NOTE: The contract says the first-fire event goal fires on the alert codes `fire` and `blaze`. A `blaze` alert means a staffed firehouse already reaches the fire, so "Build a firehouse near the fire" would be met the moment it appeared. Track E resolves this in `src/sim/goals.js` with two changes. An event goal's `trigger` may now be a list of codes. An event goal whose need is already met when its trigger first appears does not join the list; it waits for a later trouble. Stage 2's event goals behave exactly as before, because their needs are never met while their alert is up.
CONTRACT NOTE: "Peaceful skips the achievements": Track E skips only the raid achievement (Raid breaker). Wall builder stays, because walls work on Peaceful and ruling 112 names only the "raid feats and achievements". The same rule applies to the feats Untouched and Never bowed, the "Build a tower and a barracks" goal, the first-warning goal, and the wall and tower daily goals.
CONTRACT NOTE: Two functions gain an optional last argument, with their defaults unchanged: `triggerEventGoals(world, alerts = null)` and `showMeTarget(world, goal, alerts = null)`. Track E's tests use it to stand in for fire and raid alerts while `fireAlerts` and `raidAlerts` are still Track 0 stubs.
CONTRACT NOTE: Records gain fields and methods, all additive. A city row gains `bestDay` and `medal`. The records object gains `bestFor(seed, difficulty, { except })` and `stamps()`, and `createRecords` takes `max` (for tests). `src/save/records.js` also exports `normalizeRecords`.
CONTRACT NOTE: Feats about how a milestone was reached are not judged for a city that passed that milestone before Stage 3, because its `world.splits` lacks that day. `featStatus` reports such a feat as missed, and `checkFeats` writes nothing for it. This keeps the contract's test that `checkFeats` leaves a plain city unchanged.
CONTRACT NOTE: The next-threshold bar ("always shows", spec 4.1) steps aside on phones in two cases: while a critical banner is up (ruling 111), and while a tip or a caption shows, because spec 6.1 does not allow the rows to pass the middle of the map. It also hides below Capital when no goal is open, which does not happen in play. The opening chain's count ("1 of 10") replaces the strip's "Goal" label until Town; the longer "1 of 10 done" wrapped the strip past the landscape-phone layout tests.

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { createWorld, housesOf, population } from '../../../src/sim/world.js';
import { scoreOf, scorePreview, scoreRow, medalFor, nextMedal } from '../../../src/sim/score.js';
import { computeCoverage } from '../../../src/sim/housing.js';
import { bazaarsByHouse } from '../../../src/sim/distribution.js';
import { desirabilityField, houseDesirability } from '../../../src/sim/desirability.js';
import { runMonth } from '../../../src/sim/clock.js';
import { buildStressCity } from '../../../src/dev/sampleCity.js';
import { makeTestWorld, setRoad, addRaw, staffAll } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';

// Road along y = 10 in a 32x32 test world.
function street(gold = 1000) {
  const w = makeTestWorld({ gold });
  setRoad(w, 0, 10, 31, 10);
  return w;
}
const homes = (w, n, tier, residents, y = 9) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) addRaw(w, 'house', 10 + i, y, { tier, residents }); };

describe('s3 score parts', () => {
  it('scores an empty city by the formulas: only full jobs, a sound treasury and a safe record count', () => {
    const s = scoreOf(street());
    expect(s.parts).toEqual({ people: 0, prosperity: 50, culture: 0, safety: 100 });
    expect([s.raw, s.total, s.factor, s.version, s.medal]).toEqual([150, 150, 1, 1, null]);
    expect(s.next).toEqual({ medal: 'bronze', points: 10 });
    expect(s.reasons).toEqual({
      people: { code: 'growth', milestone: 'town', people: 0, of: 150 },
      prosperity: { code: 'taxes', perPerson: 0 },
      culture: { code: 'no_homes' },
      safety: null,
    });
  });
  it('counts People as 60 x growth along the milestones by people now plus 40 x the residents\' average tier', () => {
    const w = street();
    w.milestone = 'town';
    homes(w, 10, 5, 20);                                                  // 200 people, every one in a Townhouse
    const s = scoreOf(w);
    expect(population(w)).toBe(200);
    expect(s.parts.people).toBe(Math.round(60 * ((1 + 0.5) / 5) + 40 * ((5 - 1) / 8)));   // halfway from Town to Market town
    expect(s.reasons.people).toEqual({ code: 'growth', milestone: 'market_town', people: 200, of: 250 });
    w.milestone = 'capital';
    for (const h of housesOf(w)) h.tier = 9;
    expect([scoreOf(w).parts.people, scoreOf(w).reasons.people]).toEqual([100, null]);
    w.milestone = 'great_city';
    for (const h of housesOf(w)) h.tier = 2;
    expect(scoreOf(w).reasons.people).toEqual({ code: 'homes', tier: 2 });   // growth 0.8 loses 12, homes 1/8 loses 35
  });
  it('weights the average tier by residents and names the tier most lived-in homes are at', () => {
    const w = street();
    homes(w, 3, 1, 1);
    addRaw(w, 'house', 20, 9, { tier: 9, residents: 9 });                 // (3 x 1 + 9 x 9) / 12 = 7
    addRaw(w, 'house', 21, 9, { tier: 0, residents: 0 });                 // an empty plot counts for nothing
    const s = scoreOf(w);
    expect(s.parts.people).toBe(Math.round(60 * (12 / 150 / 5) + 40 * ((7 - 1) / 8)));
    w.milestone = 'capital';
    expect(scoreOf(w).reasons.people).toEqual({ code: 'homes', tier: 1 });
  });
  it('counts Prosperity from taxes per person, jobs, the treasury and open routes', () => {
    const w = street(-250);
    homes(w, 10, 4, 20);
    w.stats.lastMonth = { taxes: 500, wages: 0, upkeep: 0, soldiers: 0, net: 500 };
    w.labour = { workforce: 100, employed: 80, jobs: 80, shortLevels: [] };
    w.trade.routes = { memphis: true };
    const s = scoreOf(w);
    expect(s.parts.prosperity).toBe(Math.round(30 * (2.5 / 5) + 30 * (1 - 0.15 / 0.25) + 20 * 0.5 + 20 * 0.5));
    expect(s.reasons.prosperity).toEqual({ code: 'jobless', percent: 20 });
    w.labour.employed = 100; w.stats.lastMonth.taxes = 1000; w.trade.routes = { memphis: true, byblos: true };
    expect(scoreOf(w).reasons.prosperity).toEqual({ code: 'debt', gold: 250 });
    w.gold = -600;
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.prosperity).toBe(80);                         // 0 at -500 and below
    w.gold = 5; w.trade.routes = {};
    expect(scoreOf(w).reasons.prosperity).toEqual({ code: 'routes', n: 0 });
  });
  it('counts Culture from the homes a working temple, booth and bazaar reach, as the monthly check does, and pleasant streets', () => {
    const w = street();
    homes(w, 4, 3, 5);                                                    // x 10-13 north of the road
    addRaw(w, 'house', 30, 9, { tier: 3, residents: 5 });                 // far east: no temple reaches it
    addRaw(w, 'temple', 8, 11);
    addRaw(w, 'bazaar', 14, 11);
    addRaw(w, 'booth', 16, 11, { paused: true });                         // a paused booth reaches no one
    staffAll(w);
    const lived = housesOf(w);
    const cov = computeCoverage(w), bz = bazaarsByHouse(w), field = desirabilityField(w);
    const share = (set) => lived.filter((h) => set(h.id)).length / lived.length;
    const avg = lived.reduce((s, h) => s + houseDesirability(w, h, field), 0) / lived.length;
    const want = 25 * share((id) => cov.religion.has(id)) + 25 * share((id) => cov.entertainment.has(id)) + 25 * share((id) => bz.has(id)) + 25 * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, avg / 50));
    expect(share((id) => cov.religion.has(id))).toBe(0.8);
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.culture).toBe(Math.round(want));
    expect(scoreOf(w).reasons.culture).toEqual({ code: 'no_booth', n: 5 });
  });
  it('counts Safety: the fire term only from Town, the share of burnable buildings a staffed firehouse covers', () => {
    const w = street();
    addRaw(w, 'firehouse', 2, 11);
    addRaw(w, 'potter', 4, 11);
    addRaw(w, 'potter', 28, 11);                                          // 26 road tiles away: out of reach
    addRaw(w, 'garden', 6, 11);                                           // never burns: not counted
    staffAll(w);
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.safety).toBe(100);                            // a village: 1 before Town
    w.milestone = 'town';
    const s = scoreOf(w);
    expect(s.parts.safety).toBe(Math.round(40 * (2 / 3) + 40 + 20));
    expect(s.reasons.safety).toEqual({ code: 'fire_cover', n: 1, dir: 'east' });
    w.buildings[1].staff = 1;                                             // a quarter staffed: it works, but does not count as staffed
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.safety).toBe(60);
  });
  it('counts defence against a raid sized now once the raid clock runs, and full on Peaceful', () => {
    const w = street();
    w.milestone = 'market_town';
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.safety).toBe(100);                            // no raid clock yet
    w.raid.clockDay = 0;
    expect([scoreOf(w).parts.safety, scoreOf(w).reasons.safety]).toEqual([60, { code: 'towers', need: 1, towers: 0, soldiers: 0 }]);
    w.soldiers = [{ id: 1 }, { id: 2 }];
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.safety).toBe(Math.round(40 * (2 / 3) + 60));
    addRaw(w, 'tower', 3, 11);
    staffAll(w);
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.safety).toBe(100);                            // capped at 1
    w.difficulty = 'peaceful';
    w.soldiers = []; w.buildings[1].paused = true;
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.safety).toBe(100);
  });
  it('counts the record: 0.2 a building burned and 0.5 a raid lost in the last 360 days', () => {
    const w = street();
    w.day = 1000;
    w.danger.burnDays = [600, 700, 990];                                  // 600 is more than 360 days ago
    expect([scoreOf(w).parts.safety, scoreOf(w).reasons.safety]).toEqual([92, { code: 'burned', n: 2 }]);
    w.raid.last = { index: 1, dir: 'east', size: 4, won: false, byTowers: 0, bySoldiers: 0, towers: 0, burned: 2, stolen: 30, day: 900 };
    expect([scoreOf(w).parts.safety, scoreOf(w).reasons.safety]).toEqual([82, { code: 'raid_lost' }]);
    w.raid.last.won = true;
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.safety).toBe(92);
    w.danger.burnDays = [700, 701, 702, 703, 704, 705, 990];              // never below 0
    w.day = 1001;
    expect(scoreOf(w).parts.safety).toBe(80);
  });
  it('multiplies the parts by the level\'s factor and gives the medal on the parts\' total', () => {
    const w = street();
    w.difficulty = 'hard';
    const s = scoreOf(w);
    expect([s.raw, s.total, s.factor]).toEqual([150, Math.round(150 * 1.25), 1.25]);
    expect([s.medal, s.next]).toEqual([medalFor(150), nextMedal(w, 150)]);
    w.difficulty = 'peaceful';
    expect(scoreOf(w).total).toBe(105);
  });
  it('is the same every time for the same city, and runMonth stores it in the month-end row', () => {
    const w = street();
    homes(w, 4, 2, 6);
    addRaw(w, 'well', 9, 11);
    staffAll(w);
    expect(JSON.stringify(scoreOf(w))).toBe(JSON.stringify(scoreOf(w)));
    runMonth(w, []);
    const row = w.history[w.history.length - 1];
    expect({ score: row.score, parts: row.parts }).toEqual(scoreRow(w));
  });
  it('scores a big city quickly enough to show every game day', () => {
    const w = createWorld({ seed: 11 });
    buildStressCity(w);
    scoreOf(w);                                                           // the reach and desirability caches warm up
    const t0 = performance.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) scoreOf(w);
    expect((performance.now() - t0) / 5).toBeLessThan(20);
  });
});

describe('s3 score previews', () => {
  it('previews the parts a building would change, counted as staffed, and leaves the city exactly as it was', () => {
    const w = street();
    homes(w, 4, 3, 5);
    staffAll(w);
    const before = JSON.stringify(w);
    const p = scorePreview(w, 'temple', 8, 11);
    expect(p.culture).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect([p.people, p.prosperity]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(w)).toBe(before);
    expect(scorePreview(w, 'temple', 10, 9)).toEqual({ people: 0, prosperity: 0, culture: 0, safety: 0 });   // on a home: nothing
    expect(scorePreview(w, 'temple', 31, 31)).toEqual({ people: 0, prosperity: 0, culture: 0, safety: 0 });  // off the map
    expect(scorePreview(w, 'nothing', 3, 3)).toEqual({ people: 0, prosperity: 0, culture: 0, safety: 0 });
  });
  it('previews a firehouse raising Safety and a potter lowering it, from Town', () => {
    const w = street();
    w.milestone = 'town';
    addRaw(w, 'potter', 4, 11);
    staffAll(w);
    expect(scorePreview(w, 'firehouse', 2, 11).safety).toBe(40);
    expect(scorePreview(w, 'potter', 28, 11).safety).toBe(0);            // still nothing covered: 0 of 2 as 0 of 1
    addRaw(w, 'firehouse', 2, 11);
    staffAll(w);
    expect(scorePreview(w, 'potter', 28, 11).safety).toBe(Math.round(40 * (2 / 3) + 60) - 100);
  });
});
```

`src/sim/score.js` (replace the whole file):

```js
// The city score (spec 4.19): four parts measured from the city's state, never from clicks, the clock, pausing or undo,
// and never gating anything. Stage 3 contract: Track 0 fixed the names, signatures and shapes; Track E implements them.
// runMonth stores each month's score and parts in the history row (src/sim/clock.js).
//
// Each part is 0-100, the weighted sum of terms that are each 0 to 1 (SCORE_WEIGHTS, SCORE_TERMS in data/scoring.js):
//   people      60 growth (milestones after Village + the fraction to the next by people now, / 5; 1 at Capital)
//               + 40 homes ((the residents' average tier - 1) / 8)
//   prosperity  30 taxes (last month's tax per person / 5) + 30 jobs (full at 5% jobless, 0 at 30%)
//               + 20 treasury (1 at 0 gold or more, 0 at -500) + 20 trade (open routes / 2)
//   culture     25 each: the share of lived-in homes a working temple, booth and bazaar reach, and pleasant (the
//               homes' average desirability / 50)
//   safety      40 fire (the share of buildings that can burn a staffed firehouse covers; 1 before Town) + 40 defence
//               ((working towers + soldiers / 3) / the towers a raid sized now needs; 1 before the raid clock and on
//               Peaceful) + 20 record (1 - 0.2 a building burned and 0.5 a raid lost in the last 360 days)
// A city with no lived-in homes scores 0 on homes and on every culture term.
//
// Reasons: per part, null when the part is 100, else the term that lost it the most points (weight x (1 - term); ties to
// the first term), as { code, ... }:
//   growth { milestone, people, of }   homes { tier } (the tier most lived-in homes are at)   no_homes {}
//   taxes { perPerson }   jobless { percent }   debt { gold }   routes { n }
//   no_temple { n }   no_booth { n }   no_bazaar { n } (lived-in homes not reached)   plain { value }
//   fire_cover { n, dir } (buildings that can burn with no staffed firehouse; dir their side of the city or null)
//   towers { need, towers, soldiers }   burned { n }   raid_lost {}
// The words are SCORE_TEXT's (src/ui/text.js).
import { SCORE_VERSION, SCORE_PARTS, SCORE_WEIGHTS, SCORE_TERMS, SCORE_FACTOR, MEDALS, SPLIT_MILESTONES } from '../data/scoring.js';
import { MILESTONES } from '../data/progression.js';
import { BUILDINGS } from '../data/buildings.js';
import { DAYS_PER_MONTH } from './time.js';
import { allBuildings, housesOf, population, makeBuilding, insertBuilding, removeBuilding } from './world.js';
import { footprint, idx, inBounds } from './grid.js';
import { milestoneIndex } from './progression.js';
import { roadReach, adjacentRoadTiles } from './reach.js';
import { isWorking } from './labour.js';
import { desirabilityField, houseDesirability } from './desirability.js';
import { openRoutes } from './trade.js';
import { canBurn, fireStarted, fireCoverage } from './fire.js';
import { FIRE } from '../data/fire.js';
import { raidSize, towersNeeded, workingTowers } from './raids.js';
import { raidsOn } from './costs.js';

const zeroParts = () => Object.fromEntries(SCORE_PARTS.map((p) => [p, 0]));
const clamp01 = (v) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
const T = SCORE_TERMS;

// The difficulty's score factor.
export const scoreFactor = (world) => SCORE_FACTOR[world.difficulty];

// The best medal a parts' total earns ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold'), or null.
export function medalFor(raw) {
  let medal = null;
  for (const m of MEDALS) if (raw >= m.at) medal = m.id;
  return medal;
}

// The next medal above a parts' total and the city-score points to it ({ medal, points }), or null at gold. Medals sit on
// the parts' total, but show in city-score points: the medal's total times the factor, rounded, less the city score.
export function nextMedal(world, raw) {
  const f = scoreFactor(world);
  const m = MEDALS.find((x) => raw < x.at);
  return m ? { medal: m.id, points: Math.max(1, Math.round(m.at * f) - Math.round(raw * f)) } : null;
}

// Homes with people in them.
const livedHomes = (world) => housesOf(world).filter((h) => h.tier >= 1 && h.residents > 0);

// People: growth along the milestones by people now, and the residents' average tier.
function peopleTerms(world, lived) {
  const i = milestoneIndex(world.milestone);
  const pop = population(world);
  let growth;
  if (i >= MILESTONES.length - 1) growth = { value: 1, reason: null };
  else {
    const from = MILESTONES[i].population, next = MILESTONES[i + 1];
    const frac = clamp01((pop - from) / (next.population - from));
    growth = { value: Math.min(1, (i + frac) / T.growthSteps), reason: { code: 'growth', milestone: next.id, people: pop, of: next.population } };
  }
  if (!lived.length) return { growth, homes: { value: 0, reason: { code: 'no_homes' } } };
  let res = 0, weighted = 0;
  const byTier = new Map();
  for (const h of lived) {
    res += h.residents;
    weighted += h.tier * h.residents;
    byTier.set(h.tier, (byTier.get(h.tier) || 0) + 1);
  }
  let tier = 0, most = -1;
  for (const [t, n] of [...byTier.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])) if (n > most) { most = n; tier = t; }
  return { growth, homes: { value: clamp01((weighted / res - 1) / T.homesSpan), reason: { code: 'homes', tier } } };
}

// Prosperity: last month's taxes per person, jobs, the treasury and open trade routes.
function prosperityTerms(world) {
  const pop = population(world);
  const last = world.stats.lastMonth;
  const perPerson = last && pop > 0 ? last.taxes / pop : 0;
  const L = world.labour;
  const rate = L && L.workforce > 0 ? (L.workforce - L.employed) / L.workforce : 0;
  const routes = openRoutes(world);
  return {
    taxes: { value: Math.min(1, perPerson / T.taxPerPerson), reason: { code: 'taxes', perPerson: Math.round(perPerson * 10) / 10 } },
    jobs: { value: clamp01(1 - (rate - T.jobsFull) / (T.jobsZero - T.jobsFull)), reason: { code: 'jobless', percent: Math.round(rate * 100) } },
    treasury: { value: world.gold >= 0 ? 1 : clamp01(1 - world.gold / T.treasuryZero), reason: { code: 'debt', gold: -world.gold } },
    trade: { value: Math.min(1, routes / T.routes), reason: { code: 'routes', n: routes } },
  };
}

// How many lived-in homes a working building passing `matches` reaches along the roads, as coveredBy and bazaarsByHouse
// judge it (a road tile next to the home within the building's reach): the road tiles every such building reaches go
// into one set, then each home looks for one of its own road tiles in it, so the cost is providers plus homes, never
// providers times homes.
function reached(world, homeTiles, matches) {
  const tiles = new Set();
  for (const b of allBuildings(world)) {
    const def = BUILDINGS[b.type];
    if (!matches(def) || !def.reach || !isWorking(world, b)) continue;
    for (const t of roadReach(world, b, def.reach).keys()) tiles.add(t);   // roadReach stops at the reach
  }
  if (!tiles.size) return 0;
  let n = 0;
  for (const list of homeTiles) if (list.some((t) => tiles.has(t))) n++;
  return n;
}

// Culture: temple, entertainment and bazaar reach, and pleasant streets.
function cultureTerms(world, lived) {
  if (!lived.length) {
    const none = { value: 0, reason: { code: 'no_homes' } };
    return { temple: none, entertainment: none, bazaar: none, pleasant: none };
  }
  const homeTiles = lived.map((h) => adjacentRoadTiles(world, h));
  const share = (matches, code) => {
    const n = reached(world, homeTiles, matches);
    return { value: n / lived.length, reason: { code, n: lived.length - n } };
  };
  const field = desirabilityField(world);
  const avg = lived.reduce((s, h) => s + houseDesirability(world, h, field), 0) / lived.length;
  return {
    temple: share((d) => d.provides === 'religion', 'no_temple'),
    entertainment: share((d) => d.provides === 'entertainment', 'no_booth'),
    bazaar: share((d) => Boolean(d.sells), 'no_bazaar'),
    pleasant: { value: clamp01(avg / T.pleasant), reason: { code: 'plain', value: Math.round(avg) } },
  };
}

// The side of the city a set of buildings lies on, seen from the centre of all of them: 'east' (x up), 'west', 'south'
// (y up) or 'north', or null when they sit near the middle or all round it.
function sideOf(all, some) {
  const centre = (list) => list.reduce((c, b) => ({ x: c.x + (b.x + b.w / 2) / list.length, y: c.y + (b.y + b.d / 2) / list.length }), { x: 0, y: 0 });
  const a = centre(all), s = centre(some);
  const dx = s.x - a.x, dy = s.y - a.y;
  if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 4) return null;
  return Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dy) ? (dx > 0 ? 'east' : 'west') : (dy > 0 ? 'south' : 'north');
}

// Safety: firehouse cover, defence against a raid sized now, and the last year's record.
function safetyTerms(world) {
  let fire = { value: 1, reason: null };
  if (fireStarted(world)) {
    const all = allBuildings(world);
    const burnable = all.filter(canBurn);
    const cover = fireCoverage(world);                  // once: staffedCover's rule (coverage >= FIRE.staffedAt) per building
    const open = burnable.filter((b) => !((cover.get(b.id) || 0) >= FIRE.staffedAt));
    if (burnable.length) fire = { value: (burnable.length - open.length) / burnable.length, reason: { code: 'fire_cover', n: open.length, dir: open.length ? sideOf(burnable, open) : null } };
  }
  let defence = { value: 1, reason: null };
  if (raidsOn(world) && world.raid.clockDay !== null) {
    const need = towersNeeded(raidSize(world));
    const towers = workingTowers(world), soldiers = world.soldiers.length;
    defence = { value: Math.min(1, (towers + soldiers / 3) / need), reason: { code: 'towers', need, towers, soldiers } };
  }
  const since = (day) => world.day - day < T.recordDays;
  const burned = world.danger.burnDays.filter(since).length;
  const last = world.raid.last;
  const lost = last && !last.won && since(last.day) ? 1 : 0;
  const burnedLoss = T.burnedPenalty * burned, lostLoss = T.raidLostPenalty * lost;
  const record = {
    value: Math.max(0, 1 - burnedLoss - lostLoss),
    reason: lostLoss >= burnedLoss && lost ? { code: 'raid_lost' } : { code: 'burned', n: burned },
  };
  return { fire, defence, record };
}

// A part from its terms: round(sum of weight x term), and the reason of the term that lost the most points.
function partOf(part, terms) {
  const weights = SCORE_WEIGHTS[part];
  let sum = 0, worst = null, worstLoss = 0;
  for (const [term, w] of Object.entries(weights)) {
    const t = terms[term];
    sum += w * t.value;
    const loss = w * (1 - t.value);
    if (loss > worstLoss + 1e-9) { worstLoss = loss; worst = t.reason; }
  }
  const value = Math.round(sum);
  return { value, reason: value >= 100 ? null : worst };
}

// The score now: { version, total, raw, factor, parts, reasons, medal, next }
//   parts    { people, prosperity, culture, safety }, each a whole number 0-100 (spec 4.19 formulas, data/scoring.js)
//   raw      the parts' sum (0-400); total: round(raw x factor), the city score
//   reasons  per part, null or { code, ... }: the term that lost the part the most points, for its reason line
//            (codes and their fields above; the words live in SCORE_TEXT in src/ui/text.js)
//   medal    medalFor(raw); next: nextMedal(world, raw)
export function scoreOf(world) {
  const lived = livedHomes(world);
  const all = {
    people: partOf('people', peopleTerms(world, lived)),
    prosperity: partOf('prosperity', prosperityTerms(world)),
    culture: partOf('culture', cultureTerms(world, lived)),
    safety: partOf('safety', safetyTerms(world)),
  };
  const parts = zeroParts();
  const reasons = {};
  for (const p of SCORE_PARTS) { parts[p] = all[p].value; reasons[p] = all[p].reason; }
  const raw = SCORE_PARTS.reduce((s, p) => s + parts[p], 0);
  const factor = scoreFactor(world);
  return { version: SCORE_VERSION, total: Math.round(raw * factor), raw, factor, parts, reasons, medal: medalFor(raw), next: nextMedal(world, raw) };
}

// What placing a building of this type at (x, y) would change, counting it as staffed: { people, prosperity, culture,
// safety } in whole points (the confirm bar shows changes of 1 or more: src/ui/scoreUi.js scoreLineFor). The building is
// put in for the count and taken out again, so the world is left exactly as it was: its workers come from the jobless
// first (no other building loses staff), and its price is left out (the building changes the parts, not the payment).
// Zeros for an unknown type or a footprint that is off the map or not free.
export function scorePreview(world, type, x, y) {
  const def = BUILDINGS[type];
  if (!def) return zeroParts();
  for (const [tx, ty] of footprint(x, y, def.w, def.d)) if (!inBounds(world.size, tx, ty) || world.occ[idx(world.size, tx, ty)]) return zeroParts();
  const before = scoreOf(world).parts;
  const nextId = world.nextId, labour = world.labour;
  const b = makeBuilding(world, type, x, y);
  b.staff = def.workers || 0;
  insertBuilding(world, b);
  if (def.workers) world.labour = { ...labour, employed: Math.min(labour.workforce, labour.employed + def.workers), jobs: labour.jobs + def.workers };
  let after;
  try { after = scoreOf(world).parts; } finally {
    removeBuilding(world, b.id);
    world.nextId = nextId;
    world.labour = labour;
  }
  return Object.fromEntries(SCORE_PARTS.map((p) => [p, after[p] - before[p]]));
}

// Game-months from the start to each milestone the city has reached (world.splits), null where not reached.
export function splitMonths(world) {
  return Object.fromEntries(SPLIT_MILESTONES.map((id) => [id, Number.isInteger(world.splits[id]) ? Math.floor(world.splits[id] / DAYS_PER_MONTH) : null]));
}

// The month-end history row's score fields (runMonth): { score, parts }.
export function scoreRow(world) {
  const s = scoreOf(world);
  return { score: s.total, parts: { ...s.parts } };
}

// The sealReign command (spec 4.19, 7.3): records the day and the score in the world; never refused, and repeatable.
// The interface then writes the chronicle entry (src/save/records.js). { ok: true, warnings: [], seal }.
export function sealReign(world) {
  const s = scoreOf(world);
  const seal = { day: world.day, score: s.total, parts: { ...s.parts }, medal: s.medal, version: s.version };
  world.seals.push(seal);
  return { ok: true, warnings: [], seal };
}
```

`src/ui/scoreUi.js` (replace the whole file):

```js
// The score interface (spec 4.1, 4.17, 4.19): the summary's score section with Seal this reign and Share score, the
// score chip on the summary button, the next-threshold bar, the "+N" score preview in the confirm bar, feats, citizen
// remarks, and the title card's records, stamps, weekly seed and shared score. Stage 3 contract: createUI makes one per
// game exactly as it makes the danger interface (src/ui/danger.js: the same ctx, the same returned shape), and boot.js
// decorates the title card through titleDecor.
//
// The score is measured, never stored by the interface: current() asks scoreOf (src/sim/score.js) at most once per game
// day and command, since the sim changes the city only on a day's tick or through a command (both reach this object:
// refresh after each day, onCommand and onEvents after each command).
import { SCORE_PARTS, SPLIT_MILESTONES } from '../data/scoring.js';
import { scoreOf, scorePreview } from '../sim/score.js';
import { el, setText } from './components.js';
import { SCORE_TEXT, scoreReasonText, scoreChipText, medalText, nextMedalText, partBarLabel, factorText, scoreLineText, splitDateText } from './text.js';

// Returns { sheets, sheetParts: { building, house, actions, summary }, onEvents, refresh, onAlertAction, onCommand,
// destroy } (danger.js). Share score's screenshot button calls ctx.screenshotMode().
export function createScoreUi(ctx) {
  const { world, root } = ctx;
  let version = 0, cached = null;
  // The score now, measured once per game day and command.
  function current() {
    const key = `${world.day}|${version}`;
    if (!cached || cached.key !== key) cached = { key, score: scoreOf(world) };
    return cached.score;
  }

  // One part: its name and number, a bar (the number again, for sight; never alone) and its reason line.
  function partRow(part, s) {
    const n = s.parts[part];
    return el('li', { class: 'score-part', dataset: { part } }, [
      el('div', { class: 'row' }, [el('span', { text: SCORE_TEXT.parts[part] }), el('strong', { class: 'part-number', text: String(n) })]),
      el('span', { class: 'part-bar', role: 'progressbar', 'aria-valuemin': '0', 'aria-valuemax': '100', 'aria-valuenow': String(n), 'aria-label': partBarLabel(part, n) }, [
        el('span', { class: 'fill', style: { width: `${n}%` } }),
      ]),
      s.reasons[part] ? el('p', { class: 'reason small muted', text: scoreReasonText(s.reasons[part]) }) : null,
    ]);
  }

  // The milestone splits as game dates, in order; the ones not reached are left out.
  function splitsBlock() {
    const reached = SPLIT_MILESTONES.filter((id) => Number.isInteger(world.splits[id]));
    return [
      el('h4', { class: 'splits-heading', text: SCORE_TEXT.splits }),
      reached.length
        ? el('ul', { class: 'splits' }, reached.map((id) => el('li', { class: 'split', dataset: { id }, text: splitDateText(id, world.splits[id]) })))
        : el('p', { class: 'small muted', text: SCORE_TEXT.noSplits }),
    ];
  }

  // The summary's score section (spec 4.19): the city score, its medal and the points to the next one, each part with
  // its bar and reason, and the milestone splits.
  function summarySection() {
    const s = current();
    return el('section', { class: 'score-section' }, [
      el('h3', { text: SCORE_TEXT.cityScore }),
      el('p', { class: 'score-total' }, [
        el('strong', { class: 'score-number', text: String(s.total) }), ' ',
        el('span', { class: `medal ${s.medal || 'none'}`, text: medalText(s.medal) }),
      ]),
      el('p', { class: 'next-medal small muted', text: nextMedalText(s.next) }),
      s.factor !== 1 ? el('p', { class: 'factor small muted', text: factorText(s.raw, s.factor, world.difficulty) }) : null,
      el('ul', { class: 'score-parts' }, SCORE_PARTS.map((p) => partRow(p, s))),
      ...splitsBlock(),
    ]);
  }

  // The chip on the summary button (hud.js makes the empty node): the live total, refreshed with the chrome.
  function renderChip() {
    const chip = root.querySelector('#topbar .score-chip');
    if (!chip) return;
    setText(chip, scoreChipText(current().total));
    chip.hidden = false;
  }

  return {
    sheets: {},
    // Made without a world (the contract's shape test), it has no parts.
    sheetParts: { building: () => [], house: () => [], actions: () => [], summary: () => (world ? [summarySection()] : []) },
    onEvents(events) { if (events.length) version++; },
    refresh() { if (world) renderChip(); },
    onAlertAction() {},
    onCommand() { version++; },
    destroy() {},
  };
}

// The confirm bar's score line for a building ghost that can be placed at (x, y): the parts it would change by 1 point
// or more, counting it as staffed ("+3 Culture"), or '' for none. placement.js calls it for every preview, so it
// memoises on the ghost tile and the city's state (the day, the buildings, the roads and the labour), as nicerFor does.
const lineMemo = new WeakMap();   // world -> { key, value }
export function scoreLineFor(world, type, x, y) {
  const L = world.labour;
  const key = `${type}|${x}|${y}|${world.day}|${world.nextId}|${Object.keys(world.buildings).length}|${world.roadVersion}|${L.employed}|${L.jobs}|${world.gold}`;
  const m = lineMemo.get(world);
  if (m && m.key === key) return m.value;
  const value = scoreLineText(scorePreview(world, type, x, y));
  lineMemo.set(world, { key, value });
  return value;
}

// STUB. The title card's decoration (spec 4.1, 4.19): the three highest bests and a stamp per sealed reign under
// Continue, This week's Nile, and a shared score link's "Beat N?" with Start this seed. boot.js calls titleDecor once per
// title card and passes the result to createTitleCard as decorate, which calls it with (element, { buttonBox, newCity }).
// opts: { records (src/save/records.js), shared (the page's location hash, '' for none), startSeed(seed) (starts a
// city on that seed, asking first when a city is saved, as New city does), clock }.
export function titleDecor(opts) {
  return () => {};
}
```

with

```js
//
// ── s3 score (Track E) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Track E's words for scoring: parts, reasons, medals, splits, records, sharing, feats, remarks, and the danger goals, firsts, achievements, daily goals and tips. Add new lines just above the end marker.
// Imports for this section only, aliased so no other section's names can clash (import declarations are hoisted).
import { DAYS_PER_MONTH as SCORE_DAYS_PER_MONTH, MONTHS_PER_YEAR as SCORE_MONTHS_PER_YEAR } from '../sim/time.js';
// The score (spec 4.19): parts, reasons, medals, the chip, the confirm bar's "+3 Culture" and the summary's section. Every
// number comes from scoreOf (src/sim/score.js); the reason codes and their fields are listed there.
export const SCORE_TEXT = {
  score: 'Score', cityScore: 'City score', splits: 'Milestones', noSplits: 'No milestones yet',
  parts: { people: 'People', prosperity: 'Prosperity', culture: 'Culture', safety: 'Safety' },
  medals: { bronze: 'Bronze', silver: 'Silver', gold: 'Gold' },
  noMedal: 'No medal yet', topMedal: 'The highest medal',
  noHomes: 'No one lives here yet', noRoute: 'No trade route yet', raidLost: 'A raid was lost in the last year',
  scoreHelp: 'The score measures the city as it stands now. It never changes what you can build.',
};
const SIDE_STREETS = { east: 'the east streets', west: 'the west streets', north: 'the north streets', south: 'the south streets' };
const milestoneName = (id) => (MILESTONES.find((m) => m.id === id) || { name: id }).name;
// One part's reason line, from scoreOf's reasons[part] ({ code, ... }); '' for none.
export function scoreReasonText(r) {
  if (!r) return '';
  switch (r.code) {
    case 'growth': return `${milestoneName(r.milestone)}: ${progressText(r.people, r.of)} people`;
    case 'homes': return `Most homes are ${TIERS[r.tier].name}s`;
    case 'no_homes': return SCORE_TEXT.noHomes;
    case 'taxes': return `Taxes bring ${r.perPerson} gold a person: bigger homes pay more`;
    case 'jobless': return `${r.percent}% of workers have no job`;
    case 'debt': return `The treasury is ${r.gold} gold in debt`;
    case 'routes': return r.n === 0 ? SCORE_TEXT.noRoute : `Only ${plural(r.n, 'trade route is', 'trade routes are')} open`;
    case 'no_temple': return `${plural(r.n, 'home has', 'homes have')} no temple`;
    case 'no_booth': return `${plural(r.n, 'home has', 'homes have')} no entertainment`;
    case 'no_bazaar': return `${plural(r.n, 'home has', 'homes have')} no bazaar`;
    case 'plain': return `Homes average ${r.value} of 50 desirability`;
    case 'fire_cover': return `No staffed firehouse reaches ${r.dir ? SIDE_STREETS[r.dir] : plural(r.n, 'building', 'buildings')}`;
    case 'towers': return `A raid this size needs ${plural(r.need, 'tower', 'towers')}; you have ${r.towers} working${r.soldiers ? ` and ${plural(r.soldiers, 'soldier', 'soldiers')}` : ''}`;
    case 'burned': return `${plural(r.n, 'building', 'buildings')} burned in the last year`;
    case 'raid_lost': return SCORE_TEXT.raidLost;
    default: return '';
  }
}
export const scoreChipText = (total) => `${SCORE_TEXT.score} ${total}`;
export const medalText = (medal) => (medal ? `${SCORE_TEXT.medals[medal]} medal` : SCORE_TEXT.noMedal);
export const nextMedalText = (next) => (next ? `${plural(next.points, 'point', 'points')} to ${SCORE_TEXT.medals[next.medal]}` : SCORE_TEXT.topMedal);
export const partBarLabel = (part, n) => `${SCORE_TEXT.parts[part]}: ${progressText(n, 100)}`;
export const factorText = (raw, factor, level) => `Parts ${raw} × ${factor} on ${DIFFICULTY_NAMES[level] || level}`;
// The confirm bar's score line: the parts that would change by a whole point or more ("+3 Culture, −1 Safety"); '' for none.
export const scoreLineText = (delta) => Object.keys(SCORE_TEXT.parts).filter((p) => Math.abs(delta[p] || 0) >= 1)
  .map((p) => `${delta[p] > 0 ? '+' : '−'}${Math.abs(delta[p])} ${SCORE_TEXT.parts[p]}`).join(', ');
// A milestone split as a game date: "Town in year 2, month 3" (day 0 is year 1, month 1).
const SCORE_YEAR_DAYS = SCORE_DAYS_PER_MONTH * SCORE_MONTHS_PER_YEAR;
export const splitDateText = (id, day) => `${milestoneName(id)} in year ${Math.floor(day / SCORE_YEAR_DAYS) + 1}, month ${Math.floor((day % SCORE_YEAR_DAYS) / SCORE_DAYS_PER_MONTH) + 1}`;
// ── end s3 score ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

//
```

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { createRecords, emptyRecords, mergeRecords, normalizeRecords } from '../../../src/save/records.js';
import { RECORDS_KEY } from '../../../src/data/scoring.js';
import { createWorld } from '../../../src/sim/world.js';

// A storage that keeps what is written, as localStorage does.
function memory(start = null) {
  const data = start ? { [RECORDS_KEY]: JSON.stringify(start) } : {};
  return { data, getItem: (k) => (k in data ? data[k] : null), setItem: (k, v) => { data[k] = String(v); } };
}
const parts = (n) => ({ people: n, prosperity: n, culture: n, safety: n });
// A city with month-end rows of these scores (each row's parts are a quarter of its score, so on Normal the medal follows).
function city({ seed = 11, difficulty = 'normal', id = 'a', scores = [], splits = {} } = {}) {
  const w = createWorld({ seed, difficulty, cityId: id });
  w.history = scores.map((score, i) => ({ day: (i + 1) * 30, people: 0, gold: 0, mood: 60, score, parts: parts(score / 4) }));
  w.splits = splits;
  return w;
}

describe('s3 score records', () => {
  it('reads nothing, garbage and blocked storage as empty records, and never throws on a failed write', () => {
    expect(createRecords({ storage: memory() }).load()).toEqual(emptyRecords());
    const junk = { getItem: () => '{not json', setItem: () => {} };
    expect(createRecords({ storage: junk }).load()).toEqual(emptyRecords());
    const blocked = { getItem: () => { throw new Error('blocked'); }, setItem: () => { throw new Error('full'); } };
    const r = createRecords({ storage: blocked });
    expect(r.load()).toEqual(emptyRecords());
    r.noteCity(city({ scores: [100] }), 5);
    r.addSeal(city(), { day: 1, score: 1, parts: parts(0), medal: null, version: 1 }, 5);
    expect(r.bests()).toEqual([]);
    expect(createRecords({ storage: null }).load()).toEqual(emptyRecords());
  });
  it('notes a city row on every save: seed, level, version, the best month-end score with its medal, and the splits', () => {
    const storage = memory();
    const r = createRecords({ storage });
    const w = city({ scores: [100, 240, 200], splits: { town: 300 } });
    r.noteCity(w, 1000);
    expect(r.load().cities).toEqual([{ id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: 240, bestDay: 60, medal: 'silver', splits: { town: 300 }, updated: 1000 }]);
    w.history = [{ day: 400, people: 0, gold: 0, mood: 60, score: 150, parts: parts(37.5) }];   // the 240 has left the 12 rows
    w.splits.market_town = 500;
    r.noteCity(w, 2000);
    expect(r.load().cities[0]).toEqual({ id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: 240, bestDay: 60, medal: 'silver', splits: { town: 300, market_town: 500 }, updated: 2000 });
    r.noteCity(city({ id: 'b', scores: [] }), 3000);                       // no month end yet: a row, but no best
    expect(r.load().cities[1].best).toBe(null);
    r.noteCity({ ...w, cityId: null }, 4000);                             // no id: nothing
    expect(r.load().cities.length).toBe(2);
    expect(JSON.parse(storage.data[RECORDS_KEY]).version).toBe(1);
  });
  it('lists the highest bests, one per seed and level, and labels a best made under an older score version', () => {
    const r = createRecords({ storage: memory({ version: 1, cities: [
      { id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: 312, bestDay: 900, medal: 'gold', splits: {}, updated: 1 },
      { id: 'b', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: 200, bestDay: 900, medal: 'bronze', splits: {}, updated: 2 },
      { id: 'c', seed: 11, difficulty: 'hard', scoreVersion: 1, best: 250, bestDay: 900, medal: 'bronze', splits: {}, updated: 3 },
      { id: 'd', seed: 7, difficulty: 'relaxed', scoreVersion: 0, best: 280, bestDay: 900, medal: 'gold', splits: {}, updated: 4 },
      { id: 'e', seed: 8, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: 100, bestDay: 900, medal: null, splits: {}, updated: 5 },
      { id: 'f', seed: 9, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: null, splits: {}, updated: 6 },
    ], chronicle: [] }) });
    expect(r.bests()).toEqual([
      { seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', score: 312, medal: 'gold', version: 1, older: false },
      { seed: 7, difficulty: 'relaxed', score: 280, medal: 'gold', version: 0, older: true },
      { seed: 11, difficulty: 'hard', score: 250, medal: 'bronze', version: 1, older: false },
    ]);
    expect(r.bests(10).length).toBe(4);
    expect(r.bestFor(11, 'normal', { except: 'a' })).toEqual({ score: 200, splits: {} });
    expect(r.bestFor(11, 'peaceful')).toBe(null);
  });
  it('gives the best splits on a seed and level from the other cities, the earliest day of each milestone', () => {
    const r = createRecords({ storage: memory() });
    r.noteCity(city({ id: 'a', scores: [120], splits: { town: 400, market_town: 900 } }), 1);
    r.noteCity(city({ id: 'b', scores: [90], splits: { town: 500, market_town: 700 } }), 2);
    r.noteCity(city({ id: 'c', scores: [300], splits: { town: 100 } }), 3);
    expect(r.bestFor(11, 'normal', { except: 'c' })).toEqual({ score: 120, splits: { town: 400, market_town: 700 } });
  });
  it('adds a chronicle entry for each seal, with the city\'s splits, feats and the device\'s date, newest first as stamps', () => {
    const r = createRecords({ storage: memory() });
    const w = city({ splits: { town: 300 } });
    w.feats.earned = ['swift_town'];
    w.seals.push({ day: 800, score: 247, parts: { people: 72, prosperity: 65, culture: 58, safety: 52 }, medal: 'silver', version: 1 });
    const e = r.addSeal(w, w.seals[0], 5000);
    expect(e).toEqual({ id: 'a:1:800', cityId: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', day: 800, score: 247, parts: { people: 72, prosperity: 65, culture: 58, safety: 52 },
      splits: { town: 300 }, medal: 'silver', feats: ['swift_town'], version: 1, date: 5000 });
    w.seals.push({ day: 900, score: 250, parts: parts(62.5), medal: 'silver', version: 1 });
    r.addSeal(w, w.seals[1], 6000);
    expect(r.stamps().map((x) => x.id)).toEqual(['a:2:900', 'a:1:800']);
    expect(r.load().chronicle.length).toBe(2);
  });
  it('merges an imported file by id: the better best, the earlier splits, each entry once, and drops what is not a record', () => {
    const mine = { version: 1, cities: [{ id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: 200, bestDay: 60, medal: 'bronze', splits: { town: 400 }, updated: 10 }],
      chronicle: [{ id: 'a:1:60', cityId: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', day: 60, score: 200, parts: parts(50), splits: {}, medal: 'bronze', feats: [], version: 1, date: 10 }] };
    const theirs = { version: 1, cities: [
      { id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: 260, bestDay: 90, medal: 'silver', splits: { town: 450, market_town: 800 }, updated: 5 },
      { id: 'z', seed: 3, difficulty: 'hard', scoreVersion: 1, best: 50, bestDay: 30, medal: null, splits: {}, updated: 1 },
      { id: 'bad', seed: 'eleven', difficulty: 'normal' }, 'nonsense',
    ], chronicle: [mine.chronicle[0], { id: 'z:1:30', cityId: 'z', seed: 3, difficulty: 'hard', day: 30, score: 50, parts: parts(10), splits: {}, medal: null, feats: [], version: 1, date: 1 }, { id: 'x' }] };
    const m = mergeRecords(mine, theirs);
    expect(m.cities.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(['a', 'z']);
    expect(m.cities[0]).toEqual({ id: 'a', seed: 11, difficulty: 'normal', scoreVersion: 1, best: 260, bestDay: 90, medal: 'silver', splits: { town: 400, market_town: 800 }, updated: 10 });
    expect(m.chronicle.map((e) => e.id)).toEqual(['a:1:60', 'z:1:30']);
    const storage = memory(mine);
    createRecords({ storage }).merge(theirs);
    expect(createRecords({ storage }).load()).toEqual(m);
    expect(normalizeRecords('junk')).toEqual(emptyRecords());
  });
  it('keeps at most the cap in each list, dropping the oldest first but never a best', () => {
    const storage = memory();
    const r = createRecords({ storage, max: 3 });
    r.noteCity(city({ id: 'old-best', scores: [300], splits: { town: 200 } }), 1);   // the oldest, but the best score and the earliest Town
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) r.noteCity(city({ id: `c${i}`, scores: [100 + i], splits: { town: 900 + i } }), 10 + i);
    expect(r.load().cities.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(['old-best', 'c2', 'c3']);
    const w = city({ id: 'x' });
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      w.seals.push({ day: i, score: i === 0 ? 400 : 10 + i, parts: parts(i), medal: null, version: 1 });
      r.addSeal(w, w.seals[i], 100 + i);
    }
    expect(r.load().chronicle.map((e) => e.score)).toEqual([400, 13, 14]);
  });
});
```

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { scoreOf, splitMonths } from '../../../src/sim/score.js';
import { createRecords } from '../../../src/save/records.js';
import { shareLink, emojiRow, parseShareLink } from '../../../src/ui/share.js';
import { openSheet } from '../../../src/ui/modes.js';
import { fire } from '../../helpers/dom.js';
import { rigUI } from '../../helpers/uiWorld.js';
import { SCORE_TEXT, SHARE_TEXT, sealQuestion, sealedText, splitCompareText, T } from '../../../src/ui/text.js';

function memory() {
  const data = {};
  return { getItem: (k) => (k in data ? data[k] : null), setItem: (k, v) => { data[k] = String(v); } };
}
const sheet = (r) => r.root.querySelector('#sheet');
const openSummary = (r) => r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'summary'));
const tick = () => new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 20));
// Waits up to 6 s for a condition: a loaded machine makes the picture slowly.
async function until(test, tries = 300) { for (let i = 0; i < tries && !test(); i++) await tick(); return test(); }

describe('s3 score seal this reign', () => {
  it('puts Seal this reign, Share score and Screenshot mode in the score section; Screenshot mode hides everything', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI();
    try {
      openSummary(r);
      const buttons = [...sheet(r).querySelectorAll('.score-actions button')].map((b) => b.textContent);
      expect(buttons).toEqual([SCORE_TEXT.sealReign, SCORE_TEXT.shareScore, T.screenshotMode]);
      fire(sheet(r).querySelector('.score-actions .screenshot-mode'), 'click');
      expect([r.store.get().screenshot, r.store.get().sheet]).toEqual([true, null]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
  it('asks first in words that say what sealing does, and Not yet leaves everything as it was', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI();
    try {
      openSummary(r);
      fire(sheet(r).querySelector('.seal-reign'), 'click');
      const s = scoreOf(r.world);
      expect([r.store.get().sheet.kind, sheet(r).querySelector('h2').textContent]).toEqual(['sealReign', T.sealReign]);
      expect(sheet(r).querySelector('.seal-question').textContent).toBe(sealQuestion(s.total, s.medal));
      expect([...sheet(r).querySelectorAll('.actions button')].map((b) => b.textContent)).toEqual([SCORE_TEXT.sealConfirm, SCORE_TEXT.notYet]);
      fire(sheet(r).querySelector('.seal-not-yet'), 'click');
      expect([r.store.get().sheet.kind, r.world.seals.length]).toEqual(['summary', 0]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
  it('words the question with the medal when there is one', () => {
    expect(sealQuestion(247, 'silver')).toBe('Seal this reign? Your chronicle gets score 247 (Silver) for this city. The city carries on.');
    expect(sealQuestion(90, null)).toBe('Seal this reign? Your chronicle gets score 90 for this city. The city carries on.');
  });
  it('seals the reign in the world, writes the chronicle entry, says so, and the city carries on', async () => {
    const records = createRecords({ storage: memory() });
    const r = await rigUI({ hooks: { records }, clock: () => 1760000000000 });
    try {
      r.world.cityId = 'abc';
      r.world.day = 400;
      const s = scoreOf(r.world);
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'sealReign'));
      fire(sheet(r).querySelector('.seal-confirm'), 'click');
      expect(r.world.seals).toEqual([{ day: 400, score: s.total, parts: s.parts, medal: s.medal, version: 1 }]);
      const [entry] = records.stamps();
      expect([entry.cityId, entry.score, entry.day, entry.date, entry.seed]).toEqual(['abc', s.total, 400, 1760000000000, r.world.seed]);
      expect(r.store.get().sheet.kind).toBe('summary');
      expect(r.root.querySelector('#toasts').textContent).toContain(sealedText(r.world.seals[0]));
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'sealReign'));
      fire(sheet(r).querySelector('.seal-confirm'), 'click');                         // again: a new entry and a new stamp
      expect([r.world.seals.length, records.stamps().length]).toEqual([2, 2]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
  it('compares each split with the best on this seed and level from the device\'s other cities', async () => {
    const records = createRecords({ storage: memory() });
    const r = await rigUI({ hooks: { records } });
    try {
      r.world.cityId = 'mine';
      const other = { cityId: 'theirs', seed: r.world.seed, difficulty: r.world.difficulty, history: [], splits: { town: 600, market_town: 600 } };
      records.noteCity(other, 1);
      records.noteCity({ ...other, cityId: 'hard-one', difficulty: 'hard', splits: { town: 30 } }, 2);   // another level: not compared
      r.world.splits = { town: 480, market_town: 600, city: 700 };
      openSummary(r);
      const rows = [...sheet(r).querySelectorAll('.split')].map((li) => li.textContent);
      expect(rows).toEqual([splitCompareText('town', 480, 600), splitCompareText('market_town', 600, 600), splitCompareText('city', 700, null)]);
      expect(rows).toEqual(['Town in year 2, month 5: 4 months faster than your best', 'Market town in year 2, month 9: level with your best', 'City in year 2, month 12']);
      expect(splitCompareText('town', 660, 600)).toBe('Town in year 2, month 11: 2 months slower than your best');
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});

describe('s3 score share score', () => {
  it('shows the link, the emoji row and friends\' honour, made from the score now', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI();
    try {
      r.world.splits = { town: 420 };
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'shareScore'));
      const s = scoreOf(r.world);
      const link = shareLink({ seed: r.world.seed, difficulty: r.world.difficulty, parts: s.parts, splits: splitMonths(r.world) });
      expect(sheet(r).querySelector('h2').textContent).toBe(T.shareScore);
      expect(sheet(r).querySelector('.share-link-text').value).toBe(link);
      expect(parseShareLink(new URL(link).hash)).toEqual({ ok: true, seed: r.world.seed, difficulty: 'normal', parts: s.parts, splits: { ...splitMonths(r.world) } });
      expect(sheet(r).querySelector('.emoji-row').textContent).toBe(emojiRow(s.parts));
      expect(sheet(r).querySelector('.honour').textContent).toBe(SHARE_TEXT.honourHelp);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
  it('makes the picture before the tap, then shares it as a file with the words, or downloads it where sharing files is not offered', async () => {
    const shared = [], downloaded = [];
    let filesOk = true;
    const hooks = { share: (d) => { shared.push(d); return Promise.resolve(); }, canShare: () => filesOk, download: (f) => downloaded.push(f) };
    const r = await rigUI({ hooks });
    try {
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'shareScore'));
      const button = () => sheet(r).querySelector('.share-picture');
      expect(await until(() => !button().disabled)).toBe(true);
      expect(button().textContent).toBe(SHARE_TEXT.sharePicture);
      fire(button(), 'click');
      await until(() => shared.length > 0);
      expect([shared.length, shared[0].files[0].name, shared[0].files[0].type, shared[0].text]).toEqual([1, SHARE_TEXT.fileName, 'image/png', SHARE_TEXT.text(scoreOf(r.world).total, emojiRow(scoreOf(r.world).parts), sheet(r).querySelector('.share-link-text').value)]);
      filesOk = false;
      fire(button(), 'click');
      await until(() => downloaded.length > 0);
      expect([shared.length, downloaded.length, downloaded[0].name]).toEqual([1, 1, SHARE_TEXT.fileName]);
      expect(r.root.querySelector('#toasts').textContent).toContain(SHARE_TEXT.pictureSaved);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
  it('shares the link and the rows as words, or copies them where there is no share sheet', async () => {
    const shared = [], copied = [];
    const r = await rigUI({ hooks: { share: (d) => { shared.push(d); return Promise.resolve(); } } });
    try {
      r.store.set(openSheet(r.store.get(), 'shareScore'));
      fire(sheet(r).querySelector('.share-link'), 'click');
      await tick();
      expect(shared[0].text).toContain(sheet(r).querySelector('.share-link-text').value);
      expect(shared[0].text).toContain("friends' honour");
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
    const c = await rigUI({ hooks: { share: null, clipboard: { writeText: (t) => { copied.push(t); return Promise.resolve(); } } } });
    try {
      c.store.set(openSheet(c.store.get(), 'shareScore'));
      fire(sheet(c).querySelector('.share-link'), 'click');
      await tick();
      expect(copied[0]).toContain(sheet(c).querySelector('.share-link-text').value);
      expect(c.root.querySelector('#toasts').textContent).toContain(SHARE_TEXT.copied);
    } finally { c.cleanup(); }
  });
});
```

```js
import { describe, it, expect } from '../../harness.js';
import { weeklySeed, isoWeek, shareLink, parseShareLink, shareCheck, sharedTotal, emojiRow, pictureCard } from '../../../src/ui/share.js';
import { makeTestWorld, setRoad, addRaw } from '../../helpers/testWorld.js';

const PARTS = { people: 72, prosperity: 65, culture: 58, safety: 40 };
const SPLITS = { town: 14, market_town: 20, city: null, great_city: null, capital: null };

describe('s3 score sharing', () => {
  it('draws This week\'s Nile from the local date: ISO week-year x 100 + ISO week', () => {
    expect(weeklySeed(new Date(2026, 9, 11))).toBe(202641);                   // the spec's example, a Sunday
    expect(weeklySeed(new Date(2026, 9, 5))).toBe(202641);                    // that week's Monday
    expect(weeklySeed(new Date(2026, 9, 12))).toBe(202642);
    expect(weeklySeed(new Date(2026, 0, 1))).toBe(202601);                    // a Thursday: week 1
    expect(weeklySeed(new Date(2027, 0, 1))).toBe(202653);                    // still 2026's last week
    expect(weeklySeed(new Date(2024, 11, 30))).toBe(202501);                  // already 2025's first week
    expect(isoWeek(new Date(2026, 2, 30))).toEqual({ year: 2026, week: 14 }); // the Monday after the clocks change
    expect([weeklySeed(new Date('nonsense')), weeklySeed(null)]).toEqual([0, 0]);
  });
  it('makes the t1 link with its check, and reads it back', () => {
    const link = shareLink({ seed: 202641, difficulty: 'normal', parts: PARTS, splits: SPLITS });
    const body = 't1.202641.n.72-65-58-40.14-20-x-x-x';
    expect(link).toBe(`https://joshuahedge.github.io/thebes/#${body}.${shareCheck(body)}`);
    expect(/^[0-9a-z]{4}$/.test(shareCheck(body))).toBe(true);
    expect(parseShareLink(new URL(link).hash)).toEqual({ ok: true, seed: 202641, difficulty: 'normal', parts: PARTS, splits: SPLITS });
    expect(sharedTotal(parseShareLink(new URL(link).hash))).toBe(235);
    const hard = parseShareLink(new URL(shareLink({ seed: 7, difficulty: 'hard', parts: PARTS, splits: {} })).hash);
    expect([hard.difficulty, hard.splits.town, sharedTotal(hard)]).toEqual(['hard', null, Math.round(235 * 1.25)]);
    expect([shareLink({}), shareLink({ seed: 1, difficulty: 'easy', parts: PARTS }), shareLink({ seed: 1, difficulty: 'normal', parts: { ...PARTS, safety: 101 } })]).toEqual(['', '', '']);
  });
  it('says a typo, a newer link and a broken one apart, and ignores a hash that is no share link', () => {
    const link = shareLink({ seed: 202641, difficulty: 'normal', parts: PARTS, splits: SPLITS });
    const hash = new URL(link).hash;
    expect([parseShareLink(''), parseShareLink('#x'), parseShareLink('#welcome'), parseShareLink(null)]).toEqual([null, null, null, null]);
    expect(parseShareLink(hash.replace('72-65', '73-65'))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'bad_check' });
    expect(parseShareLink(hash.replace('#t1', '#t2'))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'newer_format' });
    expect(parseShareLink('#t1.202641.n.72-65-58.14-20-x-x-x.abcd')).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'malformed' });
    expect(parseShareLink('#t1.202641.e.72-65-58-40.14-20-x-x-x.abcd')).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'malformed' });
    expect(parseShareLink('#t1.202641.n.72-65-58-400.14-20-x-x-x.abcd')).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'malformed' });
    expect(parseShareLink('#t1.202641.n.72-65-58-40.14-20-x-x-x')).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'malformed' });
  });
  it('writes the emoji row: one line per part, a square per 20 points', () => {
    expect(emojiRow(PARTS)).toBe('People 🟩🟩🟩⬜⬜\nProsperity 🟩🟩🟩⬜⬜\nCulture 🟩🟩⬜⬜⬜\nSafety 🟩🟩⬜⬜⬜');
    expect(emojiRow({ people: 100, prosperity: 0, culture: 19, safety: 20 })).toBe('People 🟩🟩🟩🟩🟩\nProsperity ⬜⬜⬜⬜⬜\nCulture ⬜⬜⬜⬜⬜\nSafety 🟩⬜⬜⬜⬜');
    expect([emojiRow({}), emojiRow(null)]).toEqual(['', '']);
  });
  it('paints the 1200x630 picture card: the city on the left, the four bars to scale on the right', () => {
    const w = makeTestWorld();
    setRoad(w, 0, 10, 31, 10);
    addRaw(w, 'temple', 4, 11);
    const c = pictureCard(w, { total: 235, raw: 235, factor: 1, parts: PARTS, medal: 'bronze' });
    expect([c.width, c.height]).toEqual([1200, 630]);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    const px = (x, y) => [...g.getImageData(x, y, 1, 1).data].slice(0, 3);
    expect(JSON.stringify(px(40, 40)) === JSON.stringify([0xF3, 0xE7, 0xCB])).toBe(false);   // the map, not the card's paper
    const teal = [0x1F, 0x6F, 0x66], paper2 = [0xEA, 0xDB, 0xB9];
    // People 72: its bar (x 650-1150, y 300-314) is teal to 72% of the way and paper beyond.
    expect([px(655, 307), px(650 + 355, 307), px(650 + 365, 307), px(1140, 307)]).toEqual([teal, teal, paper2, paper2]);
    // Safety 40 (the fourth bar, y 480-494).
    expect([px(650 + 195, 487), px(650 + 205, 487)]).toEqual([teal, paper2]);
    expect(pictureCard(null, null)).toBe(null);
  });
});
```

`src/save/records.js` (replace the whole file):

```js
// Records on the device (spec 4.19): localStorage RECORDS_KEY ('thebes.records'), separate from the save and read and
// written inside try/catch, so private browsing never breaks the game. Stage 3 contract: Track 0 fixed the API and the
// top-level shape; Track E implements it.
//   { version: 1, cities: [ { id, seed, difficulty, scoreVersion, best, bestDay, medal, splits, updated } ],
//     chronicle: [ { id, cityId, seed, difficulty, day, score, parts, splits, medal, feats, version, date } ] }
// A city row: the city's id, seed and level, its best month-end city score (null until its first month end) with the
// game day and medal of that month and the score version it was made under, the game day it first became each milestone
// (world.splits), and when the device last noted it (ms). A chronicle entry: one per Seal this reign, with the seal's day,
// score, parts and medal, the city's splits and feats earned then, the score version and the device's date (ms).
// Each list keeps at most RECORDS_MAX: the oldest go first (cities by updated, the chronicle by date), never a best (the
// row with the highest score per seed and level, and each milestone's earliest row; the chronicle's highest entry per
// seed and level). boot.js writes a city row on every save, export carries the records beside the world (packSave's
// records) and import merges them by id.
import { RECORDS_KEY, RECORDS_MAX, SCORE_VERSION, SCORE_PARTS, SPLIT_MILESTONES, MEDALS, SCORE_FACTOR } from '../data/scoring.js';
import { medalFor } from '../sim/score.js';

export const RECORDS_VERSION = 1;
export const emptyRecords = () => ({ version: RECORDS_VERSION, cities: [], chronicle: [] });

function defaultStorage() {
  try { return typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? localStorage : null; } catch (e) { return null; }
}

// A new city's id (spec 4.19: given by the interface, never by the sim): the time in base 36 and a random tail.
export function newCityId(now = Date.now(), rand = Math.random) {
  return `${Math.floor(now).toString(36)}-${Math.floor(rand() * 36 ** 4).toString(36).padStart(4, '0')}`;
}

const isObj = (v) => v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
const isInt = (v) => Number.isInteger(v);
const isNum = (v) => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);
const isLevel = (d) => typeof d === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(SCORE_FACTOR, d);
const isMedal = (m) => m === null || MEDALS.some((x) => x.id === m);
const keyOf = (r) => `${r.seed}|${r.difficulty}`;

// The milestone days of a splits object, whole days only, in SPLIT_MILESTONES order.
function cleanSplits(s) {
  const out = {};
  if (isObj(s)) for (const id of SPLIT_MILESTONES) if (isInt(s[id]) && s[id] >= 0) out[id] = s[id];
  return out;
}

// A city row as stored, or null when it is not one (an imported file can hold anything).
function cleanCity(c) {
  if (!isObj(c) || typeof c.id !== 'string' || !c.id || !isInt(c.seed) || !isLevel(c.difficulty)) return null;
  const best = isNum(c.best) ? c.best : null;
  return {
    id: c.id, seed: c.seed, difficulty: c.difficulty, scoreVersion: isInt(c.scoreVersion) ? c.scoreVersion : SCORE_VERSION,
    best, bestDay: best !== null && isInt(c.bestDay) ? c.bestDay : null, medal: best !== null && isMedal(c.medal) ? c.medal : null,
    splits: cleanSplits(c.splits), updated: isNum(c.updated) ? c.updated : 0,
  };
}

// A chronicle entry as stored, or null.
function cleanEntry(e) {
  if (!isObj(e) || typeof e.id !== 'string' || !e.id || typeof e.cityId !== 'string' || !isInt(e.seed) || !isLevel(e.difficulty) || !isNum(e.score)) return null;
  const parts = {};
  for (const p of SCORE_PARTS) parts[p] = isObj(e.parts) && isNum(e.parts[p]) ? e.parts[p] : 0;
  return {
    id: e.id, cityId: e.cityId, seed: e.seed, difficulty: e.difficulty, day: isInt(e.day) ? e.day : 0, score: e.score, parts,
    splits: cleanSplits(e.splits), medal: isMedal(e.medal) ? e.medal : null,
    feats: Array.isArray(e.feats) ? e.feats.filter((f) => typeof f === 'string') : [], version: isInt(e.version) ? e.version : SCORE_VERSION,
    date: isNum(e.date) ? e.date : 0,
  };
}

// Any value read back as records: the well-formed rows and entries, the rest dropped.
export function normalizeRecords(raw) {
  const out = emptyRecords();
  if (!isObj(raw)) return out;
  const ids = new Set();
  for (const c of Array.isArray(raw.cities) ? raw.cities : []) { const r = cleanCity(c); if (r && !ids.has(r.id)) { ids.add(r.id); out.cities.push(r); } }
  const entries = new Set();
  for (const e of Array.isArray(raw.chronicle) ? raw.chronicle : []) { const r = cleanEntry(e); if (r && !entries.has(r.id)) { entries.add(r.id); out.chronicle.push(r); } }
  return out;
}

// The rows no cap may drop: per seed and level the row with the highest best and, per milestone, the row with the
// earliest day; and the chronicle's highest entry per seed and level.
function keptCities(cities) {
  const keep = new Set(), top = new Map(), first = new Map();
  for (const c of cities) {
    const k = keyOf(c);
    if (c.best !== null && (!top.has(k) || c.best > top.get(k).best)) top.set(k, c);
    for (const id of Object.keys(c.splits)) {
      const fk = `${k}|${id}`;
      if (!first.has(fk) || c.splits[id] < first.get(fk).splits[id]) first.set(fk, c);
    }
  }
  for (const c of [...top.values(), ...first.values()]) keep.add(c.id);
  return keep;
}
function keptEntries(chronicle) {
  const top = new Map();
  for (const e of chronicle) { const k = keyOf(e); if (!top.has(k) || e.score > top.get(k).score) top.set(k, e); }
  return new Set([...top.values()].map((e) => e.id));
}
// At most `max` items: the oldest by `age` go first, never a kept one.
function cap(list, max, kept, age) {
  if (list.length <= max) return list;
  const drop = new Set(list.filter((x) => !kept.has(x.id)).sort((a, b) => age(a) - age(b)).slice(0, list.length - max).map((x) => x.id));
  return list.filter((x) => !drop.has(x.id));
}
function capped(r, max = RECORDS_MAX) {
  return {
    version: RECORDS_VERSION,
    cities: cap(r.cities, max, keptCities(r.cities), (c) => c.updated),
    chronicle: cap(r.chronicle, max, keptEntries(r.chronicle), (e) => e.date),
  };
}

// One city's two rows made one: the better best (with its day, medal and version), each milestone's earlier day, the
// later note.
function mergeCity(a, b) {
  const better = b.best !== null && (a.best === null || b.best > a.best) ? b : a;
  const splits = { ...a.splits };
  for (const [id, day] of Object.entries(b.splits)) if (!(id in splits) || day < splits[id]) splits[id] = day;
  const newer = b.updated > a.updated ? b : a;
  return { ...newer, best: better.best, bestDay: better.bestDay, medal: better.medal, scoreVersion: better.scoreVersion, splits: cleanSplits(splits), updated: Math.max(a.updated, b.updated) };
}

// Two records merged by id (a city row keeps its better best and earlier splits; chronicle entries are unique), capped.
export function mergeRecords(a, b) {
  const x = normalizeRecords(a), y = normalizeRecords(b);
  const cities = new Map(x.cities.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
  for (const c of y.cities) cities.set(c.id, cities.has(c.id) ? mergeCity(cities.get(c.id), c) : c);
  const chronicle = [...x.chronicle];
  const seen = new Set(chronicle.map((e) => e.id));
  for (const e of y.chronicle) if (!seen.has(e.id)) { seen.add(e.id); chronicle.push(e); }
  return capped({ cities: [...cities.values()], chronicle });
}

// The parts' total of a month-end row (its raw score), for the medal.
const rawOf = (row) => SCORE_PARTS.reduce((s, p) => s + (isObj(row.parts) && isNum(row.parts[p]) ? row.parts[p] : 0), 0);

export function createRecords({ storage = defaultStorage(), key = RECORDS_KEY, max = RECORDS_MAX } = {}) {
  function read() {
    try {
      const text = storage ? storage.getItem(key) : null;
      return text ? normalizeRecords(JSON.parse(text)) : emptyRecords();
    } catch (e) { return emptyRecords(); }
  }
  function write(r) {
    try { if (storage) storage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(capped(r, max))); return true; } catch (e) { return false; }
  }
  return {
    // What the device holds, or emptyRecords() when nothing, unreadable or blocked.
    load: read,
    // After every save: this city's row (seed, level, score version, best month-end score, splits). The world keeps 12
    // month-end rows, so the best is the higher of the row's and those rows' scores.
    noteCity(world, now) {
      if (!world || !world.cityId) return;
      const r = read();
      let best = null, bestDay = null, medal = null;
      for (const row of world.history || []) {
        if (isNum(row.score) && (best === null || row.score > best)) { best = row.score; bestDay = row.day; medal = medalFor(rawOf(row)); }
      }
      const row = { id: world.cityId, seed: world.seed, difficulty: world.difficulty, scoreVersion: SCORE_VERSION, best, bestDay, medal, splits: cleanSplits(world.splits), updated: now };
      const i = r.cities.findIndex((c) => c.id === row.id);
      if (i >= 0) r.cities[i] = mergeCity(r.cities[i], row); else r.cities.push(row);
      write(r);
    },
    // After Seal this reign: a chronicle entry for the seal (sealReign's seal), with the device's date; returns it.
    addSeal(world, seal, now) {
      const r = read();
      const entry = cleanEntry({
        id: `${world.cityId || 'city'}:${world.seals.length}:${seal.day}`, cityId: world.cityId || 'city', seed: world.seed, difficulty: world.difficulty,
        day: seal.day, score: seal.score, parts: seal.parts, splits: world.splits, medal: seal.medal, feats: [...world.feats.earned], version: seal.version, date: now,
      });
      if (!entry) return null;
      r.chronicle = r.chronicle.filter((e) => e.id !== entry.id);
      r.chronicle.push(entry);
      write(r);
      return entry;
    },
    // Import: merges records from an exported file into the device's own.
    merge(other) { write(mergeRecords(read(), other)); },
    // The n highest bests, one per seed and level, highest first: { seed, difficulty, score, medal, version, older }
    // (older: made under an earlier score version, so labelled "older scoring").
    bests(n = 3) {
      const top = new Map();
      for (const c of read().cities) {
        if (c.best === null) continue;
        const k = keyOf(c);
        if (!top.has(k) || c.best > top.get(k).best) top.set(k, c);
      }
      return [...top.values()].sort((a, b) => b.best - a.best || a.seed - b.seed).slice(0, n)
        .map((c) => ({ seed: c.seed, difficulty: c.difficulty, score: c.best, medal: c.medal, version: c.scoreVersion, older: c.scoreVersion < SCORE_VERSION }));
    },
    // The personal best on one seed and level, leaving out one city (the one being played): { score, splits } with the
    // highest best (null when none) and the earliest day of each milestone; null when no other city has that seed and level.
    bestFor(seed, difficulty, { except = null } = {}) {
      const rows = read().cities.filter((c) => c.seed === seed && c.difficulty === difficulty && c.id !== except);
      if (!rows.length) return null;
      let score = null;
      const splits = {};
      for (const c of rows) {
        if (c.best !== null && (score === null || c.best > score)) score = c.best;
        for (const [id, day] of Object.entries(c.splits)) if (!(id in splits) || day < splits[id]) splits[id] = day;
      }
      return { score, splits };
    },
    // The sealed reigns, newest first, for the title card's stamps.
    stamps() { return read().chronicle.slice().sort((a, b) => b.date - a.date); },
  };
}
```

```js
// Sharing a score (spec 4.19): the weekly seed, the share link and its check, the emoji row and the picture card. Opt-in
// only, labelled "friends' honour". Stage 3 contract: Track 0 fixed the names; Track E implements them. The interface reads
// the date; the sim never does.
import { SHARE, SCORE_PARTS, SPLIT_MILESTONES, SCORE_FACTOR } from '../data/scoring.js';
import { T as TER } from '../sim/terrain.js';
import { allBuildings } from '../sim/world.js';
import { hashKey } from '../sim/daily.js';
```
