```js
import { SCORE_TEXT, SHARE_TEXT, medalText, DIFFICULTY_NAMES } from './text.js';

// The ISO week of a local date: { year, week }, the week-year being the year of that week's Thursday.
export function isoWeek(date) {
  const d = new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate());
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + 3 - ((d.getDay() + 6) % 7));                   // that week's Thursday
  const jan4 = new Date(d.getFullYear(), 0, 4);
  const thursday1 = new Date(jan4);
  thursday1.setDate(jan4.getDate() + 3 - ((jan4.getDay() + 6) % 7));      // week 1's Thursday
  return { year: d.getFullYear(), week: 1 + Math.round((d - thursday1) / (7 * 86400000)) };
}

// This week's Nile: ISO week-year x 100 + ISO week number of the local date (week 41 of 2026 is 202641).
export function weeklySeed(date) {
  if (!(date instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return 0;
  const { year, week } = isoWeek(date);
  return year * 100 + week;
}

// The link's check: 4 base-36 characters of the FNV-1a hash of everything before it. It catches typos, not cheats.
export const shareCheck = (body) => (hashKey(body) % 36 ** SHARE.checkLength).toString(36).padStart(SHARE.checkLength, '0');

const LEVEL_OF = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(SHARE.difficulty).map(([level, c]) => [c, level]));
const isPart = (n) => Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 100;

// The share link for a score: SHARE.base + '#t1.<seed>.<p|r|n|h>.<parts joined by ->.<months to each milestone
// joined by -, x where not reached>.<4 base-36 check characters>'; '' for anything that is not a score.
export function shareLink({ seed, difficulty, parts, splits } = {}) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(seed) || seed < 0 || !SHARE.difficulty[difficulty] || !parts || !SCORE_PARTS.every((p) => isPart(parts[p]))) return '';
  const months = SPLIT_MILESTONES.map((id) => (splits && Number.isInteger(splits[id]) ? splits[id] : 'x')).join('-');
  const body = `${SHARE.format}.${seed}.${SHARE.difficulty[difficulty]}.${SCORE_PARTS.map((p) => parts[p]).join('-')}.${months}`;
  return `${SHARE.base}#${body}.${shareCheck(body)}`;
}

// Reads a location hash: { ok: true, seed, difficulty, parts, splits } for a good link, { ok: false, reason }
// ('bad_check', 'newer_format', 'malformed') otherwise, and null for a hash that is not a share link at all.
export function parseShareLink(hash) {
  const text = String(hash || '').replace(/^#/, '');
  const head = /^t(\d+)\./.exec(text);
  if (!head) return null;
  if (`t${head[1]}` !== SHARE.format) return { ok: false, reason: Number(head[1]) > Number(SHARE.format.slice(1)) ? 'newer_format' : 'malformed' };
  const bits = text.split('.');
  const bad = { ok: false, reason: 'malformed' };
  if (bits.length !== 6) return bad;
  const [, seedText, level, partsText, splitsText, check] = bits;
  const parts = partsText.split('-'), months = splitsText.split('-');
  if (!/^\d{1,10}$/.test(seedText) || !LEVEL_OF[level] || parts.length !== SCORE_PARTS.length || months.length !== SPLIT_MILESTONES.length) return bad;
  if (!parts.every((p) => /^\d{1,3}$/.test(p) && isPart(Number(p))) || !months.every((m) => m === 'x' || /^\d{1,5}$/.test(m))) return bad;
  if (!new RegExp(`^[0-9a-z]{${SHARE.checkLength}}$`).test(check)) return bad;
  if (check !== shareCheck(bits.slice(0, 5).join('.'))) return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_check' };
  return {
    ok: true, seed: Number(seedText), difficulty: LEVEL_OF[level],
    parts: Object.fromEntries(SCORE_PARTS.map((p, i) => [p, Number(parts[i])])),
    splits: Object.fromEntries(SPLIT_MILESTONES.map((id, i) => [id, months[i] === 'x' ? null : Number(months[i])])),
  };
}

// A shared score's city score: the parts' total times its level's factor, rounded, as scoreOf counts it.
export const sharedTotal = (link) => Math.round(SCORE_PARTS.reduce((s, p) => s + link.parts[p], 0) * SCORE_FACTOR[link.difficulty]);

// One line per part, a square per 20 points ("People 🟩🟩🟩⬜⬜"), joined with new lines; '' for anything else.
export function emojiRow(parts) {
  if (!parts || !SCORE_PARTS.every((p) => isPart(parts[p]))) return '';
  return SCORE_PARTS.map((p) => { const k = Math.floor(parts[p] / 20); return `${SCORE_TEXT.parts[p]} ${'🟩'.repeat(k)}${'⬜'.repeat(5 - k)}`; }).join('\n');
}

const TERRAIN_COLOURS = { [TER.DESERT]: TERRAIN.sand, [TER.FERTILE]: TERRAIN.fertile, [TER.ROCKY]: TERRAIN.rocky, [TER.WATER]: TERRAIN.water, [TER.BANK]: TERRAIN.bank, [TER.MEADOW]: TERRAIN.grass };

// A top-down map of the terrain (and, when given, the roads and buildings of a world) in the square (x, y, px):
// the title card's stamps and the picture card when no view of the city is at hand.
export function drawMapSquare(g, { size, terrain, road = null, buildings = [] }, x, y, px) {
  const s = px / size;
  for (let ty = 0; ty < size; ty++) {
    for (let tx = 0; tx < size; tx++) {
      g.fillStyle = TERRAIN_COLOURS[terrain[ty * size + tx]] || TERRAIN.sand;
      g.fillRect(x + tx * s, y + ty * s, Math.ceil(s), Math.ceil(s));
    }
  }
  if (road) {
    g.fillStyle = TERRAIN.road;
    for (let i = 0; i < road.length; i++) if (road[i]) g.fillRect(x + (i % size) * s, y + Math.floor(i / size) * s, Math.ceil(s), Math.ceil(s));
  }
  for (const b of buildings) {
    g.fillStyle = b.type === 'house' ? (b.tier > 0 ? TERRAIN.roadPebble : TERRAIN.plot) : UI.housing;
    g.fillRect(x + b.x * s, y + b.y * s, Math.max(1, b.w * s), Math.max(1, b.d * s));
  }
}

const MEDAL_COLOURS = { bronze: '#B0703A', silver: '#A9A9A9', gold: '#E2B13C', none: '#DCC9A0' };
export const medalColour = (medal) => MEDAL_COLOURS[medal || 'none'];
const CARD = { w: 1200, h: 630, ink: '#2B1F0E', soft: '#5A4832', paper: '#F3E7CB', paper2: '#EADBB9', teal: '#1F6F66', font: 'system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif' };

// The 1200x630 picture card as a canvas (the city, the four bars, the medal, the seed and level, "friends' honour"), or
// null without a world and a score. view: a canvas showing the city (the game's own map, cropped to a square); without
// one the city is drawn top-down. createCanvas(w, h) makes the canvas (tests pass their own).
export function pictureCard(world, score, { createCanvas = null, view = null } = {}) {
  if (!world || !score) return null;
  const make = createCanvas || ((w, h) => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; return c; });
  const c = make(CARD.w, CARD.h);
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  g.fillStyle = CARD.paper;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, CARD.w, CARD.h);
  const side = CARD.h - 60;                                                    // the city in a square on the left
  if (view && view.width > 0 && view.height > 0) {
    const s = Math.min(view.width, view.height);
    g.drawImage(view, (view.width - s) / 2, (view.height - s) / 2, s, s, 30, 30, side, side);
  } else drawMapSquare(g, { size: world.size, terrain: world.terrain, road: world.road, buildings: allBuildings(world) }, 30, 30, side);
  g.strokeStyle = CARD.paper2; g.lineWidth = 4; g.strokeRect(30, 30, side, side);
  const x = 30 + side + 50, right = CARD.w - 50;
  g.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  g.fillStyle = CARD.ink; g.font = `bold 44px ${CARD.font}`; g.fillText('Thebes', x, 90);
  g.fillStyle = CARD.soft; g.font = `28px ${CARD.font}`; g.fillText(SCORE_TEXT.cityScore, x, 145);
  g.fillStyle = CARD.ink; g.font = `bold 96px ${CARD.font}`; g.fillText(String(score.total), x, 235);
  const numberWidth = g.measureText(String(score.total)).width;
  g.fillStyle = medalColour(score.medal);
  g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + numberWidth + 44, 205, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();
  g.fillStyle = CARD.ink; g.font = `bold 30px ${CARD.font}`; g.fillText(medalText(score.medal), x + numberWidth + 80, 216);
  SCORE_PARTS.forEach((p, i) => {
    const y = 290 + i * 60, n = score.parts[p];
    g.fillStyle = CARD.ink; g.font = `26px ${CARD.font}`; g.fillText(SCORE_TEXT.parts[p], x, y);
    g.textAlign = 'right'; g.font = `bold 26px ${CARD.font}`; g.fillText(String(n), right, y); g.textAlign = 'left';
    g.fillStyle = CARD.paper2; g.fillRect(x, y + 10, right - x, 14);
    g.fillStyle = CARD.teal; g.fillRect(x, y + 10, ((right - x) * n) / 100, 14);
  });
  g.fillStyle = CARD.soft; g.font = `24px ${CARD.font}`;
  g.fillText(SHARE_TEXT.seedLine(world.seed, DIFFICULTY_NAMES[world.difficulty] || world.difficulty), x, 560);
  g.fillStyle = CARD.ink; g.font = `italic 24px ${CARD.font}`; g.fillText(SHARE_TEXT.honour, x, 598);
  return c;
}
```

```js
// A milestone split as a game date: "Town in year 2, month 3" (day 0 is year 1, month 1).
const SCORE_YEAR_DAYS = SCORE_DAYS_PER_MONTH * SCORE_MONTHS_PER_YEAR;
export const splitDateText = (id, day) => `${milestoneName(id)} in year ${Math.floor(day / SCORE_YEAR_DAYS) + 1}, month ${Math.floor((day % SCORE_YEAR_DAYS) / SCORE_DAYS_PER_MONTH) + 1}`;
```

```js
// A milestone split as a game date: "Town in year 2, month 3" (day 0 is year 1, month 1).
const SCORE_YEAR_DAYS = SCORE_DAYS_PER_MONTH * SCORE_MONTHS_PER_YEAR;
export const splitDateText = (id, day) => `${milestoneName(id)} in year ${Math.floor(day / SCORE_YEAR_DAYS) + 1}, month ${Math.floor((day % SCORE_YEAR_DAYS) / SCORE_DAYS_PER_MONTH) + 1}`;
// A split against the personal best on this seed and level (records' bestFor: the earliest day another city reached it),
// in whole game-months; just the date when no other city got there.
export function splitCompareText(id, day, bestDay) {
  const base = splitDateText(id, day);
  if (!Number.isInteger(bestDay)) return base;
  const diff = Math.floor(bestDay / SCORE_DAYS_PER_MONTH) - Math.floor(day / SCORE_DAYS_PER_MONTH);
  if (diff === 0) return `${base}: level with your best`;
  return `${base}: ${plural(Math.abs(diff), 'month', 'months')} ${diff > 0 ? 'faster' : 'slower'} than your best`;
}
// Seal this reign (spec 4.19): the confirmation says exactly what sealReign records and what it does not change.
Object.assign(SCORE_TEXT, { sealReign: 'Seal this reign', sealConfirm: 'Seal reign', notYet: 'Not yet', shareScore: 'Share score', stampNote: 'Its stamp shows on the title card.' });
export const sealQuestion = (total, medal) => `Seal this reign? Your chronicle gets score ${total}${medal ? ` (${SCORE_TEXT.medals[medal]})` : ''} for this city. The city carries on.`;
export const sealedText = (seal) => `Reign sealed with score ${seal.score}`;
// Sharing (spec 4.19): opt-in, and every shared score says friends' honour.
export const SHARE_TEXT = {
  honour: "Friends' honour", honourHelp: "Friends' honour: a link can't be checked without a server.",
  sharePicture: 'Share picture', shareLink: 'Share link', linkLabel: 'Link to this score', making: 'Making the picture…',
  pictureSaved: 'Picture downloaded', copied: 'Copied', fileName: 'thebes-score.png',
  seedLine: (seed, level) => `Seed ${seed} · ${level}`,
  text: (total, rows, link) => `Thebes: score ${total}, friends' honour\n${rows}\n${link}`,
};
Object.assign(T, { sealReign: SCORE_TEXT.sealReign, shareScore: SCORE_TEXT.shareScore });   // the two sheets' headings
// ── end s3 score ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

//
```

```powershell
Keep records on the device, seal reigns and share a score

records.js keeps a row per city and an entry per seal in thebes.records. Each list is capped at 200 without dropping a
best, imports merge by id, and blocked storage never breaks the game. Seal this reign asks first, in words that say
what it records, then writes the chronicle entry. Share score makes the t1 link with its check, the emoji row and a
1200x630 picture made before the tap, all labelled friends' honour, with screenshot mode beside them. The summary's
```

```js
// A stamp (spec 4.19): the sealed seed's map, top-down, in a disc ringed in the medal's colour. Cosmetic; the label says it.
const STAMP_PX = 40, STAMP_MAX = 8;
const mapCache = new Map();   // seed -> its generated map: a stamp row often repeats one seed
function stampFor(entry, dpr) {
  if (!mapCache.has(entry.seed)) mapCache.set(entry.seed, generateMap(entry.seed));
  const map = mapCache.get(entry.seed);
  const c = el('canvas', { class: 'stamp', role: 'img', 'aria-label': TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.stampLabel(entry), width: STAMP_PX * dpr, height: STAMP_PX * dpr });
  c.style.width = `${STAMP_PX}px`; c.style.height = `${STAMP_PX}px`;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  const r = (STAMP_PX * dpr) / 2, ring = 3 * dpr;
  g.save();
  g.beginPath(); g.arc(r, r, r - ring, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.clip();
  drawMapSquare(g, { size: map.size, terrain: map.terrain }, 0, 0, STAMP_PX * dpr);
  g.restore();
  g.strokeStyle = medalColour(entry.medal); g.lineWidth = ring;
  g.beginPath(); g.arc(r, r, r - ring / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.stroke();
  return c;
}

// The title card's decoration (spec 4.1, 4.19): the three highest bests and a stamp per sealed reign under Continue (the
// newest STAMP_MAX, then "+N more"), This week's Nile under the difficulty choice, and a shared score link's friend score
// with "Beat N?" and Start this seed above the buttons. boot.js calls titleDecor once per title card and passes the result
// to createTitleCard as decorate, which calls it with (element, { buttonBox, newCity }).
// opts: { records (src/save/records.js), shared (the page's location hash, '' for none), startSeed(seed) (starts a city on
// that seed, asking first when a city is saved, as New city does), clock, dpr }.
export function titleDecor({ records = null, shared = '', startSeed = () => {}, clock = () => Date.now(), dpr = (typeof devicePixelRatio === 'number' && devicePixelRatio) || 1 } = {}) {
  return (element, { buttonBox, newCity } = {}) => {
    if (!element || !buttonBox) return;
    const safe = (fn, fallback) => { try { return fn(); } catch (e) { return fallback; } };

    // The device's records: up to three bests, then the stamps.
    const bests = records ? safe(() => records.bests(3), []) : [];
    const stamps = records ? safe(() => records.stamps(), []) : [];
    if (bests.length || stamps.length) {
      const box = el('div', { class: 'title-records', role: 'group', 'aria-label': TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.records }, [
        ...bests.map((b) => el('p', { class: 'best-line small', text: TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.bestLine(b) })),
        stamps.length ? el('div', { class: 'stamps' }, [
          ...stamps.slice(0, STAMP_MAX).map((e) => stampFor(e, dpr)),
          stamps.length > STAMP_MAX ? el('span', { class: 'more-stamps small muted', text: TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.moreStamps(stamps.length - STAMP_MAX) }) : null,
        ]) : null,
      ]);
      const cont = buttonBox.querySelector('.continue');
      if (cont) cont.after(box); else buttonBox.prepend(box);
    }

    // This week's Nile: the weekly seed from the device's date, at the level chosen above it.
    const seed = weeklySeed(new Date(clock()));
    const levels = buttonBox.querySelector('.title-difficulty');
    const weekly = el('div', { class: 'title-weekly' }, [
      button(TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.weekly, { class: 'weekly', 'aria-describedby': 'title-weekly-hint', onClick: () => startSeed(seed) }),
      el('p', { class: 'weekly-hint small muted', id: 'title-weekly-hint', text: TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.weeklyHint(seed) }),
    ]);
    if (levels) levels.after(weekly); else if (newCity) newCity.after(weekly); else buttonBox.append(weekly);

    // A shared score link: the friend's score and parts beside the best on that seed and level, "Beat N?" and Start this
    // seed, which picks the link's level in the difficulty choice first. A bad or newer link says so; the card works as usual.
    const link = parseShareLink(shared);
    if (!link) return;
    if (!link.ok) {
      element.insertBefore(el('p', { class: 'shared-bad small coral', text: link.reason === 'newer_format' ? TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.newerLink : TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.badLink }), buttonBox);
      return;
    }
    const total = sharedTotal(link);
    const best = records ? safe(() => records.bestFor(link.seed, link.difficulty), null) : null;
    const start = button(TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.startSeed, { class: 'start-seed primary', onClick: () => {
      const choice = buttonBox.querySelector(`.choice.difficulty[data-value="${link.difficulty}"]`);
      if (choice && choice.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true') choice.click();
      startSeed(link.seed);
    } });
    element.insertBefore(el('section', { class: 'shared-score', 'aria-labelledby': 'shared-score-heading' }, [
      el('h2', { id: 'shared-score-heading', class: 'small', text: TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.friend }),
      el('p', { class: 'friend-line', text: TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.friendLine(total, link.seed, link.difficulty) }),
      el('p', { class: 'friend-parts small muted', text: TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.partsLine(link.parts) }),
      el('p', { class: 'your-best small', text: TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.yourBest(best ? best.score : null) }),
      el('p', { class: 'beat', text: TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.beat(total) }),
      el('p', { class: 'start-on small muted', text: TITLE_SCORE_TEXT.startOn(link.difficulty) }),
      start,
    ]), buttonBox);
  };
}
```

```js
  weekly: "This week's Nile", records: 'Your records', friend: "A friend's score", startSeed: 'Start this seed',
  badLink: "This score link can't be read", newerLink: 'This score link is from a newer version of Thebes',

  stampLabel: (e) => `Sealed reign: score ${e.score}${e.medal ? `, ${SCORE_TEXT.medals[e.medal].toLowerCase()}` : ''}, seed ${e.seed}`,

  friendLine: (total, seed, level) => `${total} on seed ${seed}, ${DIFFICULTY_NAMES[level] || level}. ${SHARE_TEXT.honour}`,
  partsLine: (parts) => Object.keys(SCORE_TEXT.parts).map((p) => `${SCORE_TEXT.parts[p]} ${parts[p]}`).join(' · '),

  startOn: (level) => `It starts on ${DIFFICULTY_NAMES[level] || level}, the level of the shared score.`,
};
// ── end s3 score ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

```js
import { achievementProgress, checkAchievements, achievementsFor } from '../../../src/sim/achievements.js';

const ach = (id) => ACHIEVEMENTS.find((a) => a.id === id);
// A city past its opening chain, guide done.
function city(milestone = 'town', difficulty = 'normal') {
  const w = makeTestWorld();
  w.difficulty = difficulty;
  w.goals.completed.push(...STAGE1);
  w.guide = { on: false, done: true };
  w.milestone = milestone;
  setRoad(w, 0, 10, 31, 10);
  return w;
}

describe('s3 score danger goals', () => {
  it('puts "Build a firehouse" right after Town and "Build a tower and a barracks" right after the trade route, in a Danger chapter', () => {
    const at = (id) => ids(GOALS).indexOf(id);

    expect([goalById('firehouse').text, goalById('defences').text, CHAPTER_NAMES.danger]).toEqual(['Build a firehouse', 'Build a tower and a barracks', 'Danger']);
    expect([goalById('firehouse').chapter, goalById('defences').chapter, goalById('defences').from, goalById('defences').raids]).toEqual(['danger', 'danger', 'market_town', true]);
    expect(goalById('defences').need).toEqual({ kind: 'all', of: [{ kind: 'building', type: 'tower', n: 1 }, { kind: 'building', type: 'barracks', n: 1 }] });
    const words = [...['firehouse', 'defences', 'fire_firehouse', 'raid_tower'].map((id) => goalById(id).text), ...Object.values(goalById('raid_tower').dirText)];
    for (const text of words) expect([text, text.length <= 36]).toEqual([text, true]);   // two lines of caption on a small phone (ruling 52)
  });

    expect(ids(settleGoals(w))).toEqual(['firehouse']);
    w.milestone = 'market_town';
    w.goals.completed.push('pottery', 'homes_townhouse', 'booth_gardens', 'manor', 'market_town', 'trade_route');
    addRaw(w, 'house', 0, 0, { tier: 1, residents: 250 });

  });

    w.raid.warning = { index: 0, entry: { x: 31, y: 16 }, dir: 'east', size: 3, tribute: null, target: 'building', day: 0, arrives: 90, first: true };
    expect(openGoals(w)[0].text).toBe('Build a tower facing the east');
    expect(goalById('raid_tower').text).toBe('Build a tower facing the raiders');   // a caption reads the data's words
    w.raid.warning = null;
    w.raid.last = { index: 0, dir: 'north', size: 3, won: true, byTowers: 3, bySoldiers: 0, towers: 1, burned: 0, stolen: 0, day: 100 };
    expect(openGoals(w)[0].text).toBe('Build a tower facing the north');
    const peaceful = city('market_town', 'peaceful');
    expect(triggerEventGoals(peaceful, [alert])).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('aims Show me for a tower at the homes\' side that faces the raid', () => {
    const w = city('market_town');
    for (let x = 10; x < 14; x++) addRaw(w, 'house', x, 9, { tier: 1, residents: 5 });   // centre (12, 9.5)
    expect(showMeTarget(w, goalById('defences'))).toEqual({ x: 12, y: 9.5 });           // no raid: the homes
    w.raid.warning = { index: 0, entry: { x: 31, y: 9 }, dir: 'east', size: 3, tribute: null, target: 'building', day: 0, arrives: 90, first: true };
    expect(showMeTarget(w, goalById('raid_tower'))).toEqual({ x: 18, y: 9.5 });         // 6 tiles towards the entry
  });
});

describe('s3 score danger rewards', () => {
  it('adds five firsts at 10 gold, each with words that follow the data', () => {
    expect(FIRSTS.slice(15).map((f) => [f.id, f.check])).toEqual([
      ['first_firehouse', { kind: 'building', type: 'firehouse' }],
      ['first_fire_out', { kind: 'tallies', keys: ['blazesOut', 'firesOut'], n: 1 }],
      ['first_wall', { kind: 'tally', key: 'wallTiles', n: 1 }],
      ['first_tower', { kind: 'building', type: 'tower' }],
      ['first_raid_beaten', { kind: 'tally', key: 'raidsBeaten', n: 1 }],
    ]);
    expect(FIRST_TEXT.first_firehouse.why).toBe(`Staffed, it puts out blazes and slows fire risk up to ${FIRE.reach} road tiles away.`);
    expect(FIRST_TEXT.first_tower.why).toBe(`Staffed, it shoots raiders up to ${DEFENCE.towerRange} tiles away.`);
    const w = city();
    expect(FIRSTS.slice(15).map((f) => firstMet(w, f))).toEqual([null, null, null, null, null]);
    addRaw(w, 'firehouse', 3, 11);
    w.tally.firesOut = 1; w.tally.wallTiles = 4; w.tally.raidsBeaten = 1;
    addRaw(w, 'tower', 6, 11);
    expect(FIRSTS.slice(15).map((f) => firstMet(w, f))).toEqual([{ x: 3.5, y: 11.5 }, { x: null, y: null }, { x: null, y: null }, { x: 6.5, y: 11.5 }, { x: null, y: null }]);
    w.firsts = FIRSTS.slice(0, 15).map((f) => f.id);
    const gold = w.gold, events = [];
    expect(checkFirsts(w, events)).toEqual(['first_firehouse', 'first_fire_out', 'first_wall', 'first_tower', 'first_raid_beaten']);
    expect([w.gold - gold, events[0]]).toEqual([5 * FIRST_REWARD, { type: 'first', id: 'first_firehouse', reward: FIRST_REWARD, x: 3.5, y: 11.5 }]);
    const out = city();
    out.tally.blazesOut = 1;
    expect(firstMet(out, FIRSTS.find((f) => f.id === 'first_fire_out'))).toEqual({ x: null, y: null });   // a blaze counts as much as a fire
  });
  it('adds four achievements with exact words; the raid one is never earned or listed on Peaceful', () => {
    expect(ACHIEVEMENTS.slice(32).map((a) => [a.id, a.measure])).toEqual([
      ['fire_brigade', { kind: 'buildings', type: 'firehouse', n: 3 }],
      ['safe_streets', { kind: 'safeYear', people: 500, days: 360 }],
      ['wall_builder', { kind: 'tally', key: 'wallTiles', n: 50 }],
      ['raid_breaker', { kind: 'tally', key: 'raidsBeaten', n: 3 }],
    ]);
    expect(ACHIEVEMENTS.slice(32).map((a) => [ACHIEVEMENT_NAMES[a.id], ACHIEVEMENT_TEXT[a.id]])).toEqual([
      ['Fire brigade', 'Have 3 firehouses'], ['Safe streets', 'Reach 500 people with no building burned for a year'],
      ['Wall builder', 'Draw 50 wall tiles'], ['Raid breaker', 'Beat 3 raids'],
    ]);
    const w = city('market_town');
    w.tally.raidsBeaten = 3;
    w.difficulty = 'peaceful';
    expect(checkAchievements(w, []).includes('raid_breaker')).toBe(false);
    expect(ids(achievementsFor(w)).includes('raid_breaker')).toBe(false);
    w.tally.raidsBeaten = 2;
    expect(closestAchievement(w) && closestAchievement(w).def.id === 'raid_breaker').toBeFalsy();
    w.difficulty = 'normal';
    expect(checkAchievements(w, []).includes('raid_breaker')).toBe(false);
    w.tally.raidsBeaten = 3;
    expect(checkAchievements(w, []).includes('raid_breaker')).toBe(true);
  });
  it('earns Safe streets at 500 people with no building burned for a year, counted from Town where its day is known', () => {
    const w = city('city');
    const s = (world) => achievementProgress(world, ach('safe_streets'));
    addRaw(w, 'house', 0, 0, { tier: 1, residents: 499 });
    w.day = 1000;
    w.splits.town = 500;
    expect(s(w)).toEqual({ n: 0, of: 1 });                                    // 499 people
    w.buildings[1].residents = 500;
    expect(s(w)).toEqual({ n: 1, of: 1 });
    w.danger.burnDays = [700];                                               // 300 days ago
    expect(s(w)).toEqual({ n: 0, of: 1 });
    w.danger.burnDays = [600];                                               // 400 days ago
    expect(s(w)).toEqual({ n: 1, of: 1 });
    w.splits.town = 800;                                                     // a Town for only 200 days
    expect(s(w)).toEqual({ n: 0, of: 1 });
  });
  it('adds three daily goals: a firehouse from Town, ten wall tiles and a tower from Market town, none of the defence ones on Peaceful', () => {
    expect(DAILY_POOL.slice(15).map((d) => [d.id, d.measure, d.n, d.from, Boolean(d.raids)])).toEqual([
      ['firehouse1', { kind: 'buildings', type: 'firehouse' }, 1, 'town', false],
      ['wall10', { kind: 'tally', key: 'wallTiles' }, 10, 'market_town', true],
      ['tower1', { kind: 'buildings', type: 'tower' }, 1, 'market_town', true],
    ]);
    expect([DAILY_TEXT.firehouse1, DAILY_TEXT.wall10, DAILY_TEXT.tower1]).toEqual(['Build a firehouse', 'Draw 10 wall tiles', 'Build a tower']);
    const w = city('village');
    expect(dailyOrder(w, '2026-10-11').includes('firehouse1')).toBe(false);
    w.milestone = 'town';
    expect(dailyOrder(w, '2026-10-11').includes('firehouse1')).toBe(true);
    w.milestone = 'market_town';
    expect(['wall10', 'tower1'].map((id) => dailyOrder(w, '2026-10-11').includes(id))).toEqual([true, true]);
    w.difficulty = 'peaceful';
    expect(['firehouse1', 'wall10', 'tower1'].map((id) => dailyOrder(w, '2026-10-11').includes(id))).toEqual([true, false, false]);
    w.tally.wallTiles = 7;
    expect(dailyMeasure(w, pool('wall10'))).toBe(7);
  });
  it('adds six tips, each with its own trigger and words true to the rules', () => {
    expect(TIPS.slice(14).map((t) => [t.id, t.trigger, t.priority])).toEqual([
      ['fire_risk', 'fireRisk', false], ['firebreaks', 'fireGrew', false], ['clearing_rubble', 'rubbleLeft', false],
      ['raider_targets', 'raidWarned', false], ['tribute_once', 'tributeOffered', false], ['wall_ring', 'wallDrawn', false],
    ]);
    expect(TIP_TEXT.fire_risk).toBe(`Watch fire risk from Town: a staffed firehouse within ${BUILDINGS.firehouse.reach} road tiles slows it.`);
    for (const t of TIPS.slice(14)) expect([t.id, TIP_TEXT[t.id].length > 20]).toEqual([t.id, true]);
  });
  it('asks for each danger tip when its lesson is news', async () => {
    const r = await rigUI();
    try {
      const asked = [];
      r.ui.tips.trigger = (key) => { asked.push(key); return false; };
      const s = r.ui.scoreUi;
      s.onEvents([{ type: 'milestone', id: 'town' }]);
      s.onEvents([{ type: 'fire_grow', id: 4, covered: false }]);
      s.onEvents([{ type: 'burned', id: 4, kind: 'house', to: [9] }]);       // a home leaves empty plots, no rubble
      s.onEvents([{ type: 'burned', id: 5, kind: 'potter', to: [10, 11, 12, 13] }]);
      s.onEvents([{ type: 'raid_warning', index: 0, first: true }]);         // the first raid cannot be paid off
      s.onEvents([{ type: 'raid_warning', index: 1, first: false }]);
      const fh = addRaw(r.world, 'firehouse', 3, 11);
      s.onCommand({ kind: 'building', result: { ok: true, id: fh.id }, undoable: true });
      s.onCommand({ kind: 'building', result: { ok: true, id: 1 }, undoable: true });   // not a firehouse
      s.onCommand({ kind: 'wall', result: { ok: true }, undoable: true });
      expect(asked).toEqual(['fireRisk', 'fireGrew', 'rubbleLeft', 'raidWarned', 'raidWarned', 'tributeOffered', 'fireRisk', 'wallDrawn']);
      for (const key of new Set(asked)) expect([key, TIPS.some((t) => t.trigger === key)]).toEqual([key, true]);
    } finally { r.cleanup(); }
  });
});
```

```js
// Stage 3: `people` or more and no building burned for `days`, counted from the day the city became a Town where the
// world knows it (a city from before Stage 3 had no fires, so its days run from when it was saved).
function safeYear(world, people, days) {
  if (population(world) < people) return false;
  const town = world.splits.town;
  if (Number.isInteger(town) && world.day - town < days) return false;
  return !world.danger.burnDays.some((d) => world.day - d < days);
}

    case 'waterAll': return waterAll(world, m.homes);
    case 'jobs': return jobsFor(world, m.people, m.rate);
    case 'safeYear': return safeYear(world, m.people, m.days);
    default: return false;
  }
}
```

```js
// The first time an alert with one of an event goal's trigger codes appears, that goal joins the list (once per city).
// A goal whose building already stands is not news (a covered first fire means a firehouse is there): it waits for a
// later trouble, if the building has gone by then. alerts: the city's alerts when the caller has them (alertsFor's).
export function triggerEventGoals(world, alerts = null) {
  const { completed, triggered } = world.goals;
  const waiting = EVENT_GOALS.filter((g) => !triggered.includes(g.id) && !completed.includes(g.id) && forCity(world, g));

  triggered.push(...fired);
  return fired;
}
```

```js
  return [...events, ...(stop < 0 ? chain : chain.slice(0, stop))].slice(0, limit);
```

```js
// Where a goal's Show me points. 'alert' aims at the first building with that alert (an event goal's trouble; code can
// be a list); 'rocky' at the free rocky tile nearest the city's focus (a gem mine needs rocky ground, as canPlace checks);
// 'raid' (Stage 3) at the homes' side facing a warned or arriving raid, RAID_SHOW_ME_TILES from their centre towards
// its entry, else at the homes; a goal with no showMe (out of debt) and any target that finds nothing fall back to the
// city's focus.
// alerts: the city's alerts when the caller has them (alertsFor's).
const RAID_SHOW_ME_TILES = 6;
export function showMeTarget(world, goal, alerts = null) {
  const show = goal.showMe;
  const kind = show ? show.target : null;
  if (kind === 'alert') {
    const codes = [].concat(show.code);
    const a = (alerts || alertsFor(world)).find((x) => codes.includes(x.code) && x.id && world.buildings[x.id]);
    if (a) { const b = world.buildings[a.id]; return { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.d / 2 }; }
  }
  if (kind === 'raid') {
    const r = world.raid.warning || world.raid.active;
    const homes = housesOf(world);
    if (r && r.entry && homes.length) {
      const cx = homes.reduce((n, h) => n + h.x + h.w / 2, 0) / homes.length, cy = homes.reduce((n, h) => n + h.y + h.d / 2, 0) / homes.length;
      const dx = r.entry.x + 0.5 - cx, dy = r.entry.y + 0.5 - cy, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      const step = len > 0 ? Math.min(RAID_SHOW_ME_TILES, len) / len : 0;
      return { x: cx + dx * step, y: cy + dy * step };
    }
  }
  if (kind === 'startRoad' && world.startRoad.length) {
    const [x, y] = world.startRoad[world.startRoad.length - 1];
    return { x: x + 0.5, y: y + 0.5 };
  }
  if (kind === 'houses' || kind === 'raid') {
    const homes = housesOf(world);
    if (homes.length) {
      const sx = homes.reduce((n, h) => n + h.x + h.w / 2, 0), sy = homes.reduce((n, h) => n + h.y + h.d / 2, 0);
```

```js
    destroy() {},
```

```js
// Feats (spec 4.19): named, optional style bonuses, per city. They pay nothing, gate nothing and can be missed; they
// list under achievements in their own group and show when a reign is sealed. Their words are FEAT_TEXT in
// src/ui/text.js; src/sim/feats.js judges them and keeps its running state in world.feats ({ earned, lost, counters }).
// Check kinds (src/sim/feats.js):
//   neverInDebt { milestone }      become the milestone without the treasury ever going below 0
//   fedRun { months, people }      every home at Cottage or above fed for `months` month ends in a row, with `people` or more
//   without { type, milestone }    become the milestone without ever having a building of that type
//   noneBurned { milestone, days } no building burned for `days` after becoming the milestone
//   cleanRaid                      beat a raid with no building burned and no gold stolen
//   noTribute { milestone }        become the milestone without paying tribute
//   buildings { types, n }         n buildings of these types at once
//   jobs { people, rate }          `people` or more with unemployment at `rate` or less
//   tally { key, n }               a running tally in world.tally
//   before { milestone, day }      become the milestone before this game day (day 720 starts game-year 3)
// raids: true marks a raid feat, which a Peaceful city (no raids, spec 4.18) neither earns nor lists.
export const FEATS = [
  { id: 'debt_free', check: { kind: 'neverInDebt', milestone: 'town' } },
  { id: 'well_fed', check: { kind: 'fedRun', months: 12, people: 100 } },
  { id: 'grain_alone', check: { kind: 'without', type: 'farm_fig', milestone: 'market_town' } },
  { id: 'firewise', check: { kind: 'noneBurned', milestone: 'town', days: 1800 } },
  { id: 'untouched', raids: true, check: { kind: 'cleanRaid' } },
  { id: 'never_bowed', raids: true, check: { kind: 'noTribute', milestone: 'capital' } },
  { id: 'garden_city', check: { kind: 'buildings', types: ['garden', 'statue'], n: 20 } },
  { id: 'full_hands', check: { kind: 'jobs', people: 400, rate: 0.05 } },
  { id: 'merchant_prince', check: { kind: 'tally', key: 'sold', n: 1000 } },
  { id: 'swift_town', check: { kind: 'before', milestone: 'town', day: 720 } },
];
```

`src/sim/feats.js` (replace the whole file):

```js
// Feats (spec 4.19): named, optional style bonuses, per city; no gold, never gating. Stage 3 contract: Track E implements
// checkFeats and fills FEATS (src/data/feats.js) with their words (FEAT_TEXT in src/ui/text.js). State: world.feats =
// { earned, lost, counters }: earned and lost are feat ids (lost: can no longer be earned, e.g. Grain alone once a fig
// orchard stands before Market town), counters a record of whole numbers the checks keep:
//   fedMonth  the month index (world.day / 30) of the last month end counted for Well fed
//   fedRun    month ends in a row, up to that one, with every home at Cottage or above fed and enough people
// runMonth and settle call checkFeats. Feats that ask how a milestone was reached are judged only where the world knows the
// day it was (world.splits): a city from before Stage 3 that passed it earlier can no longer earn them (featStatus says
// so) and nothing is written for it, so a plain city's state never changes until something happens.
import { FEATS } from '../data/feats.js';
import { allBuildings, housesOf, population } from './world.js';
import { atLeast } from './progression.js';
import { raidsOn } from './costs.js';
import { DAYS_PER_MONTH } from './time.js';

const known = (world, id) => Number.isInteger(world.splits[id]);
const reachedKnown = (world, id) => atLeast(world, id) && known(world, id);

// The feats this city can earn: all but the raid feats on Peaceful (spec 4.18).
export const featsFor = (world) => FEATS.filter((f) => !f.raids || raidsOn(world));

// Every home at Cottage or above fed at the last month end (house.met, as the No one hungry achievement reads it), with
// at least `people` people.
function fedNow(world, people) {
  if (population(world) < people) return false;
  const homes = housesOf(world).filter((h) => h.tier >= 3);
  return homes.length > 0 && homes.every((h) => Boolean(h.met && h.met.food));
}

// At a month end not yet counted, Well fed's run grows by one or starts again. Called on every check, so it counts each
// month end once whether runMonth or a later command gets there first.
function countMonth(world) {
  const def = FEATS.find((f) => f.check.kind === 'fedRun');
  if (!def || world.day <= 0 || world.day % DAYS_PER_MONTH !== 0) return;
  const m = world.day / DAYS_PER_MONTH;
  const c = world.feats.counters;
  if (c.fedMonth === m) return;
  c.fedMonth = m;
  c.fedRun = fedNow(world, def.check.people) ? (c.fedRun || 0) + 1 : 0;
}

// 'earned', 'lost' or null (still open) for one feat now.
function judge(world, c) {
  switch (c.kind) {
    case 'neverInDebt':
      if (world.gold < 0) return 'lost';
      return reachedKnown(world, c.milestone) ? 'earned' : null;
    case 'fedRun':
      return (world.feats.counters.fedRun || 0) >= c.months ? 'earned' : null;
    case 'without':
      if (allBuildings(world).some((b) => b.type === c.type)) return 'lost';
      return reachedKnown(world, c.milestone) ? 'earned' : null;
    case 'noneBurned':                                   // fire starts at Town, so every building burned counts
      if (!reachedKnown(world, c.milestone)) return null;
      if (world.tally.burned > 0) return 'lost';
      return world.day - world.splits[c.milestone] >= c.days ? 'earned' : null;
    case 'cleanRaid': {
      const last = world.raid.last;
      return last && last.won && last.burned === 0 && last.stolen === 0 ? 'earned' : null;
    }
    case 'noTribute':
      if (world.tally.tributes > 0) return 'lost';
      return reachedKnown(world, c.milestone) ? 'earned' : null;
    case 'buildings':
      return allBuildings(world).filter((b) => c.types.includes(b.type)).length >= c.n ? 'earned' : null;
    case 'jobs': {
      const L = world.labour;
      return population(world) >= c.people && L.workforce > 0 && (L.workforce - L.employed) / L.workforce <= c.rate ? 'earned' : null;
    }
    case 'tally':
      return (world.tally[c.key] || 0) >= c.n ? 'earned' : null;
    case 'before':
      if (known(world, c.milestone)) return world.splits[c.milestone] < c.day ? 'earned' : 'lost';
      return !atLeast(world, c.milestone) && world.day >= c.day ? 'lost' : null;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// Records each feat newly earned (pushing { type: 'feat', id }) or ruled out; returns the ids earned by this call.
// Peaceful skips the raid feats (spec 4.18).
export function checkFeats(world, events = null) {
  countMonth(world);
  const f = world.feats;
  const added = [];
  for (const def of featsFor(world)) {
    if (f.earned.includes(def.id) || f.lost.includes(def.id)) continue;
    const v = judge(world, def.check);
    if (v === 'earned') {
      f.earned.push(def.id);
      added.push(def.id);
      if (events) events.push({ type: 'feat', id: def.id });
    } else if (v === 'lost') f.lost.push(def.id);
  }
  return added;
}

// What the interface says about one feat: 'earned', 'lost' (it can no longer be earned, including a milestone the city
// passed before the world kept its day) or 'open'.
export function featStatus(world, def) {
  if (world.feats.earned.includes(def.id)) return 'earned';
  if (world.feats.lost.includes(def.id)) return 'lost';
  const m = def.check.milestone;
  if (m && atLeast(world, m) && !known(world, m)) return 'lost';
  return 'open';
}
```

```js
      c.clear();
      expect(c.busy()).toBe(false);

  });
});
```

```js
// The opening chain's count (spec 4.1): Founded Thebes, done from the start, and the goals up to OPENING_LAST, as
// { done, of } ("1 of 10" for a new city); null once every one of them is done.
export function openingProgress(world) {
  const opening = GOALS.slice(0, GOALS.findIndex((g) => g.id === OPENING_LAST) + 1);
  const done = opening.filter((g) => world.goals.completed.includes(g.id)).length;
  return done < opening.length ? { done: done + 1, of: opening.length + 1 } : null;
}
```

with

```js
// its caption appears, so sound and sparkle land with it. While hold() is true the next caption waits in the queue
// (createUI holds captions while a tip shows on a phone at larger text, where the rows together would reach the
// middle of the map); resume() shows it once nothing holds it and the row is free.
// Stage 3: a caption may carry its own icon (a citizen remark's speech mark), busy() says whether the row is taken, and
// remarkFor picks a citizen remark (spec 4.19).
import { CHEER_MS, CHEER_GAP_MS } from '../data/ui.js';
import { REMARK_EVERY_MONTHS, REMARK_SALT, SEASONS } from '../data/tips.js';
import { allBuildings } from '../sim/world.js';
import { monthIndex } from '../sim/clock.js';
import { hash2 } from '../sim/rng.js';
import { el, clear } from './components.js';
import { cheerReward, CITIZEN_REMARKS } from './text.js';

// The citizen remark for the month that has just begun (spec 4.19, ruling 130), or null: only at a month index that is a
// multiple of REMARK_EVERY_MONTHS, from the season's remarks whose building the city has, chosen by
// hash2(seed, month index, REMARK_SALT), so a city hears the same line at the same month every time.
export function remarkFor(world) {
  const m = monthIndex(world);
  if (m <= 0 || m % REMARK_EVERY_MONTHS !== 0) return null;
  const season = SEASONS[m % SEASONS.length];
  const has = new Set(allBuildings(world).map((b) => b.type));
  const pool = CITIZEN_REMARKS.filter((r) => r.season === season && has.has(r.type));
  if (!pool.length) return null;
  return pool[Math.min(pool.length - 1, Math.floor(hash2(world.seed, m, REMARK_SALT) * pool.length))].text;
}
```

```js
// The next threshold (spec 4.1, ruling 127): the next milestone by the people the city has had, the measure that makes
// it a milestone at a month end ("Town: 83 of 150 people"); from Capital the next medal ("Silver: 38 points to go"),
// null at gold. share: how far from the last one to the next, 0 to 1.
export function thresholdFor(world) {
  const clamp = (v) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
  const i = milestoneIndex(world.milestone);
  if (i < MILESTONES.length - 1) {
    const next = MILESTONES[i + 1], from = MILESTONES[i].population;
    const n = Math.min(next.population, Math.max(world.tally.peakPeople, population(world)));
    return { kind: 'milestone', text: thresholdMilestoneText(next.name, n, next.population), share: clamp((n - from) / (next.population - from)) };
  }
  const s = scoreOf(world);
  if (!s.next) return null;
  const k = MEDALS.findIndex((m) => m.id === s.next.medal);
  const from = k > 0 ? MEDALS[k - 1].at : 0;
  return { kind: 'medal', text: thresholdMedalText(s.next), share: clamp((s.raw - from) / (MEDALS[k].at - from)) };
}
```

# Track F: balance and integration (the controller, after A-E merge)

CONTRACT NOTE: The long runs need raider entries to meet raids at all (Track B's `raiseWarning` returns early on a map without any), and `makeTestWorld` gives none by default. The 10-year village and the capital run take the two entries mapgen gives a 48-tile map, `[{ x: 47, y: 24 }, { x: 24, y: 0 }]` (the middle of the east edge and of the north edge), through `makeTestWorld({ raiderEntries })` and the capital map's own `raiderEntries`. No contract change.
CONTRACT NOTE: Ruling 114's band is asserted on the 10-year village (`tests/sim/longrun.test.js`), the steady tier-4 town (17 Houses, 272 people, a Market town), as its last 12 months' spending over its last 12 months' taxes. The village reaches the band with two firehouses and three towers (65.3%; 45% without them), so no data number is tuned. It uses towers rather than a barracks so that the band does not depend on how many soldiers Track B's barracks has trained, which differs between the stubs (none) and the real code (four). The capital run is not held to the band (39% with its defences), as ruling 114 expects.
CONTRACT NOTE: `fireCoverage` (Track 0, complete) reads a building's own road tiles, so a home with no road beside it (the capital run's second row of homes, row 14) can never be covered. The coverage assertions therefore cover every building that can burn and touches a road. The gap is a follow-up for the spec (`docs/superpowers/notes/2026-10-11-stage-3-followups.md`), not something Track F changes.
CONTRACT NOTE: Removing the calm switch also removes Track 0's test "skips fire and raids for a calm world" from `tests/stage3/contract/simSeams.test.js`; the raider-entries check it carried stays as a test of its own, and `tests/stage3/balance/cities.test.js` reads `src/sim/clock.js` to keep the switch from coming back.
CONTRACT NOTE: `devScene` needs three things the contract names but does not spell for it: the map's size (read from `ui.cameraControl.centre()`, the interface's own view), Track D's tribute sheet (opened through `ui.alerts.action(alert, 'tribute')`, the contract's alert-action seam, which D answers with `openSheet(…, 'tribute')`) and Track E's score section (`#sheet .score-section`, falling back to the first sheet part after the goals list). Where the sim would take years, a scene writes the contract's record shapes directly (`b.fire`, `raid.warning`, `raid.active`, soldiers, `world.wall`).
CONTRACT NOTE: The tracks table gives Track F two tasks; F2 is split here into F2a (the sample and stress cities, the calm switch, the title backdrop), F2b (`difficultyHint`), F2c (`devScene`) and F2d (README, follow-ups and the final review), each its own commit.

## Track F: Balance and integration

Track F runs last, on `stage-3-danger` in `C:\dev\thebes`, after the controller has merged `s3-fire`, `s3-raids`, `s3-art`, `s3-ui` and `s3-score` and the full suite passes. It owns `tests/sim/longrun.test.js`, `tests/sim/capital.test.js`, `src/dev/*`, `difficultyHint` (edited in place in `src/ui/text.js`), `tests/stage3/balance.all.js` with `tests/stage3/balance/*`, the README and the notes; as the controller it also takes the calm switch out of `src/sim/clock.js` and Track 0's test of it. Run every command from `C:\dev\thebes`.

What the track does, in one paragraph: the 10-year village and the 6-year capital run stop being calm and meet real fire and raids, so their scripts build firehouses as soon as the city is a Town and defences once it is a Market town, through the player's own commands; the village then spends 60-70% of its taxes on wages, upkeep and soldiers' pay (ruling 114) and the long runs check that a defended city loses no raid and burns almost nothing. The sample city (the title backdrop, `?sample=1`, the screenshot scenes) leaves two spots on each street for firehouses and builds them the day it becomes a Town, and a solvent Market town gets a tower and a barracks; the stress city cycles through the firehouse, tower and barracks too, and the calm switch goes from the clock. `difficultyHint` names each level's danger from the data. `devScene` sets up the six `-Stage3` screenshot scenes, and the track ends with the README, the follow-ups note and the final review.

**Run against the stubs and against Tracks A and B's drafts.** The plan below was applied, in order and by its own replacement blocks (a script read them from this file), to a copy of `stage-3-danger` at Track 0's last commit (`245f766`), and every claim in it was run there: each task's Step 2 failures are the ones quoted, each task's tests pass, and the full suite passes after each task against the stubs (987, 992, 994 and 999 tests, `ALL PASSED`; F2d changes no code). The applied copy matched the worked copy file for file. The long runs, the sample-city tests and the dev-scene tests were also run in a second copy with Track A's and Track B's draft simulation (`src/sim/fire.js`, `labour.js`, `raids.js`, `combat.js`, `defence.js`, `pathfinding.js` from their scratch worktrees): they pass there too, and the numbers quoted in the comments (blazes, raids, the band) come from that run. The only failures in that copy were the three tests Tracks A and B update in their own tasks (`integration > grows from huts to houses within two years` and the two stub tests in `simSeams.test.js`). Assertions that depend on A's and B's final tuning are marked in each task, with what to change if one misses.

**Measured numbers (Tracks A and B's drafts, normal difficulty):**

| Run | Spending / taxes | Fire | Raids | Time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10-year village, 2 firehouses, 3 towers | 65.3% over the last year (the same with the stubs) | 26 blazes, all put out, nothing burned | 3 (the first of 3 raiders, the last of 6), all beaten by the towers | about 0.4 s |
| the same village without firehouses or defences | 40% (it is dying) | 61 buildings burned | 3, all lost | |
| capital run, 5 firehouses, 2 barracks, 2 towers | 39% | 27 blazes, all put out, nothing burned | 2 (the second of 12), both beaten | about 0.9 s |
| capital run without firehouses | | 104 buildings burned; never reaches Capital | 2, both lost | |
| sample city (seeds 11, 1, 7), 600 days | | no blaze (covered homes build risk at a fifth of the rate) | none (the first warning comes 720 days after the clock) | about 70 ms, the same as Stage 2's calm build |

**Model hint:** opus (balance judgement: the band, the long runs' bounds, and what to change if the merged sim moves them).

**Files:**

- Modify: `tests/sim/capital.test.js`

- Consumes: `place`, `drawRoad`, `paintHouses` (commands); `advanceDays`; `atLeast` (`progression.js`); `canBurn`, `staffedCover` (Track 0, complete, `fire.js`); `touchesRoad` (`reach.js`); `makeTestWorld({ raiderEntries })`; `world.stats.lastMonth.{ taxes, wages, upkeep, soldiers }`; the tallies `burned`, `raidsLost`; the real `fireDay` and `raidDay` (A, B), which run because the long runs no longer set `world.calm`.
- Produces: the 10-year village's and the capital run's Stage 3 scripts and the band assertion (spec 4.11, 9; ruling 114).

```js
}

// village): enough for a raid of nine (towers needed = raiders / 3, rounded up). Towers never burn.
const LATER = [
  { milestone: 'town', steps: [['firehouse', 8, 11], ['firehouse', 21, 11]] },
  { milestone: 'market_town', steps: [['tower', 14, 11], ['tower', 22, 11], ['tower', 26, 11]] },
];

function checkSane(w) {
  expect(Number.isFinite(w.gold)).toBe(true);
  expect(w.mood).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
  expect(w.mood).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
  for (const b of allBuildings(w)) {
    for (const v of Object.values(b.store)) expect(v).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    if (b.type === 'house') {
      expect(b.residents).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
      for (const v of Object.values(b.stock)) expect(v).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    }
  }
}

// Runs the village for ten years, month by month, adding LATER's buildings as their milestones come; returns the world
// and each month's spending (wages, upkeep and soldiers' pay) and taxes.
function runVillage() {
  const w = realVillage();
  const later = LATER.map((l) => ({ ...l, done: false }));
  const months = [];
  let lowestGold = w.gold;
  for (let month = 0; month < 120; month++) {
    advanceDays(w, 30);
    checkSane(w);
    lowestGold = Math.min(lowestGold, w.gold);
    const s = w.stats.lastMonth;
    months.push({ spent: s.wages + s.upkeep + s.soldiers, taxes: s.taxes });
    for (const l of later) {
      if (l.done || !atLeast(w, l.milestone)) continue;
      for (const [type, x, y] of l.steps) expect(`${type} ${place(w, type, x, y).ok}`).toBe(`${type} true`);
      l.done = true;
    }
  }
  return { w, months, lowestGold, later };
}

describe('longrun', () => {
  it('stays sane and solvent for ten years from the starting treasury, through fire and raids', () => {
    const started = performance.now();
    const { w, lowestGold, later } = runVillage();
    const elapsed = performance.now() - started;
    expect(later.map((l) => l.done)).toEqual([true, true]);                     // both firehouses and the three towers stand
    expect(lowestGold).toBeGreaterThan(-500);
    // The treasury must grow, but a runaway money loop would also pass a lower bound alone.
    expect(w.gold).toBeGreaterThan(ECONOMY.startGold);
    expect(w.gold).toBeLessThan(60000);
    expect(population(w)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(220);
    expect(housesOf(w).filter((h) => h.tier === 4).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(15);
    // Every building that can burn and stands on the street has a staffed firehouse in reach (spec 4.12's coverage).
    const uncovered = allBuildings(w).filter((b) => canBurn(b) && touchesRoad(w, b) && !staffedCover(w, b));
    expect(uncovered.map((b) => `${b.type} ${b.x},${b.y}`)).toEqual([]);
    // Fire and raids leave a defended town standing: a covered blaze goes out, and three towers beat every raid this
    // village meets (measured with Tracks A and B: 26 blazes, every one put out, nothing burned, three raids of 3 to 6
    // beaten). The bounds leave room for retuning; they hold trivially before fire and raids exist.
    expect(w.tally.burned).toBeLessThanOrEqual(6);
    expect(w.tally.raidsLost).toBe(0);
    expect(elapsed).toBeLessThan(3000);
  });

  it('spends 60-70% of its taxes on wages, upkeep and soldiers\' pay as a steady tier-4 town (spec 4.11, ruling 114)', () => {
    const { w, months } = runVillage();
    expect(housesOf(w).filter((h) => h.tier === 4).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(15);
    const year = months.slice(-12);
    const share = year.reduce((n, m) => n + m.spent, 0) / year.reduce((n, m) => n + m.taxes, 0);
    expect(share).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.6);
    expect(share).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.7);
    // Its firehouses and towers are what bring it into the band: the same town without them spends under 50%.
    const without = year.reduce((n, m) => n + m.spent, 0) - 12 * (2 * 4 + 3 * 8 + 5 * 4 * ECONOMY.wagePerWorker);
    expect(without / year.reduce((n, m) => n + m.taxes, 0)).toBeLessThan(0.5);
  });
});
```

```js
import { advanceDays } from '../sim/clock.js';
```

```js
import { housesOf, allBuildings } from '../sim/world.js';
import { atLeast } from '../sim/progression.js';
```

In `src/dev/sampleCity.js`, replace:

```js
// Stage 2 on top of the village once it is a Town (spec 4.6, 4.7, 4.10): a storehouse, a clay pit and a potter on the
```

with:

```js
// Stage 3 (spec 4.12): fire risk builds from Town, and a firehouse reaches FIRE.reach road tiles. Each street keeps two
// spots on its south row free of homes, four tiles either side of the north road; their two firehouses reach the whole
// street (nine tiles either side) and the north road up to the next street. They are built the day the city becomes a
// Town, like a careful player.
const FIRE_DX = [-4, 4];

// Paints a street's south row of homes around its two firehouse spots (the wells at five tiles are skipped as built).
function paintAroundFirehouses(world, ex, y) {
  paintHouses(world, ex - 9, y, ex - 5, y);
  paintHouses(world, ex - 3, y, ex + 3, y);
  paintHouses(world, ex + 5, y, ex + 9, y);
}

// Whether some firehouse (or a firehouse that would stand at f) reaches one of the building's road tiles.
function reaches(world, f, b) {
  const reach = roadReach(world, f, FIRE.reach);
  return adjacentRoadTiles(world, b).some((t) => reach.has(t));
}
const reachedByAny = (world, b) => allBuildings(world).some((f) => f.type === 'firehouse' && reaches(world, f, b));

// Gives every building that can burn and stands on a road a firehouse that reaches it: first the streets' spots, then,
// for anything still out of reach (farms far out west on a map whose river lies far off), the nearest free tile that
// reaches it, searched in rings around it.
function addFirehouses(world, streets) {
  const ex = world.tradeEntry.x;
  for (const y of streets) for (const dx of FIRE_DX) place(world, 'firehouse', ex + dx, y + 1);
  for (let guard = 0; guard < 8; guard++) {
    const b = allBuildings(world).find((x) => canBurn(x) && adjacentRoadTiles(world, x).length && !reachedByAny(world, x));
    if (!b) return;
    let spot = null;
    for (let r = 1; r <= 6 && !spot; r++) {
      for (let y = b.y - r; y < b.y + b.d + r && !spot; y++) {
        for (let x = b.x - r; x < b.x + b.w + r && !spot; x++) {
          const onRing = y === b.y - r || y === b.y + b.d + r - 1 || x === b.x - r || x === b.x + b.w + r - 1;
          if (onRing && canPlace(world, 'firehouse', x, y).ok && reaches(world, { x, y, w: 1, d: 1 }, b)) spot = [x, y];
        }
      }
    }
    if (!spot) return;
    place(world, 'firehouse', spot[0], spot[1]);
  }
}

// Stage 3 (spec 4.13): a Market town's defences, at the north end of the north road where the raiders' northern entry
// lies: a tower beside the road's end and a barracks across it (both reached by the top street's firehouses). A city
// in debt, or close to it, leaves them for later (their upkeep, wages and pay would sink it further).
const DEFENCE_RESERVE = 1000;
function addDefences(world) {
  const ex = world.tradeEntry.x;
  const top = world.size - 10;
  place(world, 'tower', ex + 1, top - 24);
  place(world, 'barracks', ex - 2, top - 25);
}

// Runs the city day by day until test(world) holds or n days have passed; returns the days run.
function advanceUntil(world, n, test) {
  let d = 0;
  while (d < n && !test(world)) { advanceDays(world, 1); d++; }
  return d;
}
```

Why the sample city is laid out this way (seeds 11, 1 and 7 were run):
- A firehouse reaches road tiles up to 7 along from the one beside it, and a street runs nine tiles either side of the north road, so one firehouse cannot cover a street; two at `ex ± 4` on the south row reach `ex - 11` to `ex + 11` and the north road three tiles each way, which joins up with the next street's pair. The farms on the lowest street lie where the fertile land is; on seed 7 they sit at `ex - 17` to `ex - 12`, out of reach, so `addFirehouses` puts one more on the nearest free tile that reaches them (seed 7 gets nine firehouses).
- The firehouses come the day the city becomes a Town, because risk builds only from then (a granary, at 0.5 a day uncovered, would reach 100 within about 200 days, before the Stage 2 step at day 360). Their spots wait empty until then, so the homes never have to go.
- The tower and barracks stand at the north end of the north road, where the raiders' northern entry lies, reached by the top street's firehouses. A city with less than 1,000 gold at day 360 (seed 7) leaves them out, as a careful player in debt would.
- Measured at day 600 (the same with the stubs and with Tracks A and B's drafts, as nothing burns and no raid comes within 600 days): seed 11 a Great city of 789 (Stage 2's sample: a City of 523), 26 Townhouses and a Manor, 10,089 gold; seed 1 a Great city of 597, 5 Townhouses and a Manor; seed 7 a City of 383 at -1,347 gold (Stage 2: -425; its nine firehouses cost 180 gold a month). The cities grow larger than Stage 2's because the firehouses' jobs lift the jobs term of their mood. The Stage 2 tests (`tests/dev/sampleCity.test.js`) still pass: Townhouses at least 5 and a Manor on seeds 11 and 1.
- The title backdrop builds in about 70 ms on a laptop either way, the same as Stage 2's calm build, so it is neither precomputed nor shortened (`tests/stage3/balance/cities.test.js` fails it at a second).

### Task F2b: The difficulty hint names the danger

**Model hint:** opus (interface words that must say exactly what the sim does).

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/ui/text.js` (`difficultyHint`, edited in place; Track F owns it)
- Modify: `sw-files.js` (regenerated)
- Create test: `tests/stage3/balance/difficultyHint.test.js`
- Modify tests: `tests/stage3/balance.all.js`, `tests/ui/difficultyChoice.test.js` (Step 5)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `DIFFICULTIES[level].{ cost, risk, raids }` (`src/data/difficulty.js`); `roadCostOf`; tied in the tests to `raidsOn` (`costs.js`), `dailyRiskOf` (Track 0, complete, `fire.js`) and `raidSize` (Track 0, complete, `raids.js`: the first raid is `RAIDS.firstSize` at every level).
- Produces: `difficultyHint(level)`, three lines: the danger, the buildings' and routes' prices, the road's price. The title card and the Settings sheet show it as before (`white-space: pre-line`).

The words, from the data (spec 4.18; its example "No raids. Fires half as often. Buildings cost about 20% less."):

| Level | Hint |
|---|---|
| Peaceful | No raids. Fire risk builds 50% slower. / Buildings and trade routes cost about 20% less. / Roads: 2 gold a tile. |
| Relaxed | Later raids about 50% smaller. Fire risk builds 50% slower. / … 20% less. / Roads: 2 gold a tile. |
| Normal | Raids and fire risk as usual. / … at their usual cost. / Roads: 2 gold a tile. |
| Hard | Later raids about 50% bigger. Fire risk builds 50% faster. / … about 25% more. / Roads: 3 gold a tile. |

Each clause is the sim's rule: Peaceful never starts the raid clock (`raidsOn`); every raid after the first ("later raids") has `round(raw x risk x adaptation)` raiders kept between 2 and 12, hence "about" (the first raid is 3 at every level); fire risk builds at `base x risk x (1 - 0.8 x coverage)` a day, so "50% slower" is exact. The danger line is kept to one line on a landscape phone's title card: a first wording ("Raids about 50% bigger after the first. Fire risk builds 50% faster.") wrapped there and pushed the Install button off the bottom of an 844 x 390 screen. The score factor and the goals Peaceful skips are not in the hint (a follow-up, `docs/superpowers/notes/2026-10-11-stage-3-followups.md`).

```js
function cityAt(level) {

  w.difficulty = level;
  w.milestone = 'town';
  addRaw(w, 'house', 20, 20, { tier: 4, residents: 375 });
  const potter = addRaw(w, 'potter', 10, 10);

      'Raids and fire risk as usual.\nBuildings and trade routes at their usual cost.\nRoads: 2 gold a tile.',
      'Later raids about 50% bigger. Fire risk builds 50% faster.\nBuildings and trade routes cost about 25% more.\nRoads: 3 gold a tile.',
    ]);

    const base = { risk: dailyRiskOf(normal.w, normal.potter), size: (normal.w.raid.index = 1, raidSize(normal.w)) };
    expect(base).toEqual({ risk: 1, size: 8 });

      const { w, potter } = cityAt(level);

      expect([level, dailyRiskOf(w, potter)]).toEqual([level, base.risk * fireFactor]);
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

In `src/ui/text.js`, replace:

```js
// Difficulty on the title card (spec 4.18): what the chosen level changes, from the data. Buildings and trade routes
// scale by the level's cost multiplier ("about": each price is rounded to whole gold); a road is only 2 gold, so its
// rounded price per tile is given as it is, on a line of its own (the title card shows the hint with white-space:
// pre-line). Fire and raids (the risk multiplier) arrive in Stage 3 and are not promised.
export function difficultyHint(level) {
  const pct = Math.round((DIFFICULTIES[level].cost - 1) * 100);
  const roads = `Roads: ${roadCostOf({ difficulty: level })} gold a tile.`;
  const rest = pct === 0 ? 'at their usual cost' : `cost about ${Math.abs(pct)}% ${pct < 0 ? 'less' : 'more'}`;
  return `Buildings and trade routes ${rest}.\n${roads}`;
}
```

with:

```js
// Difficulty on the title card (spec 4.18): what the chosen level changes, from the data, on three lines (the title
// card shows the hint with white-space: pre-line). First the danger: a level without raids never starts the raid clock
// (raidsOn); otherwise the level's risk multiplier scales the size of every raid after the first, which is
// RAIDS.firstSize at every level (raidSize; "about": a size is rounded and kept between 2 and 12), and the same
// multiplier scales how fast fire risk builds up (dailyRiskOf). Then buildings and trade routes, scaled by the level's
// cost multiplier ("about": each price is rounded to whole gold); a road is only 2 gold, so its rounded price per tile
// is given as it is. The danger line stays short enough for one line on a landscape phone's title card.
export function difficultyHint(level) {
  const { cost, risk, raids } = DIFFICULTIES[level];
  const by = Math.abs(Math.round((risk - 1) * 100));
  const fire = risk === 1 ? 'Fire risk as usual.' : `Fire risk builds ${by}% ${risk < 1 ? 'slower' : 'faster'}.`;
  const danger = raids === false ? `No raids. ${fire}` : risk === 1 ? 'Raids and fire risk as usual.' : `Later raids about ${by}% ${risk < 1 ? 'smaller' : 'bigger'}. ${fire}`;
  const pct = Math.round((cost - 1) * 100);
  const roads = `Roads: ${roadCostOf({ difficulty: level })} gold a tile.`;
  const rest = pct === 0 ? 'at their usual cost' : `cost about ${Math.abs(pct)}% ${pct < 0 ? 'less' : 'more'}`;
  return `${danger}\nBuildings and trade routes ${rest}.\n${roads}`;
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: boot's `api` (`phase()`, `game()` → `{ world, ui, loop, cam }`, `startGame`); `ui.store`, `ui.settings`, `ui.cameraControl` (`centre()`, `jumpTo`), `ui.alerts` (`list()`, `action(alert, kind)`, the contract's seam to `danger.onAlertAction`), `ui.refresh()`; `openSheet`, `closeSheet` (`modes.js`); `place`, `drawRoad`, `setPaused` (commands); `assignLabour`; `coverageOf`, `roadReach`, `adjacentRoadTiles`; `raidSize`, `tributeFor`, `raidTargetKind`, `entryDir` (Track 0, complete); `DEFENCE`, `RAIDS`, `UNITS`, `FIRE`; the record shapes `b.fire`, `raid.warning`, `raid.active`, a soldier, `world.wall`; Track D's `tribute` sheet (opened by `danger.onAlertAction(alert, 'tribute')`) and Track E's `#sheet .score-section`.
- Produces: `devScene(api, name)` resolving a short description (`'peaceful'`, `'fire <id> <coverage>'`, `'tribute <size> <cost>'`, `'battle …'`, `'score'`, `'ambient <x>,<y>'`) or rejecting with a message; `DEV_SCENES`, the six names in `tools/shots.ps1 -Stage3`'s order.

The scenes (the URLs are `tools/shots.ps1`'s; every game scene opens the seed-11 sample city of Task F2a, which starts paused, so a scene stays as it is set):
- `peaceful` (`/?nosw=1`): presses Peaceful on the title card, so its hint shows.
- `fire`: the nearest pair of side-by-side homes on a street to the city's focus; the firehouses that reach them are paused through `setPaused` (a player's own command), so no staffed firehouse reaches either; one home is in the fire stage (`{ stage: 'fire', days: 4, left: 8 }`) and its neighbour a blaze (`{ stage: 'blaze', days: 1, need: 2, fought: 0 }`), `danger.firePaused` set (the first-time pause has happened). Reduced motion off, so the flames move. The home is put in the middle of the free map.
- `tribute`: the second raid's warning from the east (the first raid came and was beaten 200 days ago, beyond the mood term's 180 days), its size and tribute from `raidSize` and `tributeFor`, 60 days to go; then Pay tribute through the alert-action seam, which Track D answers with its tribute sheet.
- `battle`: the north road runs three tiles further north; a wall line 13 tiles long crosses it two tiles from its new end (a gate on the road), a tower stands on the wall either side of the gate (`place`: a tower on a standing wall tile has 80 hit points), the gate is hit (22 of 40) and one wall tile is broken (-1). Six raiders from the north stand at the gate, two of them hurt; the barracks' soldiers (up to three, trained ones first) are out behind the wall; the day's shots run from each tower to a raider. Reduced motion off.
- `score`: the city summary, scrolled to Track E's score section.
- `ambient`: ambient motion on and reduced motion off, zoom 1.5, the camera on the river west of the city's focus.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

Replace the whole of `src/dev/scenes.js` with:

```js
// Development scenes for the Stage 3 screenshots (tools/shots.ps1 -Stage3): window.__thebes.devScene(name) sets up one
// scene and resolves with a short description when it is ready to capture. boot.js exposes devScene before the title
// card shows; api is boot's returned object ({ phase, game, startGame, hooks }).
//
// 'peaceful' runs on the title card (/?nosw=1) and chooses Peaceful, so its hint shows. The others run in a game,
// opened on the seed-11 sample city (/?skipTitle=1&nosw=1&seed=11&sample=1), which starts paused, so each scene stays
// as it is set: 'fire' (a home burning next to a blaze, the firehouses that reach them paused), 'tribute' (a later
// raid's warning with the tribute sheet open), 'battle' (raiders at a wall with a gate and two towers, soldiers out),
// 'score' (the city summary) and 'ambient' (river life close up). Where the sim would take years to get there, a scene
// writes the contract's world state directly (a b.fire record, raid.warning, raid.active, soldiers, wall tiles), and it
// builds what a player would through the commands. A scene that needs motion (flames, ambient life) turns reduced
// motion off in the settings, because headless browsers ask for it.
import { place, drawRoad, setPaused } from '../sim/commands.js';
import { assignLabour } from '../sim/labour.js';
import { allBuildings, housesOf } from '../sim/world.js';
import { coverageOf } from '../sim/fire.js';
import { roadReach, adjacentRoadTiles } from '../sim/reach.js';
import { raidSize, tributeFor, raidTargetKind, entryDir } from '../sim/raids.js';
import { idx, inBounds } from '../sim/grid.js';
import { T as TERRAIN } from '../sim/terrain.js';
import { DEFENCE, RAIDS, UNITS } from '../data/raids.js';
import { FIRE } from '../data/fire.js';
import { screenToTile } from '../render/camera.js';
import { openSheet, closeSheet } from '../ui/modes.js';
import { T } from '../ui/text.js';

export const DEV_SCENES = ['peaceful', 'fire', 'tribute', 'battle', 'score', 'ambient'];

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function inGame(api, name) {
  const g = api.game();
  if (!g) throw new Error(`devScene ${name}: no city is open (use ?skipTitle=1&sample=1)`);
  return g;
}

// The map's size in CSS px, as the interface measures it (the camera control's centre is its middle).
function viewOf(g) {
  const c = g.ui.cameraControl.centre();
  return { width: c.x * 2, height: c.y * 2 };
}

// Puts tile (x, y) in the middle of the map the interface leaves free (the top bar, and the side panel, the rail or
// a sheet take the rest), by a jump, so no camera tween is left running when the capture is taken.
function focus(g, x, y, kind = 'browse') {
  const v = viewOf(g);
  const layout = g.ui.store.get().layout, top = 48;
  const i = layout === 'portrait'
    ? { top, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: kind === 'sheet' ? v.height * 0.6 : v.height * 0.2 }
    : { top, left: 0, bottom: 0, right: layout === 'compact' ? 56 + 268 : 320 };
  const midX = i.left + (v.width - i.left - i.right) / 2, midY = i.top + (v.height - i.top - i.bottom) / 2;
  const c = screenToTile({ x, y, zoom: g.cam.zoom }, v, v.width - midX, v.height - midY);
  g.ui.cameraControl.jumpTo(c.x, c.y);
}

// The tile north of the city where its north road ends (the sample city's road runs north from the start road).
function northRoadEnd(world) {
  const ex = world.tradeEntry.x;
  let y = world.size - 10;
  while (y > 0 && world.road[idx(world.size, ex, y - 1)]) y--;
  return { x: ex, y };
}

const freeLand = (world, x, y) => inBounds(world.size, x, y) && !world.occ[idx(world.size, x, y)] && world.terrain[idx(world.size, x, y)] !== TERRAIN.WATER;

// The title card with Peaceful chosen (spec 4.18): its hint names what the level changes.
async function peaceful(api) {
  if (api.phase() !== 'title') throw new Error('devScene peaceful: open the title card (/?nosw=1)');
  const choice = document.querySelector('#title .choice.difficulty[data-value="peaceful"]');
  if (!choice) throw new Error('devScene peaceful: no Peaceful choice on the title card');
  choice.click();
  return 'peaceful';
}

// A home in the fire stage and its neighbour in a blaze (spec 4.12), the firehouses that reach them paused, so no
// staffed firehouse reaches either: the critical fire banner, flames and smoke.
async function fire(api) {
  const g = inGame(api, 'fire'), { world } = g;
  const near = (b) => Math.abs(b.x - world.focus.x) + Math.abs(b.y - world.focus.y);
  const homes = housesOf(world).filter((h) => h.residents > 0 && h.w === 1 && adjacentRoadTiles(world, h).length).sort((a, b) => near(a) - near(b));
  const neighbour = (h) => housesOf(world).find((o) => o.residents > 0 && o.y === h.y && Math.abs(o.x - h.x) === 1);
  const home = homes.find((h) => neighbour(h));
  if (!home) throw new Error('devScene fire: no pair of homes side by side');
  const next = neighbour(home);
  for (const f of allBuildings(world)) {
    if (f.type !== 'firehouse') continue;
    const reach = roadReach(world, f, FIRE.reach);
    if ([home, next].some((b) => adjacentRoadTiles(world, b).some((t) => reach.has(t)))) setPaused(world, f.id, true);
  }
  assignLabour(world);
  home.fire = { stage: 'fire', days: 4, left: 8 };
  next.fire = { stage: 'blaze', days: 1, need: 2, fought: 0 };
  home.risk = 0; next.risk = 0;                      // risk goes back to 0 when a building catches fire
  world.danger.lastFireDay = world.day;
  world.danger.firePaused = true;                    // the city's first-time pause has happened (the game is paused)
  world.tally.fires += 2;
  g.ui.settings.set({ reducedMotion: 'off' });
  g.ui.refresh();
  focus(g, home.x + 0.5, home.y + 0.5);
  await wait(100);
  return `fire ${home.id} ${coverageOf(world, home)}`;
}

// A later raid's warning (spec 4.13), so it carries a tribute, with the tribute sheet open (the warning's Pay tribute).
async function tribute(api) {
  const g = inGame(api, 'tribute'), { world } = g;
  const r = world.raid;
  const entry = { ...(world.raiderEntries.find((e) => entryDir(world, e) === 'east') || world.raiderEntries[0]) };
  r.clockDay = r.clockDay === null ? 0 : r.clockDay;
  r.last = { index: 0, dir: entryDir(world, entry), size: RAIDS.firstSize, won: true, byTowers: RAIDS.firstSize, bySoldiers: 0, towers: 1, burned: 0, stolen: 0, day: Math.max(0, world.day - 200) };
  world.tally.raids += 1; world.tally.raidsBeaten += 1;
  r.index = 1;                                       // the first raid came and was beaten: this warning is the second's
  const size = raidSize(world);
  r.warning = { index: 1, entry, dir: entryDir(world, entry), size, tribute: tributeFor(world, size), target: raidTargetKind(world), day: world.day - 30, arrives: world.day - 30 + RAIDS.warningDays, first: false };
  r.index = 2;
  r.nextWarnDay = null;
  g.ui.refresh();
  const w = r.warning;
  const alert = g.ui.alerts.list().find((a) => a.code === 'raid_warning') || { code: 'raid_warning', x: entry.x, y: entry.y, dir: w.dir, arrives: w.arrives };
  g.ui.alerts.action(alert, 'tribute');
  await wait(100);
  return `tribute ${size} ${w.tribute}`;
}

// Raiders at a wall (spec 4.13, 5.4): the north road runs on past a wall line with a gate on it and a tower either
// side of the gate; the band is at the gate with two raiders hurt, the gate is damaged and one wall tile broken, and
// the barracks' soldiers are out on the near side.
async function battle(api) {
  const g = inGame(api, 'battle'), { world } = g;
  const end = northRoadEnd(world), ex = end.x;
  const gold = world.gold;
  world.gold = Math.max(gold, 10000);                // the scene's road and towers, laid through the commands
  drawRoad(world, ex, end.y, ex, end.y - 3);
  const wallY = end.y - 2;
  let tiles = 0;
  for (let x = ex - 6; x <= ex + 6; x++) {
    const i = idx(world.size, x, wallY);
    if (!(world.road[i] || freeLand(world, x, wallY))) continue;
    world.wall[i] = world.road[i] ? DEFENCE.gateHp : DEFENCE.wallHp;
    tiles++;
  }
  world.wallVersion++;
  world.tally.wallTiles += tiles;
  const towers = [];
  for (const x of [ex - 1, ex + 1]) {
    const placed = place(world, 'tower', x, wallY);   // a tower on a standing wall tile gives the tile its 80 hit points
    if (placed.ok) towers.push(world.buildings[placed.id]);
  }
  world.gold = gold;
  assignLabour(world);
  world.wall[idx(world.size, ex, wallY)] = 22;       // the gate, hit
  if (world.wall[idx(world.size, ex + 4, wallY)] > 0) world.wall[idx(world.size, ex + 4, wallY)] = -1;   // a breach
  world.wallVersion++;
  const entry = { ...(world.raiderEntries.find((e) => entryDir(world, e) === 'north') || world.raiderEntries[0]) };
  const spots = [[ex, wallY - 1, 10], [ex - 1, wallY - 1, 6], [ex + 1, wallY - 2, 10], [ex + 3, wallY - 1, 4], [ex + 4, wallY - 2, 10], [ex - 2, wallY - 3, 10]];
  const raiders = spots.map(([x, y, hp]) => ({ id: world.nextUnitId++, x, y, hp, hit: hp < UNITS.raider.hp }));
  // Three soldiers out behind the wall: those the barracks has trained, then new ones (ids follow the raiders').
  const barracks = allBuildings(world).find((b) => b.type === 'barracks');
  if (barracks) {
    [[ex, wallY + 1], [ex - 3, wallY + 1], [ex + 2, wallY + 1]].forEach(([x, y], k) => {
      let s = world.soldiers[k];
      if (!s) { s = { id: world.nextUnitId++, barracks: barracks.id }; world.soldiers.push(s); }
      Object.assign(s, { x, y, hp: UNITS.soldier.hp, hit: false, task: 'out' });
    });
  }
  const target = allBuildings(world).find((b) => b.type === raidTargetKind(world));
  const r = world.raid;
  r.clockDay = r.clockDay === null ? 0 : r.clockDay;
  r.warning = null;
  r.index = Math.max(r.index, 2);
  r.active = {
    index: 1, entry, dir: entryDir(world, entry), size: raiders.length + 1, target: raidTargetKind(world), day: world.day - 3,
    raiders, phase: 'attack', targetId: target ? target.id : null, struck: [], wait: 0, byTowers: 1, bySoldiers: 0, burned: 0, stolen: 0,
    shots: towers.map((t, k) => ({ from: { x: t.x, y: t.y }, to: { x: raiders[k + 1].x, y: raiders[k + 1].y } })),
  };
  world.tally.raids += 1;
  world.tally.raidersByTowers += 1;
  g.ui.settings.set({ reducedMotion: 'off' });
  g.ui.refresh();
  focus(g, ex + 0.5, wallY + 0.5);
  await wait(100);
  return `battle ${raiders.length} raiders ${world.soldiers.length} soldiers ${towers.length} towers on the wall`;
}

// The city summary, scrolled to the score and its parts (spec 4.19): Track E's score section, or else the first of the
// sheet parts that follow the goals list (src/ui/sheets.js summarySheet).
async function score(api) {
  const g = inGame(api, 'score');
  const s = g.ui.store.get();
  g.ui.store.set(openSheet(s.sheet ? closeSheet(s) : s, 'summary'));
  await wait(100);
  const sheet = document.querySelector('#sheet');
  const heading = sheet && [...sheet.querySelectorAll('h3')].find((h) => h.textContent === T.goals);
  const part = sheet && (sheet.querySelector('.score-section') || (heading && heading.nextElementSibling && heading.nextElementSibling.nextElementSibling));
  if (part) {
    const head = sheet.querySelector('.head');
    sheet.scrollTop += part.getBoundingClientRect().top - (head ? head.getBoundingClientRect().bottom : sheet.getBoundingClientRect().top) - 8;
  }
  return 'score';
}

// River life close up (spec 5.6): the stretch of river nearest the city's middle street, ambient motion on.
async function ambient(api) {
  const g = inGame(api, 'ambient'), { world } = g;
  g.ui.settings.set({ ambient: true, reducedMotion: 'off' });
  const y = world.focus.y;
  let best = null;
  for (let x = world.focus.x; x >= 0 && !best; x--) if (world.terrain[idx(world.size, x, y)] === TERRAIN.WATER) best = { x, y };
  if (!best) throw new Error('devScene ambient: no river west of the city');
  g.cam.zoom = 1.5;
  focus(g, best.x + 2, best.y);
  await wait(600);
  return `ambient ${best.x},${best.y}`;
}

const SCENES = { peaceful, fire, tribute, battle, score, ambient };

export async function devScene(api, name) {
  const scene = SCENES[name];
  if (!scene) throw new Error(`devScene: no scene named ${name} (${DEV_SCENES.join(', ')})`);
  return scene(api);
}
```
